yang mi gzhug ste/ 'di ltar 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i sring mo'i bu gnyis rab tu byung nas le los 'da' bar byed pa de gnyis shi zhing dus la bab na 'dir skye bar 'gyur bas de gnyis kyi don du bzhag go/ /de gnyis shin tu skrag nas gal te shes na deng zhunyid du bcug rgyapar 'ong ngo snyam nas phyogs bzhir rnam par blta bar brtsams nas/ de gnyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i gan du dong ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos smras pa/khyed rngu kyis mthong ngam/ 'phags pa mthong ngo / /de na ci yod/ sems can dmyal ba dag mchis so/ /de na ci byed/ de gnyis kyis smra sa pa/gcod pa dang / 'tsheg gipa dang / rdung ba dang / 'dral ba la sogs pa'i las dag bgyid cing de na kha cig 5ni sog le dag gis 'tsheg par bgyidas/ kha cig ni rang thag dag gis 'thag par bgyid/ kha cig ni zangs po che khol 7ba dag gi nang du stsol bar bgyid de/ de na lcags kyi zangs po che gnyis shig khol zhing samachis pa mthong nas bdag cag gis shes ldan dag 'di gnyis su su yang mi gzhug gam zhes bgyis na/ de dag gi tshomachid nas su yang mi gzhug ste/'di ltar 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i sring mo'i bu gnyis rab tu byung nas le los 'da' bar byed pa de gnyis shi zhing dus la bab na 'dir skye bar 'gyur bas sade gnyis kyi don du bzhag go zhes mchi'o / /dge tshul gnyis de ltar na nyes 1 dmigs 'di dag dang / gzhan dag kyang le los 'byung bar 'gyur bas brtson 'grus gyis shig /de gnyis brtson 'grus rtsom pa bklag nyu par bya bar brtsams shing / gal te snga dro sems can dmyal ba dran na ni zan za bar yang mi byed la/gal te phyi dro 'dran na ni zas 6de skyug par 'gyur bas de gnyis skya nyabo bseng 1—202

bseng po rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang / rke ba dang / skam pa dang /lus ma thob par gyur nas 2des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo de gnyis yid byung bar byas zin to/ /gnas brtan da ni gzengs thustod cig /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal 1 gyi bu chen pos de gnyis la smras pa/ dge tshul gnyis nyin mo spyod du 'dong ngo / /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa bzhud de/phyogs gzhan du bzhud kyi der ni mi bzhud do/ /stan bakhyer cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos de gnyis khrid nas nyin mo spyod du song ngo /de na satshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos phyogs gcig cig 9tu lha dag sprul te / de na pi bang dzodang / 'od 3ma dang / bal nyul ri dang / ma ha ti dang / su gho ṣa ci ka dag gi sgra dag grag go/ /de gnyis kyis smras pa/'phags pa 'di ci lags/ des smras pa/ deng la ltos shig /de gnyis der dong ba dang / ji tsam na pi bang dang / 'od ma dang / bal la ri dang / ma ha ti dang / su gho ṣa ka dag gi sgra dag sgrogs shing de na gzhal med khang mal cha dang sta na 5bshams pa lha'i bu snyomo dag gis yongs su gang ba gnyis shig yod de / de gnyis na lha'i bu su yang mi 'dug pa mthong nas de gnyis kyis smras pa/ shes 1 ldan dag ci'i phyir gzhal med khang 'di gnyis na lha'i bu su yang mi 'dug /de dag gis/ smras pa/ su yang mi 'dug go/ /ci'i phyir/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i sring mo'i bu gnyis rab tu byung nas brtson 'grus brtsams shing spyod pa de gnyis shi zhing dus la bab na 'dir skye bar 'gyur bas de gnyis kyi don du bzhag go/ /de gnyis yongs su dga' nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po'i gan du dong ba dang /1—203

tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos de gnyis la smras pa/ khyed kyis mthong ngam / 'phags pa mthong ngo / /de na ci yod/ lha dag mchis so/ /de na ci byed/ de gnyis kyis smras pa rmi/ pi bang dang / 'od dum dang / bal dul ri dang / ma ha ti dang / su gho ṣa byaka dag gi sgra dag sgrogs shing de na gzhal med khang mal cha dang stan bshams pa lha'i bu mo dag gis yongs su gang ba thuganyis shig mchis te/ de gnyis na lha'i bu su yang ma mchis pa mthong nas/bdag cag gnyis kyis shes ldan dag ci'i phyir gzhal med khang 'di gnyis na lha'i bu su yang mi 'dug ces bgyis byun/ de dag gi mchid rtsonas su yang mi 'dug go/ /ci'i phyir zhes bgyis na de dag gi mchid nas/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i sring mo'i bu gnyis rab tu byung nas brtson 'grus brtsams shing spyod pa de gnyis shi zhing dus la bab na 'dir skye bar 'gyur bas de gnyis kyi don du bzhag go zhes mchi'ori / /dge tshul gnyis de lta sgyu na phan yon 'di dag dang /gzhan dag kyang brtson 'grus brtsams pa las 'byung bar 'gyur bas brtson 'grus gyis shig/ //'dul ba gzhi / bam po brgyad pa/ de gnyis brtson 'grus rtsom pas bklag / par bya bar brtsams te lung nod pa dang / ji tsam gleng gzhi 15dang / yang dag par ldan pa'i rgyud du gtogs pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi nyu)sen mo'i rtse mos rdul dag bzhes nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rtso 7ji snyam du sems/ ngas sen mo'i rtse mos d+kurdul dag blangs pa gang dag yin pa dang / sa la gnas pa'i rdul gang dag yin pa de dag gang mang snyam/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi byaphyag gi sen mo'i rtse 1—204

mos rdul dag bzhes pa gang dag 2lags pa de dag 3ni nyung ba dang / nyung ngu dang / nyung shas dang / nyung zad lags te/ de dag dog sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag chadang bskrun byan brgya'i 3char yang nye bar mi mchi / stong gi cha dang /brgya stong gi cha dang / grangs dang / cha dang / bgrang ba dang / dpe dang / rgyur yang nye bar mi mchi'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag byu ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni ⑨sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa 1—205

de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang skyonas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul ri dīdag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo/'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos/ te lha rnam/sa kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul ridag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams/ kyi nang nas shi 'phos te dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi / sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sem/sa/ can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phros te sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te yi dgas rnams kyi sanang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni 1—206

dud 'gro dag gi ①nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen ②mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi / sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed sakyi sems can dag ni dud 'gro rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed byapa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ⑤ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du 1—207

skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro①/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni ②yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed ②kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ④ni yi dgas rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni lha rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni lha rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems 1—208

can dag ni lha rnams kyi neng nas shi 'phos te dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni lha rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur rol/ /sa la gnas ①pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni lha rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi②/sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni lha rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sa la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur gyi/ sen mo'i rtse mo la gnas pa'i rdul dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sems can dag ni mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa 'khor lo bzhin du sbyar ba blags ③pa dang / de gnyis kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag cag gis kyang ④lha dang mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos te sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro 1—209

dang / yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skye bar bgyi'am/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ①gnyis 'gro ba lnga pa'i ②'khor bar ji srid du nyon mongs pa rnams rgyun chad par ma gyur pa de srid du zo chun rgyud mo'i tshul gyis yongs su 'khor bar bya dgos ②so/ /de gnyis yid byung nas tshigs su bcad pa ⑤smras pa/ gang phyir mi gnas ༅lha rnams mi bzang ste/ /'tsho ba thung ba'i mi rnams mi bzang ngo / /gang na zhi med srid pa mi bzang ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces bde gshegs gsung ⑥/ /'phags pa ci nas kyang bdag cag ⑦'khor bar 'khor ba dun slan chad nyon mongs pa de lta bu dag kun du spyod par mi 'gyur ba de ltar bdag cag la chos bstan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos de gnyis kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba ⑨dang / khams dang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas gang thos nas de gnyis kyis nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa las 'dod chags dang bral ba/ bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil the )du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan dang ste'ur mnyam pa/rig pas sgo 7nga'i sbubs dral bar gyur cing / rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa dang / 'dod pa'i rnyed tsu)pa dang / bkur ste la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis tsomachod par bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur pa de lta bu'i chos bstan pa byas so/ /de gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' la me tog dag thu ④zhing 'dong ba dge slong rnams kyis mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di 1—210

gnyis gang dag yin/ che ge mo dang che ge mo yin no/ /de dag gis smras pa/bdag cag lhung bzed nag por zos nas so dag lhung zhing mgo skya ①bor gyur kyang bdag cag gis sems rtse gcig pa yang ma thob na/ tshe dang ldan pa 'di gnyis dang po lo bdun kho na lon te ②rab tu byung na nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas pas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo brtson 'grus kyis byang chub 'thob ②bo zhes bka' stsal pa de ni legs par gsungs pa ④yin no/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa dge tshul 'di gnyis kyis las ci zhig bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas lo bdun kho na lags na rab tu byung ste'u/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul khyab la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad pa gang lags pa de 'di gnyis kho na la brten ⑦nas bag yangs ④su mdzad cing nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du bgyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di gnyis nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/'od ⑨pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa/ gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag byas shing bsags pas 'di gnyis nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor byamyong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa dag ⑩ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang / skye mched dag la rnam par smin par 'gyur teX/ las 1—211

rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang ①tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal ②pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang / zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu gdul ②ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od sung 'jig rten du byung ste/ de dge slong gi 'khor nyi khri dang bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na nye bar rten cing bzhugs so/ /bā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag phan tshun bshes pa gnyis shig gzhon nu'i gnas skabs su rab tu 'byung bar 'dod na de gnyis kyis nye du dag las rab tu 'byung ba byam thob nas/ gang gi tshe lang tsho yol bar gyur pa de'i tshe na de gnyis kyis nye du dag la bltas te yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /'di ni chos nyid de rtag tu gzhon rim gyis ⑤las bya ba yin pas dge slong rnams kyis rgan zhugs 'di gnyis deng shig༅ /rgan zhugs 'di gnyis khyed ⑦cig ces bsgo'o⑧/ /de na gcig ni spro ring ba'i rang bzhin can yin/ cig ༅shos ni spro thung ba'i rang bzhin can yin pas de khro bar byed pa dang ⑩cig shos kyis smras pa/ rgan zhugs gzhon pa'i gnas 7skabs su rab tu ma byung na da 8ci'i phyir khro/ de na 'di gnyis kyi ⑫tshe ji srid bar tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob nas de'i 'og tu 'chi ba'i tshe smon lam 'di skad ces/ bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 1—212

rgyas yon gnas bla na med pa phya'od srung la tshe ji srid bar tshangs par spyod pa spyad na yon tan gyi tshogs 'ga' yang ma thob ste/ bdag cag gis tshe dzuji srid bar tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma la bram ze'i khye'u khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig 5pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen ④pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba 5bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de'i bstan pa la bdag cag lo bdun kho na lon nas khurab tu byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba mdzad pa gang yin pa de bdag cag gnyis kho na la brten nas bag yangs su mdzad cing nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du gyur cig 3ces gdab par brtsams so/ /dge slong dag de la de'i tshe de'i dus na khyim bdag zhuganyis gang dag yin pa de dag ni dge tshul 'di gnyis yin te/ de gnyis kyis der smon lam btab pa gang yin pa des da ltar lo bdun kho na lon nas rab tu byung ste/ ngas khya'adul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bcas pa gang yin pa 'di gnyis kho na la brten lku nas bag yangs skyesu byas shing nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas 8dgra bcom pa nyid mngon du byas so//1—213

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul ka shi dag tu ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na phyogs gcig cig ①tu byon pa dang 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis na gang gi tshe/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad ②pa de'i tshe —na zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dang / btsod ka dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung nas kha cig ni 'og logs su 'dong / kha cig ni steng logs ②su 'dong bas gang dag 'og logs su 'dong ba de dag ni sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang / bsdus gzhom dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol ba dang / so thams thams ④dang / kyi hud zer ⑤dang / a chu zer ⑥dang / 0la ༅ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen por dong ste/ sems can dmyal ba tsha ba gang dag yin pa de dag tu bsil bar gyur te 'bab ②par byed la/sems can dmyal ba grang ba gang dag ⑨yin pa de dag tu ni tsu )dro bar gyur te 'bab par byed do/ /des sems can dmyal ba de dag gi gnod pa'i bye brag dag rgyun gcod par byed cing de dag 'di snyam du shes ldan dag ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos sam/ 'on te gzhan du skyes snyam du sems so/ /de dag dad pa bskyed 7par bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sprul pa gtong bar mdzad de / de dag gis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du shes ldan dag bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa yang ma yin la/ gzhan du skyes pa yang ma yin te/'di ltar sems can sngon ma mthong ba 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi tsoganod pa'i bye 1—214

brag dag rgyun chad par gyur to snyam du sems so/ /de dag sprul pa la sems mngon par dad par gyur nas sems can dmyal ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i las de zad par byas nas gang du bden pa dag gi snod du gyur par 'gyur ba'i lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyor ba len par byed do/ /gang dag steng logs su 'dong ba de dag ni rgyal po chen po bzhi ༅dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum ②dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs chen dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang /'od gsal dang / dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang /sprin med dang / bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che dang / mi che dudang /mi gdung ④dang / gya rnam snang dang / shin tu mthong dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi nang du dong nas mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs ⑤par byed cing tshigs su bcad pa gnyis po/ brtsam ⑥par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la ༅glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba yang smras so/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams byul dunas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi slad bzhin slad bzhin du 0rjes su 'dong ste/ de la bcom ldan 'das 'das pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snam logs su nub par 'gyur ro/ /1—215

ma 'ongs pa'i las lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su nub par 'gyur①/sems can dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthil du nub par 'gyur/ dud 'gror ②skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni long ③bur nub par 'gyur/ yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor nub par 'gyur/ mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni pus mor nub par 'gyur / stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid ④lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag mthil ⑤g.yon par nub par 'gyur/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid yilung ston par bzhed na ni phyag mthil ⑦g.yas par nub par 'gyur/ lhar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni lte bar nub par 'gyur/ nyan thos kyi byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal du nub par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ni mdzod spur nub par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lung ston par bzhed na ni gtsug tor du nub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan ⑧gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil du nub bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun ⑨dga' bos thal mo sbyar te zhus pa/btsun pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum ⑩pa mi mdzad na/ btsun pa 'dzum pa ⑩mdzad pa'i rgyu ni gang lags/ rkyen ni gang lags/ tshigs su bcad pa yang gsol pa/ kha dog sna tshogs stong gis bkra ba yi/ /tshogs rnams zhal gyi sgros tsonas byung gyur te/ /de yis phyogs rnams thams cad snang bgyis 0pa/ /nyi gdugs bdal ④bar gyur pa ji bzhin no/ /rgod bral zhum 1—216

dang rgyags pa rab spangs la①/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba mchog gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thul byed rgyu ma mchis par/ /rtsa ba ②dung ltar dkar 'dzum ②ston mi mdzad/ /de slad brtan ④pa rang blo dus mkhyen nas/ /thub pa khyu mchog dge sbyong skye dbang po/ /nyan pa'i skye bo som nyi ldan rnams la/ /the tshom skyes pa gsung tshig brtan pa dang / /dam pa dge ba dag gis bsal ⑤du gsol/ /tshwa yichu ri rgyal lta bur brtan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas mgon rnams glo bur 'dzum mi ston / /brtan pa ji slad 'dzum pa ston mdzad pa/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams de ni nyan par 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun ⑦dga' bo de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum ⑤pa mi mdzad de/ kun dga' bo phyogs 'di nyid du g.yon can rab tu mang po dag gis ⑨dge slong ma rab tu mang po dag lus bskyod pas sun phyung ste/de dag 'di nas shi 'phos nas ⑨ sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur rotho〉/ /de nas dge slong zhig gis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de tsugelogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//btsun pa g.yon can rab tu mang po dag gis dge slong ma rab tu mang po dag lus bskyod pas sun phyung ba gang dag lags pa de dag gi nang nas gcig bdag lags so/ /mi gti 'amug can khyod kyis kyang dge slong ma rab tu mang po dag lus bskyod pas sun phyung ngam/ btsun pa bdag gis kyang dge slong ma rab tu mang po dag lus bskyod pas sun phyung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams ④la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gang zag byadage slong ma sun phyung 1—217

ba ni chos 'dul ba 'di la mi skye ba'i chos can yin pas dge slong dag khyed ①kyis gang zag dge slong ma sun phyung ba chos 'dul ba 'di las bsnyil ②bar bya'o/ /'ga' zhig gi gan du rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa 'ongs na/ des de la dge slong ma sun phyung ba ma yin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag cig ①rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'ongs so/ /dge slong dag 'dod chags dang bral ba med pa na dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba 'byin par byed de/ kha cig ④gzhon nu'i gnas skabs su ltung ba byung nas rgan por gyur/ kha cig ni rgan po'i gnas skabs na ltung ba 'byin par byed do/ /de dag gis gang gi khyatshe dge slong mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa rnams las thos pa de'i tshe na chos bzhin du sgrub par byed de/ de dag yongs su spo ba dang mgu bar bya bar ༅spyod pa na dge 'dun la rim gro byed cing de na kha cig ni btung ba 'drim par byed/ kha cig ni bsil ④yab thogs te g.yob par byed do//ji tsam na khyim bdag des de na gnas mal bzang po dag bshams shing kha zas bsod pa'i spyi bungs bshams pa mthong nas des bsams pa/ 'di dag gi chos ni bzang na 'di ltar 'di dag la skyon yang yod de/ 'di dag la rje sa dang gus pa med de/ rgan pa rgan pa dag las byed du 'jug go snyam nas de skad smras pa dang / drug sde dag gis thos nas de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag ci zer/ 'phags pa khyed cag gi chos ni bzang na ⑤'di ltar khyed cag la skyon 1—218

yang mchis so/ /khyim bdag kho bo cag la skyon ci yod/ des smras pa/'phags pa dag ①khyed cag la rje sa dang gus pa ma mchis te/ rgan pa rgan pa dag las bgyid du stsol to/ /rgan pa dag la yang las byed du gzhug dgos ②pa yod do/ /'phags pa dag khyed kyi nang du nga charab tu phyung na ④yang las bgyid du stsol tam/ de dag gis smras pa/ khyod pas gang ches khyad par du 'phags pa rab tu phyung na yang de yang nged kyis ⑤las byed du gzhug na khyod lta ci smos/des bsams pa/ gal te bdag 'di dag gi nang du rab tu byung na bdag kyang 'di dag gis ༅las byed du bcug ⑦par 'gyur gyis/ thabs kyi rnam pa zhig bya'o snyam mo/ /khyim bdag de mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas des dge slong dag gi gan nas kun du spyod pa'i chos dag bslabs sos/ /bslabs nas mtha' 'khob cig tu song ste skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig dag bgos ⑨te 'dug pa dang / ji tsam na dge slong mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba dag phyogs de nas 'ong zhing 'gro bar byed pa de dag gis de mthong nas smras pa/ gnas brtan mnyan yod na chos kyi rje mngon sum du bzhugs shing de na dus dang ⑩dus su lha'i gzugs dag kyang snang / snang ba rgya chen po dag kyang 'byung / lha'i sgra dag kyang grag⑩ /kun shes pa brda cosprod pa dag kyang grag /longs spyod gnyis po zang zing gi longs spyod dang / chos kyi longs spyod kyang yod na ci'i phyir mnyan yod du mi 'gro/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di nyid du 'dug par bya'o/ /de dag gis de la yang dang yang du smras pa/ gnas brtan mnyan yod na chos kyi rje mngon sum du bzhugs shing de na dus dang dus su lha'i gzugs dag kyang snang / snang ba tsochen po dag kyang 'byung / lha'i sgra dag 1—219

kyang grag /kun shes pa brda ①sprod pa dag kyang grag /longs spyod gnyis po zang zing gi longs spyod dang / chos kyi longs spyod dag kyang yod na ci'i phyir mnyan yod du mi 'gro/ de tshangs pa ②mtshungs par spyod pa dag gis dus bskyed pa na mnyan yod du song ngo / /ji tsam na des de na gnas mal bzang po bshams shing kha zas bsod pa'i spyi bungs bshams pa mthong nas des bsams pa/gal te bdag gral gyi dang por 'dug na ni yon bshad pa ②bya dgos par ④'gyur ro snyam nas des stan gegacig bor nas stan yiganyis pa la 'dug go/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇ+ḍi ༅rgya 'ongs nas des bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag snam sbyar gyi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba rnams kyi mchog tu bstan na 'di su zhig yin snyam mo/ /ji tsam na bsams pa dang rku thabs su gnas pa zhig yin par mthong nas des de se gol gyi sgras bskrad ⑧do/ /tshe dang ldan pa rta ⑨thul dang / bzang ldan dang / rlangs pa dang / ming chen dang /grags pa dang / gang po dang / dri med dang / ba lang bdag dang /lag bzangs bodang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan 0thams cad kyis kyang se gol gyi sgras bskrad 8do/ /ji tsam na drug sde dag gi gan du song ba dang de dag gis de la smras pa/ gnas brtan khyod lo du lon/ des na tshod kyi dbang du byas te kho bo lo drug bcu lon no zhes smras pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis kyang lo drug bcu ma bzhes na 'dis ga la lon / de dag gis de la smras pa/ rgan zhugs khyod kyi mkhan po gang yin/des smras pa/ dge sbyong gi ta ma'i mkhan po gang yin/ de dag gis smras pa/1—220

tshe dang ldan pa dag ①rgan zhugs 'di ni rang gis rtags blangs pa yin no zhes de dag gis de lag pa dang rkang pa dag ②nas bzung ste rgan pa'i mthar khrid nas smras pa/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ③du gsol/ 'jig rten na rang byung ④gcig ni bcom ldan 'das lags na gnyis pa ni rgan zhugs 'di lags so//'di ni gsol ba'o zhes smras nas rgan pa'i mtha' nas bskrad do/ /de nas ⑤bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gang zag rku thabs su gnas pa ni chos 'dul ba 'di la mi skye ba'i chos can yin pas/dge slong dag khyed kyis gang zag rku thabs su gnas pa chos 'dul ba 'di las bsnyil bar bya'o/ /'ga' zhig gi gan du rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa 'ongs na/des de la ⑥ku thabs su gnas pa ma cayin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par ⑦rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal ④tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑨'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gang zag rku thabs su gnas pa bsnyil bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis na gang zag rku thabs su gnas pa lags/nye ba 0'khor gang tshun chad yinas dge slong rang bzhin du gnas pa dag dang lhan cig tsogaso sbyong gi tsolas dag lan gnyis sam gsum du 8nyams su myong bar gyur na de tsam gyis na gang zag rku thabs su gnas pa yin no// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na bram ze zhig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig rtse ④bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur tshuspyod par byed do/ /rtse bar byed/ dga' 1—221

bar byed/ dga' mgur ①spyod par byed pa de'i chung ma la sems can zhugs par gyur to/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das te btsas pa las ma ning skyes pa 'dra ba bud med kyang ma yin skyes pa yang ma yin pa zhig byung nas bsrings shing bskyed de che bar ⑤gyur to/ /de khye'u dag dang lhan cig rtse bar byed pa na de ③de dag la mtshan ma ston par byed nas de dag gis de la smras pa/ khyod ci yin/des smras pa/ bdag ma ning ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ khyod ni bram ze yin pas khyod kyi khyim du mi snyan pa ④gags par gyur na mi rung gis de lta ⑤ma byed cig /de dag gis de'i pha ma la smras pa/ khyod kyis zhum ning 'di 'di lta ⑦'di lta byed kyis zlog shig /de dag gis de la smras pa/ ma ning dubadag cag ni bram ze ⑨yin pas bdag cag n+tu gi khyim du mi snyan par tsho/nyegrags par gyur na mi rung gis de lta com byed cig /de de dag gis bzlog 8kyang mi 'dug go/ /de dus gzhan zhig na rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang / ji tsam na des dge slong gzhon nu gzhon nu dag mthong nas des bsams pa/ bdag 'di dag gi nang du rab tu byung cin 'di dag bdag la skyes pa'i bya ba byed par 'gyur zhing bdag kyang 'di dag la bud med kyi bya ba byed par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de ⑫dge slong gi gan du song ste smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal lo/ /des de la smras pa/ khyod pha mas gnang ngam/ des smras pa/ma gnang ngo / /song la pha ma la gsol cig /de pha ma'i gan du song ste smras pa/yab yum bdag rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal lo/ /de gnyis des yongs su gdungs pas bsams pa/ bdag cag 'di dang bral bar byas rab tu 'byung la rag go snyam nas/ de gnyis kyis de la smras pa/ ma ning gnang ngo / /de ⑩1—222

dge slong gi nang ①du song ste smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag pha mas gnang gis rab tu dbyung ②du gsol/ des de rab tu phyung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par byas pa dang / dge slong rnams kyi mdun du mtshan ma ston par byed nas/ de dag gis de la smras pa/ khyod ma ning yin nam ci/ des smras pa/ yin no ③zhes zer ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang /de na ④bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gang zag ma ning ni chos 'dul ba 'di la mi skye ba'i chos can yin pas/dge slong dag khyed ⑤kyis gang zag ma ning yochos 'dul ba 'di las ⑦bsnyil bar bya'o / /'ga' zhig gi gan du rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa 'ongs na/ des de la ma ning ma yin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag ma ning ni lnga po 'di dag yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ skyes nas ma ning dang / zla ba phyed 2pa'i ma ning dang / 'khyud nas ldang ba'i ma ning dang / phrag dog can gyi ma ning dang /nyams pa'i ma ning ngo / /de la skyes nas ma ning gang zhe na/ gang skyes nas bud med kyang ma yin skyes pa yang ma yin pa'o/ /zla ba phyed pa'i ma ning gang ⑨zhe na/ gang zla ba phyed ni bud med zla ba phyed ni skyes par 'gyur ba'o/ /'khyud nas ldang ba'i ma ning gang zhe na/ gang la gzhan dag gis 'khyud na ⑨ dbang po 'byung bar 'gyur ba'o4〉/ /phrag dog can gyi ma ning gang zhe na/gang la gzhan dag rtsol cib mthong na dbang po 'byung bar 'gyur ba'os/ /nyams pa'i ma ning gang zhe na/ gang gi dbang po nad kyis nyams pa'am mtshon gyis bcad pa'o/ /de la ma ning snga ma bzhi po skyes nas ma ning dang / zla ba 1—223

phyed pa'i ma ning dang / 'khyud nas ldang ba'i ma ning dang / phrag dog can gyi ma ning gang dag yin pa de dag ni rab tu ma byung na ni ①rab tu dbyung ②bar mi bya la/ rab tu byung na ni bsnyil bar bya'o/ / de la nyams pa'i ②ma ning gang yin pa de ni rab tu ma byung na ni rab tu dbyung bar mi bya la/ rab tu byung na ni gal te 'gyur ba mi sten na btang snyoms su bya'o/ /gal te 'gyur ba bsten ④na bsnyil bar bya'o// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /klu rnams kyi kun du spyod pa ni lus la nyin mo bye ⑤ma me'i mdog lta bu lan gsum 'bab cing des de dag rus pa'i keng rus tsam zhig lus par byed do/ /klu gzhon nu skyes nas ring po ma lon pa zhig gi ༅lus la nyin mo bye ma me'i mdog lta bu lan gsum 'bab ⑦cing des de rus pa'i keng rus tsam zhig lus par byas pa dang des ma la smras pa/ma bdag gis yun ji srid cig tu sdug bsngal 'di lta bu mnag dupar bgyi 'tshal/bu ji srid du ⑨ris mthun pa yod kyi bar du'o/ /de na 7klu rdzu 'phrul che ba dang mthu che ba gzhan gang dag yin pa de dag gi lus la bye ma me'i mdog 0lta bu mi 'bab cinas des smras pa/ ma 'di dag la ci'i phyir mi 'bab/ mas smras pa/'di dag ni rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che ba/ bskal par gnas pa/ sa 'dzin pa / 'dab 'chags kyi rgyal po 'dab bzangs kyis ④dbyung bar mi nus pa yin pas de'i phyir 'di dag la mi 'bab bo/ /de na klu phra mo gzhan gang dag yin pa de dag gi lus la 4)bye ma me'i mdog lta bu mi 'bab nas des smras pa/ma 'di dag la ni rigs na 'di dag la ci'i phyir mi 'bab/ mas smras pa/1—224

'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi dag blangs pas de'i phyir 'di dag la mi 'bab bo/ /des smras pa/ gal te de lta na bdag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi dag blang ngo / /mas smras pa/ bu tshe gcig gi sdug bsngal ni bla'i tshe rabs mang po'i ①ni ma yin te/ gal te khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi ②dag blangs nas yang dag par ma bsrungs ②na yun ring por sems can dmyal bar sdug bsngal mnag ④par bya dgos so/ / des bsams pa/ sdug ⑤bsngal 'di bas ches sdug ༅bsngal bar 'gyur ba ci ༅zhig yod kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi dag len du 'gro'o snyam dunas/ de ⑨bram ze'i cha lugs su mngon par sprul nas rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ba dang /ji tsam na des dge slong dag bsam gtan dang / klog pa skyedang / rnal 'byor dang / yid la byed pa la skyebartson zhing gnas pa mthong ngo mthong nas kyang dad pa skyes te/ des bsams pa/ ji je dang por skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi dag blang ngam/ 'on te rab tu 'byung bar bya snyam mo/ /des 8yang bsams pa/ rab tu 'byung bar bya'o snyam nas de dge slong 8gi gan du song ste ⑩smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal lo/ /des smras pa/ kho bo ni gsar bu yin 8pas yiganas brtan gzhan 'ga' zhig gi drung du song shigaci /des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis gzhan ngo 'tshal ba ma mchis te/ 'di ltar bdag thog mar tsokho nar 'phags pa'i gan du mchis pas khyod nyid ⑩kyis bdag dge slong 'ga' zhig la gtad par gsol/ dge slong 1—225

de'i mkhan po dgon pa pa zhig dgon pa na ①'dug pas des de khrid de de'i gan du song nas smras pa/ mkhan po rigs kyi bu 'di rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal gyis rab tu dbyung du gsol/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag gshan ②pa byed du bcug ①pa ni bla'i ④rab tu phyung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par byas nas yal bar bor ba ni mi rung ngo zhes bka' stsal pas/'di yang sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur la/ kho bo yang ltung ba dang bcas par 'gyur bas kho bo 'di rab tu mi 'byin to/ /des smras pas/mkhan pos rab tu dbyung ba yi'aba' zhig mdzod ⑦cig dang / bdag gis 'di bslab par bgyi zhing klog tu stsal bar bgyi'o/ /des dude rab tu phyung 0zhing bsnyen tsobar rdzogs par byas nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs 'di nyid khyod kyi mkhan po gcig pa yin/ 'di nyid slob dpon yin gyis khyod kyis 'di nyid la dri yibar bya/ khyod kyis 'di nyid la bklag 8par bya'o8/ /khyod kyis 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o/ /des gcig las 'phros pa'i lung bklags ④pas des de gcig tsolas 'phros pa'i lung klog tu gzhug par brtsams pa dang / des ⑩shin tu brtson 'grus brtsams pas kha ton ⑩du lhogs nas dge slong slob dpon de shin tu mig gang ste des de la smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ci lhan cig tu bsod snyoms la 'jug par bya'amatho)/ 'on te so sor4)/ des () bsams pa/bdag gis mi'i zas kyis 'tsho bar mi nus kyis/ bdag klu'i gnas su song la bdud rtsi zos shing ( 〉zos shing phyir 'ong bar bya'o snyam nas/ des smras pa/slob dpon so sor 'jug par bya'o 3/ /des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs de ltar gyis shig /de klu'i gnas su lha'i bdud rtsi zos nas phyir 'ong ngo /klu 1—226

rnams ni gnyid che ba yin pas cade gang gi tshe gnyid log nas langs pa de'i tshe na dge slong de bsod snyoms blangs nas phyir 'ong ngo / /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na dge slong des bsod snyoms glo ①bur ba rnyed snonas des de blangs te phyir 'ongs pa chadang / ji tsam na ④gnas khang na mgar ⑤ba'i sbud pa 'bud pa lta bu'i sgra thos nas des gtan ⑥pa'i bu ga nas bltas ⑦na/ gnas khang de thams cad klu'i lus bskyil bas gang ba mthong nas des sprul pa sprul pa zhes sgra phyung ba dang /de sgra la mkhas pas myur ba myur ba kho nar sad nas ⑧rang bzhin gyi ⑨cha lugs mi snang bar byas te de sprul pa'i cha lugs su 'dug go/ /dge slong dag ⑩lhags nas de dag gis de la smras pa/ 'di ci yin/ des smras pa/ sprul pa yin no/ /de dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa brtson 'grus brtsams pas rtag tu kha ton la brtson pa yin na 7ci khyod 'di la ser sna byed dam/ des smras pa/ kho bo ni 'di la cung zad kyang ser sna mi byed de 8/ 'di ltar 'di ni sprul pa yin no//de dag phan tshun smra ba na bcom ldan 'das kyang phyogs der gshegs nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ci yin/ dge slong dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sprul pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ⑫stsal pa/ dge slong dag gang zag sprul pa ni chos 'dul ba 'di la mi skye ba'i chos can yin pas/ dge slong dag khyed thostekyis gang zag sprul pa chos 'dul ba 'di las bsnyil bar bya'o/ /'ga' zhig gi gan du rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa 'ongs na/ des de la sprul pa ma yin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag klu'i rang bzhin lnga po 'di dag yin la lhag ma ni sprul pa yin no/ /lnga gang ⑫1—227

zhe na/ rang bzhin gyis skye ba chodang / rang bzhin gyis 'chi ba dang / rang bzhin gyis nyal ba dang / rang bzhin gyis za ba chodang / rang bzhin gyis mi tshangs par spyod pa du )'khrig pa'i chos sten ④par byed pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 3bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs khyod kyis phung po 'di dag gis yon tan gyi 6tshogs 'ga' yang thob par mi nus kyis/ dge slong rnams la ma 'tshe bar song shig /des bsams pa/ 'babs 3par ga la bya snyam nas des sā 8la'i dgon pa zhig tu song nas gtsug lag khang rta babs mthon po dang ldan pa/ mthongs nyukhung dang / skar khung dra ba can dang / lan tshikan gyis brgyan pa/ snying dang mig 'phrog par byed pa/ mtho ris kyi them skas su/ gyur pa/ khri dang / khri'u dang / yo byad phun sum tshogs pa zhig sprul te/dge slo/nga glo bur du 'ongs pa dang / 'gro bar chas pa rnams la yo byad thams/ cad kyis sto bas par byed do/ /rgan zhugs shig gtsug lag khang der dbyar gnas nas mnyan yod du song ngo / /drug sde dag gi ci kun du spyod pa ni 'dir bdag cag gis bram ze dang khyim/ bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa rnams/ la yang chos bstan par bya/ rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad nga/ra bya/ rang gi grags/ pa yang bsgrag par bya'o/ /snyam pas drug sde dag las gang yang rung bas rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo stong par mi 'jog pas/ nye dga' nang par sngar langs te so shing bor nas snam sbya ra dmar ser gyon te rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug go/ /des thag ring po kho na zhu nas rgan zhugs mgo spra ba'i me tog ltar skya ba smin ma 'phyang ba zhig 'ong ba de mthong nas des bsams pa/ 'di ni dge slong gnas brtan 5'ga' zhig yin gor ma chag snyam nas des bsu ste gnas brtan byon pa 1—228

legs so byon pa legs so zhes byas pa dang des smras pa/ slob dpon phyag 'tshal lo / /nye dga'as ①bsams pa/ kye ma 'di ni rgan zhugs zhig stel/ slob dpon yang mi shes/ mkhan po yang mi shes so ④snyam nas des de la smras pa/rgan zhugs khyod ga las 'ongs/ sā thula'i dgon pa nas so/ /ci de na ⑤gtsug ⑥lag khang yod dam/ des smras pa/ gtsug lag khang yod do/ /ci de gtsug lag khang yin nam/ 'on te phongs ⑦pa yin/ gtsug lag khang ni ci 'dra / phongs pa ni ci 'dra/ gang na yo byad ⑤thams cad dang ldan pa ni gtsug lag khang yin la/ gang na yo byad thams cad dang bral ba ni phongs ⑨pa yin no/ /de gtsug lag khang yin no/ /de na ci yod/ de na dge slong zhal ta byed pa gnas te/ des dge slong glo 7bur du 'ongs pa dang 'gro bar chas pa rnams la yo byad thams cad kyis stobs par byed do/ /drug sde dag gi yikun du spyod pa ni gang cung zad ci thos pa de phye 'bred 8kyi dus kyi tshe gcig tu 'dus ⑫nas phan tshun rjod ④par byed pa yin pas nye dga' gtsug lag khang du song ste drug sde dag la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa bdag cag gis yun ji srid kyis brel ba spang bar bya/ khyod kyis thos pa cung zhig yod dam/ nye dga'as byasmras pa/yod de/ sā phyala'i dgon pa na gtsug lag khang yod do/ /de na ci yod/ de na zhal ta ༅byed pa gnas te/ des dge slong glo 8bur du 'ongs pa dang 'gro bar chas pa rnams la yo byad thams cad kyis stobs par byed kyis7/ tshur shog bdag cag der 'dong ngo / /de dag der dong ba ⑥ dang / des de dag thag ring po kho na nas 'ong ba mthong yinas des bsams pa/ gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa de dag 'dir 'ongs so snyam mo/ /des yang bsams pa/1—229

bdag gis 'di dag la yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs ①na/ 'di dag gis bdag la ci byar yod snyam nas/ des de dag la rgan rims ②kyis gnas mal yang tog dudang / khang pa brtsegs pa dag bskos ④shing yo byad thams cad kyis kyang bstabs so/ /de dag nyi ma nyung shas shig 'khod ⑤nas smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' rgan zhugs 'di la 'du ba yang mi snang 'god pa yang mi snang bas bdag cag gis 'di la grangs dag 'debs su gzhug yigo zhes de dag gis de la smras pa/ rgan zhugs khyod la 'du ba yang mi snang / 'god pa yang mi snang bas tshur shog grangs thob shig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag cung zad nyams pa'am gcig tu ma gyur tam/ de dag gis smras ⑦pa/ cung zad kyang nyams par ma gyur te tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis drug sde dag gtsug lag khang de ④nyid du dbyar gnas na ⑨de dag gis 'du ba yang mi shes/'god pa yang mi shes so zhes bdag cag smad par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/gnas brtan dag gal te de lta na bgyi'o/ /ji tsam na bya/ lo bcu gnyis ⑩na'o / /de dag gis smras pa/ rgan zhugs lo bcu gnyis na khyod kyis gtsug lag khang 'di sgo 'phar yang zos par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ lo bdun na'o / /de dag gis smras pa/ mi rung ngo / /des smras pa/ zla ba bdun na'o / /de dag gis smras pa/ mi rung ngo / /des smras pa/ nyin zhag bdun na'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' nyin zhag bdun gyis rgan zhugs 'dis ci zhig zos par gyur te de bzhin bya'o/ /de dag gis de la smras pa/ rgan zhugs de bzhin gyis shig /des bsams pa/ zhag bdun lon na gtsug lag khang 'di mi snang bar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ des de nas ⑪1—230

tshangs pa mtshungs par ①spyod pa des pa des pa rnams la la la la ni snam sbyar 'bul ②bar byed/ la la la ni bla gos/ la la la ni sham thabs/ la la la ni rngul zan①/ la la la ni lhung bzed/ la la la ni lhung bzed chung ngu 'bul bar byed do/ /drug sde dag gis de mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' rgan bzhugs 'di phyogs tshol gyis ⑤thag bdun 'das nas phyogs dang bcas nas rtsa nas gdon to/ /des kyang zhag bdun 'das nas de dag nyal ba dang gtsug lag khang de mi snang bar byas nas rgya mtsho'i 'gram ༅du song ngo /de dag kyang sa sgre bo la nyal zhing 'khod nas smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' longs la rdo rgyus long shig dang grangs ༅'debs su gzhug go/ /de dag gis ji tsam na bdag cag sa sgre bo la nyal bar mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad pa/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa byed pa zhig bdag cag gis tho btsams ⑧nas gtsug lag khang mi snang bar byas te song ba de lha'amakhya/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ su yin zhes zer ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong zhal ta byed pa de ni sprul pa gang yin pa de nyid yin te/ gal te dge slong drug sde dag gis tho btsams tho )par ma gyur na bstan pa mthar thug gi bar du sangs rgyas tsu〉dang /chos dang / dge 'dun dag la mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes yidamigs gang ci byung ba de ni dge slong dag gtsug lag khang gang na 'du 'god mi mngon pa 8der grangs 'debs su 'jug pa las gyur pa yin no ④snyam nas bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na 8gang na 'du ba ⑩1—231

yang mi mngon 'god pa yang mi mngon pa der yang ①dge slong gis grangs 'debs su gzhug par ②mi bya'o/ /gang na 'du ba ni mngon la 'god pa mi mngon pa der yang dge slong gis ①grangs 'debs su gzhug par mi bya'o/ /gang na 'god pa ni mngon la 'du ba mi mngon pa der yang dge slong gis grangs 'debs su gzhug par mi bya'o/ /gang na 'du ba dang 'god pa mngon pa der ni dge slong gis dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis tshod rig par bya'o// //'dul ba gzhi༅/ bam po dgu pa/ de'i 'og tu rgya mtsho'i 'gram du song ste gtsug lag khang rta babs mthon po dang ldan pa/ mthongs khung ༅dang skar khung dra ba can dang ldan pa⑥/ lan kun gyis brgyan pa/ snying dang mig 'phrog par byed pa/ mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa/ khri dang khri'u dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa gnyis pa zhig sprul te/ der rgya mtsho chen po'i klu dag bram ze dang / khyim bdag gi ⑦cha byad kyis mngon du lhags dunas de dag de la chos nyan par byed do/ /de dag gis de la chos thos nas dge slong glo 0bur du 'ongs pa dang 'gro bar chas pa rnams la yo byad thams cad kyis stobs par byed do / /rgan zhugs shig gtsug lag khang der dbyar gnas nas mnyan yod du song ngo / /drug sde dag gi 7kun du spyod pa ni 'dir bdag cag gis bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhags pa rnams la yang chos bstan par bya/ rgol ba dag kyang tshar gcad par bya/ rang gi grags pa yang bsgrag par bya'o snyam pas drug sde dag las gang yang rung bas ⑩rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo stong par mi 'jog pas nye dga' nang par sngar langs te so shing bor nas snam sbyar dmar ser gyon te rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi sgo na 'chag cing 'dug go/ /des thag ring po 1—232

kho na nas rgan zhugs mgo spra ba'i me tog ltar skya ba smin ma ①'phyang ba zhig 'ong ba de mthong nas des bsams pa/ 'di ni dge slong gnas brtan phya'aga' zhig yin gor ma chag snyam nas des de bsu ste gnas brtan byon pa legs so ri byon pa legs so zhes byas pa dang des smras pa/ slob dpon phyag 'tshal lo/ /nye dga'as ④bsams pa/ kye ma 'di ni rgan zhugs shig ste/ slob dpon yang mi shes mkhan po yang mi shes so snya ma nas/ des de la smras pa/ rgan zhugs khyod ga las 'ongs/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas so/ /ci de na gtsug lag khang yod dam/des smras pa/ gtsug lag khang yo da do/ /ci de gtsug lag khang yin nam/'on te phongs pa yin/ gtsug lag khang ni ci 'drag/ rdzongs nga/ ni ci 'dra/gang na dziyo byad tham/sa cad dang snye ldan nga/ ni gtsug lag khang yin la/ gang na yo byad thams/ cad dang bral ba de sdoni phongs 9pa yin no/ /de gtsug lag khang yin no/ /de na ci yod/ de na dge slong chos smra ba gnas/ te/ de de na bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams/ la chos/ ston 10par byed cing de dag gis de la 1 chos thos nas dge slong glo bur du 'ongs pa/ dang 'gro bar chas nga/ rnams/ la yo byad thams cad kyis stobs par byed do/ /drug sde dag gi kun du 2spyod pa/ ni gang cung zad ci thos pa 1 de phyi 'bred ci kyi dus/ kyi tshe gcig tu 'dus nas phan tshun rjod par byed pa yin pas nye dga' gtsug lag khang du song ste drug sde dag la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag gis yun ji srid kyis brel ba spang bar bya / khyod kyis thos pa cung zhig 0yod dam/ nye dga'as sasmras pa yod denyu /rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gtsug nyuphelag nyu9khang yod do/ /de na ci yod/ de na dge slong chos smra ba gnas te/ de de na bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams la chos ston par 1—233

byed cing de dag gis de las chos thos nas dge slong glo 7bur du 'ongs pa dang 'gro bar chas pa rnams la yo byad thams cad kyis stobs par byed kyis/tshur shog dubadag cag der 'dong ngo / /de dag der dong ba dang / des de dag thag ring po kho thun rtsonas 'ong ba semathong nas des bsams pa/ gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa de dag 'dir yang skyo'ongs so snyam mo/ /des yang bsams pa/ bdag 'di dag la cung zad kyang rag lus pa med na 'di dag gis bdag la ci byar yod snyam mo/ /de nas rgya mtsho chen po'i klu de dag bram ze dang khyim bdag gi cha lugs kyis mngon du lhags tsupa dang / des de dag la chos bstan duto/ /de dag gis de las 9chos thos nas dge slong glo bur du 'ongs pa dang 'gro bar chas pa rnams la yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs pa dang drug sde dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' rgan zhugs 'dis ci zhig shes/gcig las 'phros pa'o/ /'di ni re zhig rdzubs pas gcig las 'phros pa'i chos ston gyis yidage slong 'di dag ni sde snod gsum dang ldan pa/ chos sgrogs pa / rigs nyu pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa can sha stag yin na/ ci'i phyir 'di dag la gsol ba mi 'debs/ de dag gis de la smras pa/ rgan zhugs khyod kyis ci shes/ des smras pa/ gcig las 'phros pa'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/rgan zhugs khyod ni re zhig rdzubs pas gcig las 'phros pa'i nyu chos ston gyi/dge slong 'di dag ni sde snod gsum dang ldan pa/ chos sgrogs pa/ rigs (sripa dang grol ba'i spobs pa can sha stag yin na/ ci'i phyir 'di dag la gsol ba mi 'debs/ des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag 6bdag gis bzlog gam ci na khyed ci'i phyir chos mi ston/ de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' rgan zhugs 1—234

'di bdag cag dang mi mthun par byed kyis gnas nas dbyung ba'i las bya'o/ /des bsams pa/ gal te bdag ①la gnas nas dbyung ba'i las byas na klu'i ②gnas su yang skabs mi rnyed do snyam nas des ②de dag nyal ba dang gtsug lag khang de yang mi snang bar byas te rgya mtsho chen por zhugs so/ /de dag bye ma'i thang la nyal zhing 'khod 'khod nas smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' longs la seng ge'i khri shoms shig dang chos bstan par bya'o/ /de dag gis ji tsam na bdag cag bye ④ma'i thang la nyal ba mthong nas de dag gis smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par ⑤dad pa/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa byed pa zhig bdag cag gis tho btsams yinas gtsug lag khang mi snang bar byas te song ba de lha'am/ klu 'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ su yin zhes zer ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong chos smra ba de ni sprul pa gang yin pa de nyid yin te/ gal te dge slong drug sde dag gis tho btsams ⑦par ma gyur na bstan pa mthar thug gi bar du sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dag la mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/nyes dmigs gang ci byung ba de ni dge slong dag ma gsol bar chos ston par byed pa las gyur pa yin no snyam nas bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong gis ma gsol bar chos bstan par mi bya'o/ /dge slong ma gsol bar chos ston na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de'i ngor mgron ⑧du bos pa la ni ltung ba med do/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag sangs rgyas 'tsho zhes bya ba phyug pa nor mang ba longs spyod che ba zhig 'dug pa des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas de de dang 1—235

lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gdul ①ba la ltos pas de'i khyim du song ste/ des khyim bdag de chung ma dang bcas pa skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi ②dag la bzhag go/ /ji tsam na ①dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag de'i chung ma la sems can zhugs par gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus sems can de nges par skal ba dang ldan pa nyid du shes nas phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong med par de'i khyim du song ba dang khyim bdag des rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te smras pa④/ ci 'phags pa la phyeslad bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong ma mchis sam/ des smras pa/ khyim bdag ci kho bo'i phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong rtswa ka sha'i ༅byings sam/ ku sha'i byings nas 'byung bar 'gyur ram/ 'di ltar khyod lta bu dag las thob pa gang dag yin pa de dag kho bo'i phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong ༅du 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag sangs rgyas 'tshos smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gi mchis 'brang du'adi la sems can zhig zhugs par gyur gyis/ gal te bu pho zhig btsas par gyur na de bdag gis ⑨'phags pa'i slad bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong du 'bul 7lo/ /des smras pa / khyim bdag thabs yin no/ /de 7zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das pa dang khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ gsal btsu)/gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ mgo gdugs lta bu dang ldan pa/ lag pa ring btso/dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ smin ma 'jar bci/ sna'i gzangs tsomatho ba zhig btsas so/ /btsas nas de'i nye du dag 'dus shing lhags nas de nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu ⑩gcig tu btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas khye'u ⑩ming cir gdags 8zhes ming 'dogs par byed do༅/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ khye'u 1—236

'di sangs rgyas 'tsho'i ①bu yin pas khye'u'i ②ming dge 'dun 'tshor gdags ①so zhes de'i ming dge 'dun 'tsho ④zhes bya bar btags so/ /de dag gis ⑤khye'u dge 'dun 'tsho ༅'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang ⑦/mar gyi snying gu ⑧dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi bye brag gtso bo gtso bo dag gis sring bar byed/ skyed par byed cing rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin du myur du skyed par byed do/ /gang kho na'i nyin mo dge 'dun 'tsho btsas pa de kho na'i nyin mo tshong pa lnga brgya dag gi bu dag kyang btsas te/ de dag kyang rigs dang mthun pa'i ming dag btags 0so/ /gang gi tshe khye'u dge 'dun 'tsho chen por gyur pa de'i tshe na rkyi tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de rab tu dbyung ba'i dus shes nas gdul yib la ltos pas phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong med par gcig pu de'i khyim du song ba dang khyim bdag sangs rgyas 'tshos rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te stan bting ba dang tshe dang ldan pa shā 8ri'i bu 'dug go/ /'dug nas kyang khyim bdag sangs rgyas 'tsho la brda tsobya bar brtsams so/ /de nas khyim bdag sangs rgyas 'tshos dge 'dun 'tsho la smras pa/ bu cikho bos khyod ma'i rum na 'dug cing ma btsas pa nyid nas 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge 8sbyong du phul gyis khyod song la 'di la bsnyen bkur gyis ⑩shig /de sems can srid pa tha ma pa yin pas 'dzum ༅sngon du btang ste/ 'jigs pa med cing bzhin nyams pa med pa dang / dman pa med pas de ltar bgyi'o zhes khas blangs nas de tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i phyi bzhin phyi bzhin 8rjes su 'brang ngo /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de rab tu byung ⑩zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par byas nas kun du spyod pa'i chos dag bslabs te lung bzhi klog tu bcug ⑥ go/ /1—237

ji tsam ①dus gzhan zhig na/ tshong pa lnga brgya po dag gi bu lnga brgya po de ②dag gis phan tshun gros byas te rgya mtsho chen por 'dong ba'i zong sta ②gon byas nas rgya mtsho chen por 'phags pa dang / de dag 'di snyam ④sems te/ shes ldan dag rgya ⑤mtsho chen po ni 'jigs pa du mas kun du gang ba yin pas bdag cag gis gang bdag cag rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du dong ba rnams la chos ston par 'gyur ba'i 'phags pa 'ga' zhig gshegs su gsol na⑥/ des bdag cag bde legs su 'gyur snyam nas/ de dag gis ⑦dpyad par brtsams te smras pa/su gshegs su cigasol0/ gzhan dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho 0'di bdag cag gi ne'u ldangs lhan cig ⑩skyes pas rdul la lhan cig rtse rtse ba yin pas bdag cag gis 'di la gsol ba gdab 8par bya'o/ /de nas de dag de'i gan du song 8ste rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho ④bdag cag gi ne'u ldangs lhan cig skyes pas rdul la lhan cig rtse rtse ba lags te/ bdag cag ni rgya mtsho chen por 'phags na rgya mtsho chen po ni 'jigs pa du mas kun du gang ba lags pas 'phags pas bdag cag rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du mchis 8pa rnams la chos bstan na des bdag cag bde legs su 'gyur ba lags kyis/ de'i slad du 'phags pa bdag cag dang thabs cig ⑩rgya mtsho chen por gshegs par gsol/ des smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bo la rang dbang med kyis deng la mkhan po la zhus shig /de dag tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ga la ba der song ⑩ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa shā ri'i bu mkhyen par mdzod cig /'phags pa dge 1—238

'dun 'tsho 'di bdag cag gi ne'u ldangs lhan cig ②skyes pa sa rdul la lhan cig rtse rtse ba lags te/ bdag cag ni rgya mtsho chen por 'phags na rgya mtsho chen po ni 'jigs pa du mas kun du gang ba lags pas 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tshos bdag cag rgya mtsho ②chen po'i nang du mchis pa ①rnams la chos bstan na des bdag cag bde legs su 'gyur lags kyis/ de'i slad du 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho bdag cag dang thabs cig ④rgya mtsho chen por gtang ⑤bar gsol/des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyid la zhus shig dang kho bos yizlog par mi byed do/ /de dag bcom ldan 'das ga ⑦la ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi duzhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho 'di bdag cag gi ne'u ldangs lhan cig skyes pa sa rdul la lhan cig rtse rtse ba lags te/ bdag cag ni rgya mtsho chen por 'phags na rgya mtsho chen po ni 'jigs ⑨pa du mas kun du gang ba lags pas 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tshos bdag cag rgya mtsho chen por ⑩ mchis pa rnams la chos bstan yin des bdag cag bde legs su 'gyur ba 8lags kyisa'i/ de'i slad du 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho bdag cag dang thabs cig hustergya mtsho chen por gtang 8bar gsol / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ ci tshong pa 'di dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad yod dam/ 'on te med snyam na ⑩yod par gzigs so/ /su la rag lus snyam nas ⑩dge slong dge 'dun 'tsho la rag lus par gzigs nas/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho la bka' stsal pa/dge 'dun 'tsho khyod rgya mtsho chen por 'jug tu song la khyod kyis 'jigs pa dang 1—239

'jigs su rung ba dag bzod par gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tshos bcom ldan 'das la cang mi smra bar dang du blangs so/ /de nas tshong pa lnga brgya po de dag tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho dang lhan cig dge mtshan dang /bkra shis dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dag byas te/ shing rta dag dang /khur dag dang / spyad ①dag dang / gle ba dag dang / rnga mo dag dang /ba lang dag dang ②/ bong bu dag gis rgya mtsho chen por 'dong ba'i zong khyer te/rgya mtsho chen por 'phags nas mthar gyis grong dang / grong rdal snodang /yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i ④rdzo ⑤brang dang / tshong rdal dag tu rnam par rgyu ba na rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram ༅du phyin nas de dag gis lam gis ⑦dub pa bsal ④te / zong rnying pa ⑨lnga brgyas gru bo che bisbyar nas zho shas 'tsho ba lnga brgya 7po stobs par byed pa dang / sel bar byed pa dang / rkyal tsochen dang / gru pa dang / rlung yor thogs pa dag khrid de/ lan gsum dril bsgrags tsonas nor bsgrub ④pa'i phyir rgya mtsho chen por zhugs so/ /ji tsam na de dag rgya mtsho chen por dong ba dag gi gru bo che de klu rnams kyis bzung nas de dag zhi ba dang /chu lha dang / lus ngan dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams la rgya mtsho chen po 'di na lha'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ dri za'am / gang gnas pa de bdag cag la ci 'dod pa 0smra bar gyur cig ces gsol ba gdab par brtsams pa dang / de nas rgya mtsho chen po nas 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho nged la byin cig ces sgra phyung ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho ni bdag cag gi ne'u ldangs lhan cig skyes pa sa rdul la lhan cig rtse rtse ba/ bcom ldan 'das dang btsun pa shā ri'i bus bdag cag 1—240

la gnang ba yin pas bdag cag 'di dang lhan cig 'chi ba dang dus byed pa ni bla'i / 'di yongs su gtang bar ①ni mi bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tshos de dag la smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci zer/ de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa rgya mtsho chen po nas 'phags pa dge 'dun ②'tsho nged la byin cig ces ③sgra byung ④ngo / /des smras pa/ ci'i phyir mi sbyin/ de dag gis smras pa/'phags pa khyod ni bdag cag gi ne'u ldangs lhan cig skyes pa sa rdul la lhan cig rtse rtse ba/ bcom ldan 'das dang / btsun pa shā ri'i bus bdag cag la gnang ba ⑤lags pas bdag cag khyod dang thabs cig ༅'gum pa dang dus bgyid pa ni bla'i༅/ khyod yongs su gtang bar duni mi bgyi'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tshos bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la dge 'dun 'tsho khyod rgya mtsho chen por 'jug tu song la khyod kyis 'jigs pa dang 'jigs su rung ba dag bzod par gyis shig ces bka' stsal pa gang yin pa de ni 'di yin no snyam nas/ des lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te bdag nyid rgya mtsho chen por mchong spubar brtsams pa dang / de nas tshong pa de dag gis des de ltar brtsams pa mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho ci mdzad ci mdzad/de de dag de ltar bzlog bzhin du rgya mtsho chen por mchongs ⑩pa dang / de ma thag kho nar klu rnams kyis gru bo che de btang ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho yang klu rnams kyis khrid de klu'i gnas su zhugs so/ /de nas klu de rnams klu'i bu mo rnams dang lhan cig 'dzum pa sngon 7du btang ste ya mtshan skyes naso mig tshugs su lta zhing tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho mchod rten de tsodag la phyag 'tshal du gzhug 8par brtsams te smras pa/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho 'di ni 1—241

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi dri gtsang ①khang lags sol/ /'di ni gtsug tor can dang / thams cad skyob dang / 'khor ba 'jig dang / gser thub dang / 'od srung gi dri gtsang ②khang lags so/ /'di ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i dri gtsang ①khang lags so/ /des de dag dang lhan cig mchod rten dag la phyag 'tshal nas klu'i tshogs kyi gung la stan ④bshams pa nyid la 'dug go/ /de nas klu de rnams kyis thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba btab pa/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho lha dang mi rnams la ni bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo sde dang / ma mo rab tu gnas ⑤na/ bdag cag klu rnams ni mi khom par skyes/ log par ༅ltung ba'i lus dang ldan pas/ kye ma 'phags pas bdag cag la mdo sde'i mtha' rab tu gnas par mdzad du gsol/ des de ltar bya'o zhes khas blangs so/ /de nas sprul pa des klu gzhon nu gsum spro ba bskyed nas gcig gle smras pa/ re zhig khyod kyis ni yang dag par ldan pa lhogs shig /gnyis pa la smras pa/ khyod kyis ni bar ma lhogs shig /gsum pa la smras pa④/ khyod kyis ni ring po dulhogs shig /kho bos 0kyang gcig las ⑩'phros pa'i lung brjod 7pa'i skabs de dag nyid la cigasal bar bya'o/ /de dag gis bklag 8par brtsams nas de na gcig ni mig btsums te ④lung nod par byed do/ /gnyis pa ni rgyab kyis phyogs te lung nod par byed do/ /gsum pa ni thag ring por 'dug ste lung nod par byed do/ /de dag gi nang nas sprul pa de nyid ni sngon gyi (smebag chags kyi khyad par gyis gus pa dang bcas pa dang /zhe sa dang bcas pa dang / 'phral gyi bya ba thams cad la thog mar 'gro ba yin pas de nang bar sngar langs te/ 'phags pa bzhengs la tshems shing 'or cig /1—242

bcom ldan 'das kyi ①dkyil 'khor dang mchod rten la phyag mdzod cig /bshos gsol cig /gzims 'amal shoms shig ces smra bar ②byed do/ /ji tsam na de thams cad kyis rim gyis lung rnams bklags ④pa dang / sprul pa des smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di dag gis lung rnams bklags ⑤na ci ⑥'dzin tam 'on te ⑦mi 'dzin/ des smras pa/ 'di dag dran pa dang ldan pas 'dzin par ni 'gyur na 'di ltar 'di dag la nyes pa yod do/ /des smras pa/'phags pa nongs pa ci mchis/ 'di dag thams cad gus pa med pa dang zhe sa med pa yin te/ re zhig gcig ni mig btsums te lung nod par byed/gnyis pa ni rgyab kyis phyogs te lung nod par byed/ gsum pa ni thag ring por ⑧'dug ste 0lung nod par byed do/ /khyod 'ba' zhig gus pa dang bcas pa dang / zhe sa chadang bcas pa dang 'phral gyi bya ba thams cad la thog mar 'gro 7ba yin no//des smras pa/ 'phags pa de dag ni gus pa ma mchis pa dang / zhe sa ma mchis pa ma lags te/ re zhig mig btsums te lung nod pa gang lags pa ni mig gdug pa lags so/ /rgyab kyis phyogs te lung nod pa gang lags pa skyoni dbugs gdug 8pa lags so/ /thag ring cipor mchis te lung nod 8pa gang lags pa de ni reg pa gdug pa lags so/ /bdag gcig pu ni mche ba gdug pa lags so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho skrag tsonas bsams pa/bdag kho bo 0dgra bo rnams kyi nang na tso'adug pa lta snyam nas/ de skya bo bseng bseng tsopo/ rid pa dang / nyam chung ba 0 dang / rke ba dang skam pa dang lus ma thob par gyur to/ /klu sprul pas smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod ci'i slad du skya bo bseng bseng 6〉po/ /rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang / rke ba dang /1—243

skam pa dang / lus ma thob par gyur/ des smras pa/ kho bo ni dgra bo ①rnams kyi nang na 'dug ste gang gi tshe khyed cag las gang yang rung ba zhig 'khrugs par gyur pa de'i tshe na kho bo ming tsam zhig lus par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/bdag cag 'phags pa la gnod pa ri mi bgyid de/ 'di ltar 'phags pa slar 'dzam bu'i ri gling du gshegs pa zhed sadam ci/ des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs kho bo 'di na dga' ba med pas 'gro 'dod do/ /de nas klu de rnams kyis phan tshun gros byas te/ gang gi tshe gru bo che de phyogs der 'ongs pa de'i tshe na 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho bteg ste gru bo che'i nang du bzhag go/ /de nas tshong pa de dag 'dzum pa sngon du btang ste ya mtshan skyes nas mig tshugs su lta zhing smras pa/ 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho byon pa legs so/ /byon pa legs so des smras pa/ shes ldan dag kho bos ni 5klu'i gnas su klu rnams la lung bzhi po dag rab tu gnas pa ra byas kyis rjes su yi rang bar 6gyis shig /de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa 'di lta ste/ gzhan la phan 'dogs pa 'di geni ston pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung bas bgyi ba lags te rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas tshong pa de dag tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho dang lhan cig tshogs shing kun dga' bzhin du mthar gyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram du phyin to/ /ji tsam na thams cad ngal zhing dub pas gnyid log pa tsun tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho yang rgya mtsho chen po la blta bar brtsams so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag lnga po 'di dag ni blta 0bas chog mi shes shing mthong na mi mthun pa med pa yin te/lnga gang zhe na/ dge slong dag glang po che cang shes gzhon sha can dang /'khor los nyunyesgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / rgya mtsho dug can pa dang / ri'i rgyal 81—244

rgyal po ri rab dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni blta ①bas chog mi shes shing mthong na mi mthun pa med pa yin no zhes gsungs pas/ de yun ring du rgya mtsho chen po la lta ba na dub pas tho rangs gnyid stug pos non to/ /de nas tshong pa de dag khal dag bkal te 'phags nas mtshan mo nam nangs ②pa na tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho mi snang ①nas / de dag brtad ④cing shes ldan dag 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho ga re zhes phan tshun du blta bar brtsams pa dang / de na kha cig na re mdun du song ngo zhes zer ro/ /kha cig phyen re phyi bzhin 'ong ngo zhes zer ro/ /kha cig na re dbus nas 'gro'o zhes zer ro/ /de dag rnam pa thams cad du kun du tshol ba na yi chad par gyur cing ma mthong ngo / /de nas de dag bzhin nyams shing dman par gyur te smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag cag gis 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho bor ba ma legs pa ⑥byas kyis phyir ldog par bya'o/ /yang bsams pa / 'phags pa dge 'dun 'tsho ni rdzu 'phrul che ba mthu che ba yin pas 'di ltar rgya mtsho chen por yang dus la ma bab na de da lta ⑦skam la phyin na dus la bab par ga la 'gyur/ de ni rdzu 'phrul che ba mthu che ba yin pas de ches sngon du song ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod do snyam nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag tshur sheg ⑧'dong zhes de dag 'phags so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho yang bye ma'i thang stong pa la nyi ma 'char ba'i ༅dus kyi tshe nyi ma'i 'od zer dag gis phog nas sad pa dang / ji tsam na ci yang mi snang nas des bsams pa/ tshong pa de ⑫dag ni dong na da ji ltar bya/ gar bab bab tu 'gro'o 0snyam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa de snying stobs che bas song ba dang lam mi snang nas des phan tshun btsal 1—245

nas lam srang zhig mthong nas ①de der zhugs pa dang / ji tsam na sa ②la'i dgon pa zhig na gtsug lag khang rta babs mthon po dang ldan pa/ mthongs ①khung dang / skar khung dra ba can dang / lan kun ④gyis brgyan pa/ snying dang mig 'phrog par byed pa/ mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa/ khri dang khri'u dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba / rdzing bu dang mtshe'us nye bar mdzes par byas pa⑤/ ngang pa dang /khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tsho yidang / ri skegs dang / khu byug mngon par sgra ༅'byin pa/ lha'i gnas ltar dpal gyis 'bar ba zhig dang /de na dge slong legs par bgos shing legs par sbyangs pa/ spyod lam zhi bas gnas pa dag mthong nas gus pa dang bcas pas de dag gi gan du song ngo / /de nas de dag gus par sgrim pa dang bcas pas de la smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho byon pa legs so byon pa legs so khyod da gzod ⑧ga las byon/des ji ltar gyur pa thams cad brjod pa dang / de nas de dag gis ngal sor bcug ⑨ste/ lam gyi dub pa bsal bonas gtsug lag khang du khrid do/ /ji tsam na stan tsu〉bzang po bshams pa dang / kha zas bsod pa'i spyi bungs (smebashams pa mthong nas de dag gis de la smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho mi skyems sam/ mi sbrebs tsosam/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag skom mo/ /bkres ④so/ /de dag gis smras pa8/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho gsol cigatso/des smras pa/ dge 'dun gyi nang du bza'o/ /de dag gis tu)smras pa/btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho khyod shul gyis dub pa lags kyis da gsol cigatso /slad kyis 'dir nyes dmigs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / des nyes dmigs 1wa 246

mthong bas ⑤zos nas mtha' gcig tu song ste 'dug go/ /ji tsam na de dag dro la bab ste/ gaṇ+ḍi ②brdungs pa na rang rang gi lhung bzed thogs te gral rims ①bzhin 'khod do/ /de dag 'khod pa dang gtsug lag khang de yang mi snang bar gyur cing de dag gi rang rang gi lhung bzed kyang lcags kyi tho ba rnam pa sna tshogs su gyur to/ /de nas de dag ji srid du dro ma yol gyi bar du lcags kyi tho ba de dag gis phan tshun glad ④pa bcom nas de dag glud ⑤pa zhom zhing sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyen nas yinyam thag pa'i skad 'byin to/ /ji tsam na dro yol ba dang gtsug lag khang de yang de kho na bzhin du phyir byung zhing dge slong de dag kyang de kho na bzhin du spyod lam zhi bas gnas so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho de dag gi gan du song ste dris pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed su yin/las gang gis 'dir skyes/ de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho 'dzam bu'i ༅gling pa'i mi rnams ni yid ches par dka' ⑧bas khyed yid ches par mi 'gyur ro/ /des ⑨smras pa/ kho bos mngon ༅sum kho nar mthong na ci'i phyir yid ches par mi 'gyur/ de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho bdag cag ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od sung gi 0nyan thos su gyur te/ ji tsam na bdag cag gis 8zan gyi gral du 'thab tsomo bgyis pas las de'i rnam par smin ④pas bdag cag nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa dag sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ba gang lags pa de lta bu'i gnas kyang mchis par 'gyur ro(nye/ /btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho de'i slad du 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs nas tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di lta 1—247

ste / dper na 'od srung ①gi dge slong khyadag ltar zan gyi gral du thab dumo ma byed cig /sdug rngubasngal gyi tshogs de lta bu'i skal ba can du 'gyur bar ma byed cig ces don 'di rgya cher brjod na legs so/ /des de ltar bya'o zhes khas blangs te 3song ngo / /ji tsam na de kho na bzhin du sa byula'i dgon pa zhig na gtsug lag khang gnyis pa rta rtsobabs mthon po dang ldan pa/ mthongs 3khung dang / skar khung dra ba can dang / lan kun gyis brgyan pa/ snying dang mig 'phrog par byed pa/ mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa/ khri dang khri'u dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba/rdzing bu dang mtshe'us nye bar mdzes par byas pa/ ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dag mngon par sgra 'byin pa/ lha'i gnas ltar dpal gyis 'bar ba zhig dang / de na dge slong legs par bgos shing legs par sbyangs pa/ spyod lam zhi bas gnas pa dag mthong nas gus pa dang bcas pas de dag ‘ gi gan du song ngo / /de nas de dag gis 7gus pa dang sgrim pa dang bcas pas de la 1 smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho byon pa legs so byon pa legs so/ /khyod da gzod ga las byon / des ji ltar gyur pa thams cad brjod pa dang / de nas de dag gis ngal sor bcug n+ya ste/ lam gyis 6dub pa bsal sanas gtsug lag khang du khrid do / /ji tsam na stan bzang po bshams skyepa dang / kha zas bsod tshapa'i spyi bungs bshams pa dag mthong nas de dag gis de la smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho mi skyems sam/ mi sbrebs skyesam/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag skom rtsamo/ /bkres du so/ /de dag gis smras pa/ btsun byupa dge 'dun 1—248

'tsho gsol cig /des smras pa/ dge 'dun gyi nang nyudu bza'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho khyod shul gyis mnyel 3snab lags kyis da zhugasol cig④ /slad kyis 'dir nyes dmigs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des nyes dmigs mthong bas zos nas mtha' gcig tu song ste 'dug go/ /ji tsam na de dag dro la bab ste gaṇ+ḍi brdungs pa na rang rang gi lhung bzed thogs te gral rims bzhin du 'khod do/ /de dag 'khod pa dang gtsug lag khang de yang mi snang bar gyur cing bza' ba dang btung ba de dag kyang lcags khu das tu gyur to/ /de nas de dag ji srid dro ma yol gyi bar du 3lcags khu de dag gis phan tshun gtor nas de dag lus tshig cing sdug bsngal gyi zhutshor bas nyen nas nyam gethag pa'i skad 'byin to/ /ji tsam na dro yol ba dang gtsug lag khang de yang de kho na bzhin du phyir byung zhing dge slong de dag kyang de kho na bzhin du spyod lam zhi bas gnas so/ /de nas tshe dang /ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho de dag gi gan du song ste dris pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed su yin/ las gang gis 'dir skyes/ de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho 'dzam bu'i tsugling pa'i mi rnams ni skuyid ches par dka' nyu1bas khyod yid ches par mi 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/kho bos mngon sum kho nar mthong na ci'i phyir yid ches par mi 'gyur/ de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho bdag cag ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi nyan thos su gyur te/ ji tsam na dge 'dun la snum bag gi rnyed pa byung zhing dge slong glo bur du 'ongs pa dag kyang lhags pa na/bdag cag ser snas skyoyongs su bzung ba dag gis ji srid du 15dge slong glo bur du 'ongs pa dag ma dong ba de srid du bza' bar mi bya'o zhes de ltar sems 1—249

bskyed cing tshig tu yang rjod ①la/ zhag bdun gyi bar du dus ma yin par ②yul ngan pa ①byung nas des bza' ba dang btung ba de dag rul cing ma rung bar gyur pa de ltar bgyis te/ bdag cag gis ④dad pas sbyin par bya ba chud gsan ⑤pas las de'i rnam par smin pas bdag cag nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos pa dag sems can dmyal ba chen po ༅rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ba gang lags pa de lta bu'i gnas kyang mchis par 'gyur ro/ /btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho de'i slad du 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs nas tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di lta ste/ dper na 'od srung gi dge sbyong dag ⑦ltar dad pas sbyin par bya ba chud ma gzon cig /sdug bsngal gyi tshogs de lta bu'i skal ba can du 'gyur bar ma byed cig duces don 'di rgya cher brjod na legs so/ /des ⑨de ltar bya'o zhes khas blangs yinas song ngo / /ji tsam na yang de kho na bzhin du sā yila'i dgon pa zhig na gtsug lag khang gsum pa rta babs mthon po dang ldan pa / mthongs 8khung dang / skar khung dra ba can dang / lan kun gyis brgyan 8pa/ snying dang mig 'phrog par byed pa/ mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa/ khri dang khri'u dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba/ rdzing bu dang mtshe'us nye bar mdzes par byas pa/ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ne tso dang / ri skegs dang /khu byug dag mngon par sgra 'byin pa/ lha'i gnas ltar dpal gyis 'bar ba zhig dang / de na dge slong legs par bgos shing legs par sbyangs pa/spyod lam zhi bas gnas pa dag mthong nas gus pa dang bcas pas de dag gi gan 1—250 ci

du song ngo / /de nas de dag gus pa dang ༅sgrim pa dang bcas pas de la smras pa/btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho byon pa legs so byon pa legs so/ /khyod da gzod ②ga las byon/ des ji ltar gyur pa thams cad brjod pa dang / de nas de dag gis changal sor bcug ste ④lam gyis ⑤dub pa bsal yinas gtsug lag khang du khrid do༅/ /ji tsam na stan bzang po bshams pa dang / kha zas bsod ⑧pa'i spyi bungs bshams pa dag mthong nas de dag gis de la smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho mi skyems sam/ mi sbrebs spusam/ des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag skom mo/ /bkres so/ /de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho gsol cig /des smras pa/ dge 'dun gyi nang du bza'o/ /de dag gis smras pa/ btsun pa dge 'dun 'tsho khyod shul gyis mnyel ⑩ba lags kyis skyed gsol cigaspu /slad kyis 'dir nyes dmigs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des nyes dmigs mthong bas zos nas mtha' gcig tu song ste 'dug go/ /ji tsam na de dag dro la bab ste gaṇ+ḍi brdungs 0na rang rang gi lhung bzed thogs te gral rims bzhin du 'khod do/ /de dag 'khod pa dang de dag gi gtsug lag khang de 'bar rab tu 'bar kun du rab tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur nas sreg par brtsams so/ /de nas de dag ji srid du dro ma yol gyi bar du me lce des bsregs nas de dag lus ④tshig cing sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyen nas banyam thag pa'i skad 'byin to/ /ji tsam na dro yol ba dang gtsug ⑩lag khang de yang de kho na bzhin du phyir byung zhing dge slong de dag kyang de kho na bzhin du spyod lam zhi bas gnas so/ / de nas 0tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun 'tsho de dag gi gan du song ste dris pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed su yin/ las gang gis 'dir skyes/ de 1—251
