rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag deng la 'di dag thams cad sod ①cig /de dag gis lam po che dang / srang dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su rjes su sgrogs shing gsad ②par khrid pa na chom rkun pa zhig lam dog ②par bros te rgyal byed kyi tshal du dge slong gi gan du song ste ⑤smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag ⑤rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal lo/ /des de ⑥rab tu phyung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par byas so/ /chom rkun pa de dag kyang bsad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag rang gi rgud pa dang / gzhan gyi rgyad pa dang /rang gi 'byor pa dang / gzhan gyi 'byor pa la yang dang yang du so sor rtogs shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag rang gi rgyad pa dang / gzhan gyi rgud pa ni kun du skyo bar 'gyur ba'i gnas yin la/ rang gi 'byor pa dang /gzhan gyi 'byor pa yang kun du skyo bar 'gyur ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na dge slong rnams cudur khrod rgyur 'dong ba na dge slong de yang de rnams dang lhan cig ⑧dur khrod rgyur song ba las des chom rkun pa de dag bsad ⑨pa mthong nas mchi mas brnangs te 'dug par gyur pa dang / dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di hu) gsar du tshurab tu byung ba yin yang bsam 8pa 'di 'dra bar bzang ngo / /des skad phyung byaste ngu bar brtsams pa dang dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod ci'i phyir cho nges 'debs/ des smras pa/ 'di ni bdag gi pa'o//'di ni bdag gi 8phu nu'o/ /'di ni 8khu bo'o⑩/ /'di ni zhang po'o/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di rnams kyis dgra bcom pa srog 4)dang 'phral lam/des smras pa/ phral lo zhes zer ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong 1—302

rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gang zag 'di ni dgra bcom pa bsad ①pa yin te/ gang zag dgra bcom pa bsad ②pa ni chos 'dul ba 'di la mi skye ba'i chos can yin pas dge slong dag khyed kyis gang zag dgra bcom pa bsad ②pa chos 'dul ba 'di las bsnyil bar bya'o/ /'ga' zhig gi gan du rab tu 'byung bar 'dod pa 'ongs na/des de la dgra bcom pa bsad ④pa ma yin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par ⑤rab tu 'byin par byed/ bsnyen par rdzogs ༅par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑦'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa gang gis sngon rab tu phyung ba dun de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun phye ba de gal te legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa spudage slong gi dngos po 'tshal tson/ rab tu dbyung tsobar bgyi'am rab tu dbyung 8bar mi bgyi/ nye ba 8'khor rab tu dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /de lta bas na 'ga' zhig gi gan du rab tu dbyung skyibar 'dod pa 'ongs na/ des 8de la dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa ma yin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba tho)'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba gal te legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'tshal na/rab tu dbyung bar bgyi'am/ rab tu dbyung bar mi bgyi/ nye ba ⑩'khor rab tu dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /de lta bas na 'ga' zhig gi gan du rab tu dbyung tsobar 1—303

'dod pa 'ongs na/ des de la de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba ma yin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ①'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa sngon gang rab tu 'byung ba na pham par 'gyur ba ②bzhi las ltung ba gang yang rung ba byung ba de gal te legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'tshal na/ rab tu dbyung bar bgyi'am/ rab tu dbyung bar mi bgyi/ nye ba tso'akhor rab tu dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /de lta bas na 'ga' zhig gi ④gan du rab tu 'byung bar 'dong ba 'ongs na/ des de la pham par 'gyur ⑤ba bzhi las ltung ba gang yang rung ba byung ba ma yin nam zhes dri bar bya'o/ /ma dris par rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas 'ubacom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag gal te gang zag ma mthong bas gnas nas phyung ba babs pa zhig yang phyir 'ongs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ltung ba mthong gis bdag rab tu dbyung bar gsol zhes zer na de ⑦rab tu dbyung bar dubya'o/ /rab tu phyung nas tshe dang ldan pa dag ltung ba bshags par byas༅la/ bdag bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol zhes zer na bsnyen par rdzogs par bya'o/ /ji ste bsnyen par rdzogs nas ltung ba ma mthong ngo zhes zer na/ gal te dge 'dun tshogs pa yod na yang ma mthong bas gnas nas dbyung bar bya'o/ /gal te tshogs pa med la ji ste bsnyen par rdzogs na ⑩legs 1—304

par bsnyen par rdzogs pa yin te/ 'di ltar gang zag gis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po rnyed par dka' 1ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ma mthong bas gnas nas phyung ba ji lta ba bzhin du phyir mi 'chos pas gnas nas phyung ba dang / sdig pa can gyi lta ba'i rnam pa mi gtong bas gnas nas phyung ba yang de bzhin no// //sdom la/ lag rdum dag dang rkang rdum dang / /lag sor zlum por 'jas pa dang / /mchu med lus la rma mtshan can/ /rgan ches pa dang gzhon ches dang / /theng po smad 'char cazhar ba dang / /lag sor rdum skur 5mi'u thung dang / /lba ba lkugs 6pa 'on pa dang / /rten 'phye 7dang ni rkang 'bam sdodang / /bud med kyis dub khur gyis dub/ /mi gang lam gyis dub rnams dang / /ya za ma lug gta' gam dang / /de lta bu yi mi rnams ni/ /drang srong chen pos dgag pa mdzad/ /mdzes pa rab tu dbyung ba dang / /yongs su dag pa bsnyen rdzogs par/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis rab mkhyen te/ /bden pa'i mtshan gyis bka' stsal to/ /sangs/ rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /drug sde dag gi kun du spyod pa ni gang rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs par byas pa des ji srid du 'di dag ni gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa dag yin no zhes bya bar mi shes pa de srid du de skyo de dag dang lhan cig gnas par byed la/gang gi tshe shes par gyur pa de'i tshe dge slong rang bzhin du gnas pa dag rke dang lhan cig zhuganas par byed denyunye/ ston pa'i bka' lung gis dus gsum du 'gro 1—305

ba'i phyir blta ba 'ba' zhig byed do/ /de nas de dag gis gros bya bar brtsams pal/ dga' bo nye dga' lhung bzed ①nag po can 'di dag ni btsas 'phrog pa ②dang 'dra ste/ bdag cag gis rab tu phyung ②ba rnams 'di dag gis 'phrog par byed kyis/ da ni lhung bzed nag po can rnams kyis dbrog par mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa de 'dra ba rab tu dbyung bar bya'o zhes gros byas so/ /ji tsam dus ④gzhan zhig na nye dga' kun du 'khyam pas mi lag rdum zhig mthong nas smras pa/bzhin bzangs ci'i phyir rab tu mi 'byung / des smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag lag pa ma tshang ba su zhig gis rab tu 'byin par bgyid/ nye dga'as ⑤smras pa/ bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la yithugs rjes rab tu phye ba yin gyis/ kho bos khyod rab tu dbyung bar bya'o zhes des de rab tu phyung ⑦zhing byabasnyen par rdzogs par byas so/ /de nas zhag gnyis sam gsum zhig kun du spyod pa'i chos rnams spubaslabs nas smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ri dgas kyis ri dgas mi sosartsa / mnyan yod rgya che la rang gi ༅spyod yul dang yab kyi spyod yul yin pas bsod snyoms rgyus la 'tsho bar gyis shig /des smras pa / mkhan po ji ltar bsod snyoms rgyu bar bgyi/ des smras pa/ khyod kyis de tsam yang 8mi shes masam/ ngas khyod la bstan par bya'o zhes des de'i sham thabs ni srad zhu)bus bcings/ chos gos ni tsher /ngasnyems gtur te bskon(9/dpung pa g.yon par ni lhung bzed kyi snod bzhag /dpung pa g.yas par ni khar gsil ⑩btags so/ /de nas de mnyan yod du 8spyod yul du zhugs pa dang bud med kyis brang brdungs nas smras pa/ 'phags pa sus khyod rab tu byung ba'i lag pa gnyis bcad/ des smras pa/ sring mo khyim pa yinas kho bo'i 1—306

lag pa chad de①/ rab tu byung ② nas chad pa ma yin no/ /sus rab tu phyung /des smras pa/ mkhan po nye dga'as zhuso/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ gnas ngan len kun du spyod pa de ma gtogs pas ④gzhan su zhig 'di lta bu rab tu 'byin par byed ces zer ba'i skabs de ⑤bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ nyes dmigs gang cung zad ci byung ba de ni dge slong dag tshilag rdum rab tu 'byin pa las gyur pa yin no ༅snyam nas bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong gis lag rdum rab tu dbyung bar mi bya bsnyen par rdzogs par mi bya'o/ /rab tu 'byin par byed/ bsnyen par rdzogs par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//lag rdum duji lta ba de bzhin du rkang rdum dang / lag sor zlum por rtsa'ajas pa dang / mchu med pa dang / lus la rma mtshan co can dang / rgan ches pa ⑫dag kyang 8de bzhin no/ /dge slong dag gzhon ches pa dag rab tu 'byin par byed nas de dag gis dge 'dun gyi gnas mal bshang gcis ma 6rung bar byed nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag kyang rab tu dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /theng po rtsodag rab tu 'byin par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag kyang rab tu dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /smad 'chal dang / zhar ba dang / lag sor rdum po dang / sgur 8po dang / mi'u thung dang / wa ba can dang / lkugs ⑩pa dang / 'on pa dang / rten 'phye dang / rkang 'bam byadag rab tu 'byin par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bu dag kyang rab tu dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag bud med 1—307

kyis dub pa dang / khur gyis ①dub pa dang / lam gyis dub pa dang / ya za ma lug dang / gta' ②gam pa dag rab tu 'byin par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bu dag kyang rab tu dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /rab tu 'byin par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /bsdu bar bya ba'i skabs so/ /rab tu 'byung chaba'i gzhi rdzogs sto ge// //gso sbyong gi gzhi'i ②sdom la/ mu stegs can dang ka pi na/ /gnas dang rgyal po sbyar ba mang / /sdom la/ mu stegs can dang gsol ba dang / /gnang ba dang ni 'dug pa dang / /bab col spong dang zhal ta dang / / bya dang gso sbyong thoganas rnams so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na rgyal po'i khab kyi dge bsnyen rab tu mang po dag nang par nang par zhing bcom ldan 'das la blta rtseb dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir 'gro bar brtson ④par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi dge bsnyen rab tu mang po dag 'di snyam du sems te/da ltar bcom ldan 'das kyang nang du yang dag par la'ajog par mdzad la/dge slong yid du 'thad byapa hunams kyang nang du yang dag 'jog par byed pas bdag cag re zhig bcom ldan 'das la blta 8ba dang bsnyen bkur 0bya ba'i phyir 'dong ba sngas kyis/ bdag cag gzhan mu stegs ④can kun du rgyu dag gi kun dga' ra ba ga la ba der dong ngo snyam mo de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi dge bsnyen rab tu mang po dag gzhan mu stegs can kun du rgyu dag gi 8kun dga' ra ba ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas gzhan mu stegs can kun du rgyu dag dang lhan cig mngon du 1—308

yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba'i gtam sna tshogs byas te mtha' gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas mu stegs can zhig gis mu stegs can dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag bdag cag 'ba' zhig la 'dug pa dang bya ba dang gso sbyong yod dam/ 'on te shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong ①dag la yang yod/ de nas mu stegs can zhig gis mu stegs can dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag bdag cag 'ba' zhig la 'dug pa dang bya ba dang gso sbyong yod kyi/ shākya'i bu'i dge sbyong dag la ni med do/ /de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi dge bsnyen rab tu mang po dag gzhan mu stegs can kun du rgyu dag gis smras pa la mngon par bstod ④par yang mi byed/ phyir ldog par yang mi byed cing mngon par bstod pa duyang ma byas/ phyir bzlog ④par yang ma byas par stan dag las langs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig ༅tu 'khod do/ /mtha' gcig tu 'khod nas rgyal po'i khab kyi dge bsnyen ⑥rab tu mang po dag rtsogis gzhan mu stegs can kun du rgyu dag dang lhan cig bar skabs su gtam ci brjod pa de thams cad bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol nas 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /kye ma bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse ⑧ba'i slad du bdag cag gi skyil yang mchis pa dang / bgyi ba dang /gso sbyong bca' bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po'i khab kyi dge bsnyen rab tu mang po dag la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi dge bsnyen rab tu mang po dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar ⑨rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la 1—309

mngon par bstod pa dang rjes su yi rang ba ①byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ②nas dong ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na dge slong rnams kyis deng phyin chad 'dug pa dang /bya ba dang / gso sbyong la tron ⑤bya bar rjes su gnang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams kyis deng phyin chad 'dug pa dang / bya ba dang /gso sbyong la tron ④bya bar rjes su gnang ngo zhes bka' stsal nas/ de dag gis 'dug pa ci ④lta bu yin pa dang / bya ba ci ༅lta bu yin pa dang / gso sbyong ci ⑦lta bu yin pa mi shes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed dutshur shog /'dug pa ni rnal 'byor te/ lus 'di nyid rkang pa'i mthil ⑨yan chad klad cepa'i skra man chad ⑩pags 8pa la thug gi bar du ji 8ltar gnas pa dang /ci 6ltar byas pa bzhin du mi gtsang rtsab rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gang ste/ lus 'di la skra dang kha spu dang / sen mo dang so dang / rdul dang / dri ma dang /pags the'upa dang / sha dang / rus pa dang / rgyus pa dang / rtsa dang /mkhal ma dang / snying dang / mchin pa dang / glo ba dang / rgyu ma dang /gnye ma dang / pho ba dang / long ka dang / lhang pa dang / mtsher pa sh+yidang / phyi sa dang / mchi ma dang / snabs dang / zhag dang / chu ser dang / rkang dang / tshil dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang / rnag dang / khrag dang / klad 8pa dang / klad ༅rgyas dang / gcin dag du yod do snyam du so sor rtogs shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong dag spyod yul du zhugs pa yin yang rnal 1—310

'byor sgom ①par byed pa na ②de dag glang po che 'khrul pa dang / ②rta 'khrul pa dang / rkang thang ④pa 'khrul pa dang lhan cig phrad nas 'gyel ba dang bub par gyur nas ma dad pa ⑤rnams 'phags pa dag mi mthong ngam ci zhes co ༅'dri bar byed pa dang / de dag rnal 'byor sgom mo ⑦zhes zer ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spyod yul du zhugs pas rnal 'byor bsgom ④par mi bya'o/ /de dag sgo tsokhang du rnal 'byor sgom byapar byed pa na yur nas ma dad pa rnams 'phags 7pa dag ci khyed 8'du bar nyal ba'i brtul zhugs can yin nam zhes co 'dri bar byed pa'i skabs de (1bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo khang du rnal 'byor bsgom bopar mi bya'o / /de dag khyams byasu sgom par byed pa na nyes dmigs de nyid du gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyams nyu9su rnal 'byor bsgom nyu snapar mi bya'o/ /de dag gnas khang du sgom par byed pa 8na bsam gtan dag sh+yagi tsher ma ni sgra yin pas sems rtse gcig pa nyid kyang mi thob pa'i skabs ṭu de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas khang du rnal 'byor bsgom 3par mi bya'o/ /de dag dgon par dong ste sgom 3par byed pa na chom rkun pa rnams dang / g.yon can rnams dang / seng ge rnams dang / stag rnams dang / gung rnams dang / gzig rnams kyis bgrod 3par gyur pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa kū/dgon par rnal 'byor bsgom 3par mi bya'o/ /de dag grong dang nye bar lhags 1—311

nas sgom par byed pa na ma dad pa rnams 'phags pa dag ci khyed cag 'ga' zhig ①shi ba dang ldan par ma gyur tam zhes co ②'dri bar byed pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyogs de ②yal ga dag gam/ sog dag dang ④/ re lde dag gis bskor bar bya'o/ /de dag gis phyogs ⑤yal ga dag gam/ seg dag gam/re lde dag gis bskor ba dang ma dad pa rnams 'phags pa dag ci 'di rgyal mo yig gon gyi ⑦ra ba'am/ la phug gi char ba'am zhes co 'dri bar byed pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyogs de rtsig ⑨pa dag gam/ 'obs dag gis bskor bar bya'o/ /de dag gis phyogs de n+tu rtsig 7pa dag gam/ 'obs dag gis bskor ba dang / ma dad pa rnams 'phags pa dag ci 'di ma du lung ga'i ra ba'am / 'on te bal po se'u'i mar ba yin/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ rnal 'byor sgom 8pa'o zhes zer ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na spong khang brtsig par gnang hu ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis spong khang brtsig ⑫par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ de dag gis spong khang rnam pa byaji lta bu yin pa ⑩mi shes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spong khang ni gnyis te/ chung ngu dang /chen po'o/ /chung ngu ni gnas khang gnyis kyi bar du sung btod ④pa'o/ /chen po ni gnas khang bcu'am/ bcu gnyis kyi bar du srang btod 0pa'o/ /dge slong dag gis gnas khang byas nas sbyang byed pa bzhin du sgo dod zhu par mi byed 1—312

nas / bcom ldan 'das ①kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo gdod ②par bya'o/ /dge slong dag sgo glegs mi 'dzud dunas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sgo glegs gzhug par bya'o/ /dbye dka' nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / lag zungs gdags par bya'o/ /yang mig ④sgra 'khrol nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'og tu ko ba'i dum bu gzhug par bya'o/ /gcad dka' ༅nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnam gzer zhudang /'khor gtan dang / phred gtan ༅gzhug ⑧par bya'o/ /mun gnag par gyur ⑨nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skar khung gdod par bya'o/ /dma' bar btod ⑩pa na chom rkun pa dang / g.yon can dang / seng ge dang /stag dang / gung rnams kyis bgrod par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dma' bar gdod par mi bya'o/ /rtso1mthon po gdod 8pa na snang ⑫ba mi gsal tsunyenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mthon por gdod par mi bya bar sum gnyis dor bar bya zhing sum gnyis dor rtsonyenas sum char gdod par bya'o/ /de dag gong du rtsosum gnyis bor te 'og gi sum char dod 2nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'og tu sum gnyis bor te gong du sum 8cha bor bar gdod par bya'o/ /dge slong dag phyi yangs shing nang rub par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skar khung rgya mtsho'i ⑩rnam pa lta bur zhu gdod par bya byaste/ phyi rub la nang yangs par bya'o/ /khwa dang /mchil pa dang / phug 3ron dag 'jug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / skar khung dra ba can du bya'o/ /sbrang bu tre ma bu ka dang / tre la ta dag 'jug nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo glegs gzhug 0par bya'o//1—313

rlung gis 'byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phred gtan gzhug par ①bya'o/ /gcad dka' nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gnam gzer dang 'khor gtan gzhug par bya'o/ /dbye dka' nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbyug gu skam ka ②byas te phred gtan dang /gnam gzer dudang / 'khor gtan dag gis ni gcad par bya'o/ /dbyug gu skam gas ④ni dbye bar bya'o/ /der stan phyedagos par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sa'i stegs ༅bu dag bya'o/ /mkhrang ༅bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khri'u bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khri'u bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ de dag gis khri'u ci 'dra ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kho ra khor yug tu khru dubazhis 'khor ba'i khri'u bya zhing de thags mas bla bar bya'o/ /de dag gis ⑨thags ma du yod mi shes nas the'u bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ thags ma ni lnga ste/mun dza'i skyedang / sha na'i dang / gres ma'i dang / ras ma'i dang / sba phra mo'i'o / /de dag mkhrang 8bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/stan nang tshangs can skyogading bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan bonang ⑫tshangs can dag gding bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ de dag gis ④stan nang tshangs can ci 'dra ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ srid du khru bzhi pa zheng ⑩du khru do yod pa nyis 8ltab tu byas te drub par bya'o/ /de'i nang du shing bal gyis dgang bar bya'o/ /de dag gis shing bal du yod mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shing bal dag ni lnga ste/ arga'i ༅shing bal dang / ka shi ku'i ⑥ shing bal dang / er ma'i 0shing bal dang /1—314

spra ba'i shing bal dang / shal ma li'i shing bal dag ①yin no/ /gzhan yang lnga ste / bal dang / sha na'i shing bal dang / ras bal dang / ras ma dang /lo ma'i tshogs dag gis bkang ba dag yin no/ /shing bal thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'chugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo mdor skud ②pas ②bya rog rkang gi gzungs gdab par bya'o/ /'khod pa na yur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gdos bu gdags par bya'o/ /ji ltar gdags mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skud pa btags ④te rna ba la gdags par bya'o/ /'on kyang yur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dbyug gu ⑤gzugs par bya'o/ /dge slong dag dbyug gu spyig thogu'i bcad 'phro lta bus 'dzugs pa na rma byung nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bre'i bcad 'phro lta bur bya'o/ /'on kyang snad nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras ma dag gis dkris rtsonas dal bus khad kyis khad kyis gzugs par bya'o/ /'on kyang yur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pho long 'phang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis mun khung du 'phangs pa na de 'khyams dunas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' hustsal pa/ thag ⑩gus btags te 'phang bar bya zhing de nas yang phyir drang bar bya'o/ /'on kyang yur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdun du mar me gzhag par bya'o / /'on kyang yur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rkang pa gcig brkyang bar yibya'o/ /'on kyang yur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rkang pa ya gcig kyang brkyang bar bya'o/ /'on kyang yur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ langs te bcag par bya'o/ /dge slong dag 1—315

'chag ①pa na 'thom nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phred dag ②la 'ju bar bya'o/ /lag pas chang rgyud byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbu bu bskon la skud 0pas btags pa la 'jus te bcag par bya'o/ /mchil ④lham dang bcas pas 'chag ⑤par byed pa na sgra byung nas ༅bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mchil lham can ⑦gyis bcag ⑧par mi bya'o/ /rdul gyis rkang pa gnyis ma rung spunas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ par thang gding cibar bya'o/ /snums 7par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dgongs cospong ba pa'i kun du spyod pa'i chos dag bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong spong ba pas zhag gsum zhing gsum zhing rkang pa gnyis bsku bar bya'o/ /dge slong spong ba pas kun du spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa dag yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//de dag der mi shong nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ steng du rim khang gnyis pa bya'o/ /'dzeg nyusredaka' nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/them skas bya'o/ /lhung bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kha khyer gyis bskor bar bya'o/ /de 'khrul 6nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lcags kyi gzer bu dag gis gdab par bya'o/ /'on kyang mi shong nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyi 8rol du spong khang chen po bya'o/ /de dag sgo sprod dag tu byed pa na de dag phan tshun dag tu tsosnang nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sgo snol mar gdod par bya'o/ /sgo khang bya'o/ /phug kyang bya'o/ /de dag de na yur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sgo drung du snam bu'am ras dpyangs 8te nyal bar bya zhing 'di la 'gyod par mi 1—316

bya'o / /de dag de nas song zhing yang phyis 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong spong ba'i zhal ta byed pa bsko bar bya'o3)/ /dge slong spong ba'i zhal ta byed pa chos lnga dang ldan pa ni ma bskos pa yang bsko bar mi bya la/ bskos pa yang dbyung bar bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun pas 'gro ba dang / zhe snang gis 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis 'gro ②ba dang / 'jigs pas 'gro ba dang / spong ba la tron zhubyas pa dang ma byas pa mi shes pa ste/dge slong spong ba'i bozhal ta byed pa chos lnga po de dag dang ldan pa ni ma bskos pa yang bsko bar mi bya la/ bskos pa yang dbyung bar bya'o/ /dge slong spong ba'i zhal ta byed pa chos lnga phyedang ldan pa ni ma bskos pa yang bsko bar bya la/bskos pa yang dbyung bar mi bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'dun pas mi 'gro ba dang / zhe sdang gis mi 'gro ba dang / gti mug gis mi 'gro ba dang /'jigs pas mi 'gro ba dang / spong ba la tron byas pa dang ma byas pa shes pa ste/dge slong spong ba'i zhal ta byed pa chos lnga po de dag dang ldan pa ni ma bskos pa yang bsko bar bya la/ bskos pa yang dbyung bar mi bya'o/ /'di ltar bsko bar bya ste/ je gyedang por spro bar bya ste/ ming 'di ༅zhes bya ba khyod dge 'dun gyi spong ba'i 3zhal ta byed par spro'am zhes dri bar bya'o/ /gal te spro na des spro zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu des gnas mal bshams ⑨pa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi ⑩brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo yinas/dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa thal dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid par spro 1—317

na / gal te dge 'dun ①gyi ②dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis dudage slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi cospong ba'i zhal ta bgyid par bsko ④ste/ dge slong ming ༅'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ④du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid par spro ste/de'i slad du dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dudage 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid par bsko zhing dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di sh+yidage 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid par bsko zhing / dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 6shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung nyu3shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis medage slong ming 'di nyul zhes bgyi ba skyedage 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid par bskos shing / dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi spong ba'i zhal ta bgyid de/ 'di ltar cang 8mi gsung bas nyunide de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge slong dag ngas dge slong spong skyeba'i zhal ta byed pa'i kun du spyod pa'i chos rnams bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong spong ba'i zhal ta byed pas spong khang du chag chag gdab par bya'o/ /phyag dar bya'o//lci ba sar pa'i byug 8pas bsku 'ubar bya'o/ /stan bsham par bya'o/ /bshang ba'i sa dang gci ba'i sa byi dor bya'o/ /chag chag gdab par bya'o/ /phyag dar bya'o/ /lci ba sar pa'i byug pas bsku bar bya'o/ /lo ma'i chang du bu gzhag 1—318

par bya'o/ /bong rdog dang / sa dang / chu gzhag par bya'o/ /de dag re re'i gan du song ste 'bod par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/re re nas bod par mi bya bar gaṇ+ḍi brdung bar ①bya'o/ /des zugaṇ+ḍi rgya cher brdungs pa dang ji tsam na spyod yul gyi grong mi rnams chom rkun pa ma 'ongs sam zhes lcasngangs nas/ de rnams go bgos ④te lhags nas 'phags pa dag ci chom rkun pa dag mchis sam/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag chom rkun pa dag ma ༅lhags te/ 'di ltar spong ba la tron byed do/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'phags pa dag rnam par 'tshe 'ub la tron mdzad kyi/'di na spong ba ga la mchis zhes zer ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ gaṇ+ḍi ④rgya cher brdung bar mi bya ste/ 'di ltar gaṇ+ḍi de rduni lnga ste/ dge 'dun bsdu ba'i gaṇ+ḍi dang / las kyi gaṇ+ḍi spudang / shi ba'i gaṇ+ḍi dang / spong ba'i gaṇ+ḍi dang /gnod pa byung ba'i gaṇ+ḍi'o/ /de la dge 'dun bsdu ba'i gaṇ+ḍi de nyu)ni rgyud gsum dang tog gsum moskye/ /las kyi gaṇ+ḍi de phyani rgyud gcig dang tog skyogasum mo / /shi ba'i gaṇ+ḍi de 6ni byi bo'oskye/ /spong ba'i gaṇ+ḍi de rtsani khar sil 8lo/ /gnod pa byung ba'i gaṇ+ḍi de 8ni ji tsam gyis chog pa'o/ /de dag dus rting mal thug pa na ci bder byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rting zhu la thug zun ci bder mi bya bar dus shes par byas nas ci bder 6byas te/ dge 'dun las 'tshal ma thob 3pa gang dag ④yin pa de dag kyang khrus byas nas dge 'dun gyi nang du 'du khom pa dang / bsod snyoms pa gang dag yin pa de dag kyang rkang lag gnyis bkrus nas grong du bsod snyoms la 'jug khom par bya'o/ /1—319

de dag de ①khro na bzhin du ci bder byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / de kho na bzhin du ci bder ②mi bya bar rgyud chags gsum pa gdon par bya'o / /de dag ha cang mang du 'don par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ha cang mang du gdon par mi bya'o/ /de dag ha cang nyung ngur 'don par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pal/ ha cang nyung ngur gdon par mi bya ste/ 'di ltar ran par gdon par bya'o/ /de dag yon bshad par mi byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yon bshad par bya'o / /bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bshad par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/de dag gis sus yon bshad par bya ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis yon bshad par bya'o/ /de dag yon bshad pa ha cang mang du byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/yon bshad pa ha cang mang du mi bya'o/ /de dag yon bshad pa ha cang nyung dur byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yon bshad pa ha cang nyung ngur mi bya ste/ 'di ltar yon bshad par byaran par bya'o/ /dge slong zhuspong ba'i zhal ta byed pa thams cad kyi mjug tu 'du zhing 'uthams cad kyi mdun du dgyes ⑦par byed nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong duspong ba'i zhal ta byed pa thams cad kyi mjug tu dgyes ⑨par bya zhing thams cad kyi mdun ④du 'du bar bya'o/ /gal te rkyen de lta bu byung na tsodes phyogs dben par lde skyomig sbas te/ tshe dang ldan pa kho bos phyogs ga ge mo zhig tu lde 8mig sbas kyis phye la zhugs shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /dge slong bospong ba'i zhal ta byed pas kun du spyad pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa dag 8yang dag par blangs te mi 1—320

'jug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de ni 'dug pa zhes bya'o/ /bya ba gang zhe na/ dge 'dun gyis ①gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang /gsol ba dang bzhi'i las gang yin pa de 'di phyani bya ba zhes bya'o/ /gso sbyong gang zhe na/ dge slong dag ngas so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon pa ston pa dugang yin pa ste/ de khyed kyis deng phyin chad zla ba phyed phyed cing gdon par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor ④thar pa'i mdo gdon pa gdon ⑤par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ de dag gis sus gdon par bya ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyi thoganas brtan gyis zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor cuthar pa'i mdo gdon pa gdon par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi duganas brtan gyis zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor rtsathar pa'i mdo gdon pa gdon par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ dge slong dag de'i gnas khang du 'du bar byed pa tsu tshan de dag der mi shong ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas khang du gdon par mi bya'o/ /de dag khyams su gdon par byed pa skyon der yang mi shong nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge 'dun gyis skyegaso sbyong gi gnas la blo mthun par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyis cigaso sbyong gi gnas la blo mthun par bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/ de dag gis gang la blo mthun par bya ba mi shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ byas pa'am / zin pa nang mtshams cidang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa tsodage 'dun tsogaso sbyong gi gnas su 'dod pa gang yin pa de la blo mthun par 1—321

bya'o / /'di ltar blo mthun par bya ste/ gnas mal bshams ①pa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis snodage slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas/dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la/ dge slong gcig ②gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ④du gsol/gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyis ⑤gso sbyong gi ⑥gnas su bzhed na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis ༅dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis duganang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom chagang dang bcas pa 'di la/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am/bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi chogaso sbyong gi nyunyeganas su bzhed de kye/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis nyunyeganas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di la dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di la dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ④shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung 4)shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/1—322

dge 'dun gyi ①gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di la dge 'dun gyi chagaso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyis ①lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /gang du dge 'dun gyi cigaso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par byas pa der dge slong rnams kyis 'dug la gso sbyong dang /dgag dbye dang / gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i ⑤las bya'o/ /mi mthun par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po bcu gnyis pa/ sdom la/ ka thob na dang chos gos dang / /dgrol dang mtshams chung mtshams chen dang / /gnang dang bskyung bskyed dgrol ba dang / /gcad rtsodang mi 'bral ma gcad dudang / /grong dgon las dang dgon ⑨pa yi/ /sde tshan yang dag bsdus pa yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na tsu sna'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ku'i gnas na bzhugs byaso/ /de'i tshe na tshe dang ldan pa bram ze ka kyipo na rgyal po'i khab na sde can ma'i phug na gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas dge 'dun dang mthun par 'jug 8go/ /de nas dge slong rab tu mang po dag gso sbyong bcwa rūlnga pa de nyid kyi tshe gso sbyong gi gnas su 'dug cing mthun par gyur nas/ shas cher tshe dang ldan pa bram ze ka byapi na la sdod cing 'khod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa bram ze ka 0pi na 'di snyam du sems te/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcwa lnga pa yin la bdag dge slong ka 0pi na'i gso sbyong yang bcwa lnga pa yin na/ci dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su 'gro bar bya'am/ 'on te dge 'dun gyi 1—323

gso stong gi gnas su 'gro bar mi bya/ ci dge 'dun dang lhan cig gso sbyong nyams su myong bar bya'am/ 'on te dge 'dun dang lhan cig gso sbyong nyams su myong bar mi bya/ ci dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag tu 'gro bar bya'am/ 'on te dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang / ①dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag tu 'gro bar mi bya/ ci dge 'dun dang lhan cig dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag nyams su myong bar bya'am/ 'on te dge 'dun dang lhan cig dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang / dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag nyams su myong bar mi bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / rtag tu dag pa snying po ste/ /rtag tu dag pa gso sbyong yin/ /gtsang lduma'i las ni gedag gyur pa/ /de ④yi brtul zhugs 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bka' stsal pas bdag ni dag cing mchog tu dag pa sdudang ldan no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa bram ze ka 'u'i na'i sems kyi 3yongs su rtog ④pa thugs su chud nas 'od ma'i tshal nas mi snang bar mdzad de sde can ma'i phug tu tshe dang ldan pa bram ze ka 6mi na'i mdun du bzhugs te 'di skad ces bka' stsal coto/ /ka skyepo na khyod gcig pu dben par song ste nang du yang dag 'jog pa na 'di snyam du deng ⑫dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong pobacwa lnga pa yin la bdag dge slong ka bopo na'i gso sbyong yang bcwa lnga pa yin na/ ci dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su 'gro bar bya'am/'on te dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su 'gro bar mi bya/ ci dge 'dun dang lhan cig tsogaso sbyong nyams su myong bar bya'am/ 'on te dge 'dun dang lhan cig ⑩gso sbyong nyams su myong bar mi bya/ ci dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang / dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag tu 'gro bar bya'am/ 'on te dge 'dun gyi bya ba pyadang /1—324

dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag tu 'gro bar mi bya/ ci dge 'dun dang lhan cig dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang / dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag nyams su myong bar bya'amanya/'on te dge 'dun dang lhan cig dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang / dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag nyams su myong bar mi bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / rtag tu dag pa snying po ste/ /rtag tu dag pa gso sbyong yin/ /gtsang sema'i las ni dag gyur pa⑤/ /de yi brtul zhugs 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bka' stsal pas bdag ni dag cing mchog tu dag pa dang ldan no snyam du sems la ④sems kyi yongs su rtog pa ma byung ngam/ btsun pa byung ngo / /ka ⑤yi na khyod re zhig dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su mi 'gro na thogazhan su zhig 'gro bar 'gyur/khyod dge 'dun dang lhan cig gso sbyong nyams su myong bar mi byed na/ gzhan su zhig nyams su myong bar byedartso/ khyod dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang / dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag tu mi 'gro na gzhan su zhig 'gro bar 'gyur/ khyod dge 'dun dang lhan cig dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag rgyadang / dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag nyams su myong bar mi byed na gzhan su zhig nyams su myong bar byed/ ka h+phupi na de lta bas na khyod dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su mi 'gro bar ma byed par song shig /ka 7pi na khyod dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong nyams su mi myong bar ma byed par nyams su byamyong bar byos shig /ka 8po na khyod dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag tsodang / cidage 'dun gyi byed pa dag tu mi 'gro bar ma byabyed par song shig/ka 6pi na khyod dge 'dun dang lhan cig ⑩dge 'dun gyi bya ba dag dang / dge 'dun gyi byed pa dag nyams su mi myong bar ma byed par nyams su myong bar gyis 8shig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan ⑩pa bram ze ka zhu pi na khrid nas 1—325

gso sbyong gi gnas ga la ba der ①gshegs te dubyon nas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong dag gis gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi du sdom pas mtshams chen po gcad ④pa rjes su gnang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyagaso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po gcad 'upar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas/dge slong rnams kyis ji ltar gcad 3par bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ je dang por dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams chen po phyogs bzhi'i gematshan ma brtan po shar phyogs su ni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/ khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang /byang phyogs su 9yang sapha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/ khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan zhu po gzugs par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gnas mal bsham pa 8byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge nyu 7slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo tsu ༷nas/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la 6dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis skyematshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po rtso)shar phyogs su ni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/1—326

rtsig ①pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ②ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am / khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan por ②brjod par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su yang pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan por ④brjod par bya'o/ /de'i ⑤'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di lta ste/ gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po skyobarjod pa shar phyogs su rtsoni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ldum ⑨brtan po lags/ lho phyogs su ni ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ nub phyogs su ni ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma brtan po lags/ byang phyogs su ni lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan 0po lags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu yib dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la rig par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du dge 'dun gyis grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs 8par dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug gi tho)bar du mtshams chen po gcod ④do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/1—327

dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ①du gsol/ 'di lta ste/ gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis ②mtshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am / rtsig ③pa'i mtshan ma ④brtan po lags/ lho phyogs su ni ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ nub phyogs su ni ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma brtan po lags/ byang phyogs su ni lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/ khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po ⑤lags te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ⑥mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs cupar dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po gcod dun/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag mtshan ma 'di rnams ④kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la rtsareg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs par dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i skyobar du mtshams chen po gcad 8par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 8shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung boshig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis byamatshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs par 0dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i 1—328

bar du mtshams chen po bcad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas ①de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun gyis gang ②du mtshams chen po bcad pa der dge slong rnams kyis 'dug ste/ gso sbyong bya zhing dgag dbye dang / gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang /cha gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya'o/ /mi mthun par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong rnams chos gos gsum thogs te nyin mo spyod du 'dong ba na skyo bar gyur pa'i bskabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyis ⑤chos gos dag dang ༅mi 'bral ba'i gnang rtsob sbyin par bya'o/ /'di ltar sbyin par bya ste/ gnas mal bsham pa 3byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ /'di lta ste/ gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi rtsasdom pas mtshams chen po bcad pa las/ gal te dge 'dun gyi skyodus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyis ༅chos gos dag dang bral ⑫bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsol 8to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan tsu )du gsol/ 'di lta ste/gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 1—329

mtshams chen po bcad de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi ①chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsol ②na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag 'di lta ste/gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams la ②bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi ④chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal ⑤bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung yoshig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ༅shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal lags te / 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas dude de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun gyis gang du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong rnams kyi rtsachos gos dag rtsodang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba byin pa der skyodage slong rnams stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dang bcas pas 'dong bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /dge slong dag la bzhi'i tshogs kyis las bya ba dag byung zhing lnga'i tshogs kyis las bya ba dag dang / bcu'i tshogs kyis las bya ba dag byung nas/ de dag dge 'dun thams cad sdud par byed pa na/ dge slong rnams kyi tsodage ba'i phyogs yongs su nyams par gyur pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mtshams bu chung gcad 8cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par bya'o/ /'di ltar gcad ④par bya ste / je dang por mtshams chen po tsodagrol bar bya'o/ /'di ltar dgrol bar 1—330

bya ste/ gnas mal bsham par ①byas nas/ gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo ②nas/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te/ las bya'o / /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ②du gsol/ 'di lta ste/gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po bcad pa gal te dge 'dun gyi ④dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis ⑤gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis mtshams chen po gzhig cing dgrol bar mdzad do ⑥/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan thodu gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po bcad de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis mtshams chen po gzhig cing dgrol bar dumadzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag mtshams chen po gzhig cing dgrol bar rmyemadzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung tsheshig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung skyeshig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum 8du bzlas/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis mtshams chen po bshig cing bgrol 8lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gnas pa dang gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis cimatshams bu chung gi 8phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan 8po shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa'am/ srad bu bres pa'am / rdo bzhag pa'am/ srol btod ⑩pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su ca 1—331

yang seng ldeng gi phur pa ①btab pa'am/ slad bu bres pa'am/ rdo bzhag pa'am / ⑤ srol btod ②pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gnas mal bsham pa ④byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo shenas/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la/ dge slong gnas pa dang gzhug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams bu chung gi phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa'am/ srad bu bres pa'am/ rdo bzhag pa'am/ srol btod ⑥pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su yang seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa'am / srad bu bres pa'am/ rdo bzhag pa'am/ srol btod rtsopa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma phyabartan po brjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/'di lta ste gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams bu chung gi 1phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa nyu mashar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa lags/ lho phyogs su ni srad bu bres pa lags / nub phyogs su ni skyerdo bzhag pa lags/ byang phyogs su ni srol btod rkyepa brtan po lags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi skyedus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi bonang du 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams bu chung gcod cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 1—332

'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'di na ①dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams ②du chung gi phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa lags / lho phyogs su ni srad dubu bres pa lags/ nub phyogs su ni rdo bzhag pa lags/ byang phyogs su ni ④srol btod ⑤pa brtan po lags te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams bu chung bcad ④cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams bu chung bcad 3cing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung sashig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung spushig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du 'di ltar gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams la skyebade ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams bu chung bcad nyunyecing dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung nyu)bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /de'i 'og tu mtshams chen po gcad 8par bya'o/ /'di ltar gcad kyipar bya ste/ je dang por dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis byamatshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po shar phyogs su ni pha bong 0gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya 1—333

skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/ khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang /byang phyogs su yang pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ra ①ba'i mtshan ma'am/bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/ khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gnas mal bsham pa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo 3nas / dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis sematshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan thupo shar phyogs su ni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po sabarjod par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang /nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su yang pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po thobarjod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ⑦du gsol/ 'di lta ste/ gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi ldumatshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan ⑨po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma 1—334

brtan ①po lags/ lho phyogs su ni ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ nub phyogs su ni ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma brtan po lags/ byang phyogs su ni lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi shedus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyi ②mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs ④par dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la rgyathug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po gcod do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan rgyadu gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi rtsomatshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig 3pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ lho phyogs su ni ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ nub phyogs su ni ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma brtan po lags/ byang phyogs su ni lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags te/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs par dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po ⑨gcod na/ tshe dang 1—335

ldan pa gang dag mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs par dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po gcad ①par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 0shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung 5shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang rtsonas dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams sgrubade ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs par dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po bcad skulags te/'di ltar cang rtsomi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to3/ /dge 'dun gyis gang du mtshams chen po bcad pa der dge slong rnams kyis 'dug ste gso sbyong bya zhing dgag dbye dang / gsol ba dang /lku gsol ba dang gnyis dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya'o/ /mi mthun par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//de'i 'og tu mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyis nyu)chos gos dag dang mi 'bral ba'i gnang ba sbyin par bya'o/ /'di ltar sbyin par bya ste/gnas mal bsham hupa byas nas 8gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan 8du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po bcad pa 0las/1—336

gal te dge 'dun gyi ①dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ②ba stsol to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan zhudu gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po bcad de/de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang bya'abral bar mi sdu'agyur ba'i gnang ba stsol nabyu/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par rngubagyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal rdubar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung rtsashig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung 6shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun gyis gang du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong rnams kyis ༅chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba byin pa der dge slong rnams kyi 8stod g.yogs asmad g.yogs tsodang bcas pas 'dong bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 1—337

'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ①'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa las bgyid ②pa gcig gis gsol ba gcig dang las brjod pa gcig gis mtshams kyi sgo nang dang / slad rol dang bcas pa bskyung ba dang bskyed par rung ngam/ nye ba ②'khor rung ste/ de la bskyung ④ba ni 'di yin te chung ngu'o/ /de la bskyed pa ni 'di yin te chen po'o/ /'di ltar bya ste/ je ⑤dang por mtshams chen po ⑥dgrol bar bya zhing mtshams bu chung yang dgrol bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor ba gzhig par bya'o/ /'di ltar dgrol bar bya ste/ gnas mal bsham ⑦pa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas / dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa na mtshams gnyi gar dudage 'dun bkod nyude/ dge slong las byed pas mtshams gnyi gar ༅shing ngam / dbyug pa'am/ seg byagam/ re ldes mnan nas gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan 8du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po bcad cing mtshams bu chung bcad de dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par bgyis pa las/nyi/ gal te dge 'dun gyi bladus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis mtshams chen po gzhig cing comatshams bu chung yang gzhig steskye/ dkyil 'khor ba dgrol bar mdzad do//'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ⑩du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po bcad cing mtshams bu chung yang bcad de/ dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par bgyis pa de'i slad du dge 'dun 1—338

gyis mtshams chen po gzhig cing mtshams bu chung yang gzhig ste/ dkyil 'khor ba dgrol bar mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag mtshams chen po gzhig cing mtshams bu chung yang gzhig ste/ dkyil 'khor ba dgrol bar bzod ①pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ②shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ④shig /'di ni las brjod pa dang po ste/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis mtshams chen po gzhig ④cing mtshams bu chung yang bshig phyanas dkyil 'khor ba bkrol ༅lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /de'i 'og tu dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po shar phyogs su ni pha bong gis rtsomatshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang /nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su yang pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ ge bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs par bya'o/ /mtshams bu chung gi phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa'am / srad 0bu bres pa'am/ rdo bzhag ⑩pa'am/ srol btod byapa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su yang seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa'am/ srad bu 1—339

bres pa'am/ rdo bzhag pa'am/ srol btod ①pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po gzugs ②par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gnas mal bsham ②pa byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs te dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas/dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing 'thun ④par gyur pa la dge slong gnas pa dang /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis dumatshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po shar phyogs su ni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/ khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang /byang phyogs su yang pha bong gi mtshan ma'am/ cig pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma'am/ lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/ khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po skyobarjod par bya'o/ /mtshams bu chung gi phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pa tsubatab pa'am/ srad bu bres pa'am/ rdo bzhag pa'am/ srol btod rdupa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod par bya'o/ /lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su yang seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa'am/ srad rmyepu bres pa'am/ rdo bzhag pa'am/ srol btod skyepa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod par bya'o / /de'i 'og tu mtshams gnyi gar dge 'dun bkod ⑩de dge slong las byed pas mtshams gnyi gar shing ngam/ dbyug pa'am/ seg gam/ re ldes mnan nas gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ⑫1—340

du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis mtshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni pha bong ①gi mtshan ma'am/ rtsig pa'i mtshan ma brtan ②mo lags / lho phyogs su ni ka ba'i mtshan ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ nub phyogs su ni ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma brtan po lags/ byang phyogs su ni lam po che'i mtshan ma'am/khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ mtshams bu chung gi phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa lags / lho phyogs su ni srad bu bres pa lags/ nub phyogs su ni rdo bzhag pa lags/ byang phyogs su ni srol btod du pa brtan po ngulags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi 5dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod 'ucig dang / dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas ma'adi lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs par dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po bcad cing mtshams bu chung yang bcad de/ dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad dedu/ 'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ༅du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'di na dge slong gnas pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis hu )mtshams chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni pha bong gi mtshan ma'am / rtsig pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ lho phyogs su ni ka ba'i mtshan 1—341

ma'am/ shing ljon pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/ nub phyogs su ni ra ba'i mtshan ma'am/ bya skyibs kyi mtshan ma brtan po lags/ byang phyogs su ni lam po che'i mtshan ma'amanyu/ khron pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brtan po lags/mtshams bu chung gi phyogs bzhi'i mtshan ma brtan po brjod pa shar phyogs su ni seng ldeng gi phur pa btab pa lags/ lho phyogs su ni srad bu bres pa lags/nub phyogs su ni rdo bzhag pa lags/ byang phyogs su ni srol btod ②pa brtan po ③lags teX/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ⑤mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang /dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs par dgon pa la thug ①pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po bcad cing mtshams bu chung yang bcad de ⑦dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad na tshe dang ldan pa gang dag mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang /dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs par dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po bcad cing mtshams bu chung yang bcad ⑧de/ dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung 0shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung ⑩shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyis mtshan ma 'di rnams kyi nang du gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom ⑩pas 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du grong dang grong gi nye 'khor ma gtogs 1—342

par ①dgon pa la thug pa dang / gnas mal la thug pa'i bar du mtshams chen po bcad cing mtshams bu chung yang bcad de dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun gyis gang du mtshams chen po dang mtshams bu ②chung ③bcad de dkyil 'khor bar blo mthun par byas pa der dge duslong rnams kyis 'dug ste ⑤gso sbyong bya zhing dgag dbye dang / gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang /gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya'o/ /mi mthun par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar dugal te 'dod na bskyed par ④yang bya'o/ /gal te mi 'dod na bskyung bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang mi 'bral ba'i gnang ba sbyin par bya'o/ /'di ltar sbyin ⑧par bya ste/ mtshams bu chung gi nang nas phyir byung ste mtshams chen por gnas mal bsham par ⑨byas nas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs ste 0dris pa'i tshig gis dge slong rnams la yang dag par bsgo nas/ dge 'dun thams cad 'dug cing mthun par gyur pa la dge slong gcig gis gsol ba byas te las bya'o/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan yidu gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po bcad pa las/gal te dge 'dun gyi 'dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang / dge 'dun gyis 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par tsobagyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyis 8chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal lo8/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 1—343

'dun btsun pa rnams gsan ①du gsol/ 'di lta ste gnas 'dir dge 'dun mthun pas gso sbyong gcig pa'i gnas kyi sdom pas mtshams chen po bcad de/de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag 'di lta ste/ gnas bsdu ba dang / dge slong rnams bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba'i slad du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ②ba stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung ①shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung 0shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba stsal lasas te/'di ltar cang mi gsung bas 0de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /dge 'dun gyis gang du mtshams chen po'i nang du dge slong thams cad kyi chos gos dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnang ba byin pa der dge slong rnams stod g.yogs dang dusmad g.yogs dang ⑦bcas pas 'dong bar bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑧'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa mtshams ma ⑨bkum pa'i gnas kyi mtshams gang (sprelags/ nye ba (spre'akhor rtsig pas bskor ba yin na rtsig pa mtshams yin la/ cig pas ma bskor na wa kha nas chu tso'adzag pa gang du bab pa tshun chad de/ dge slong de tson 'khod ④pa rnams kyis der 'dug ste gso sbyong bya zhing dgag dbye dang gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang gsol ba dang 1—344

bzhi'i las bya'o/ /mi mthun par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ①'khor gyis zhus pa/btsun pa grong gi mtshams kyi gnas gang lags/ nye ba du'akhor nye ②'khor gyi mtha' tshun chad do④/ /dge slong de na 'khod pa rnams kyis der 'dug cing ⑤gso sbyong bya zhing dgag dbye dang gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang gsol ༅ba dang bzhi'i las bya'o/ /mi mthun par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro༅/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ⑧'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa grong ma mchis pa'i dgon pa'i gnas kyi mtshams gang lags / nye ba ⑨'khor rgyang grags kyi mtha' tshun chad de/ dge slong rgyang grags kyi hu nang na 'khod pa thams cad kyis gcig tu 'dug ste gso sbyong bya zhing dgag dbye dang gsol ba dang / gsol ba dang gnyis dang gsol ba dang bzhi'i las bya'o/ /mi mthun par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba the ca'akhor gyis zhus pa/btsun pa gso sbyong gi las du mchis/ nye ba kyi'akhor bzhi ste/ chos ma yin pas mi mthun par byed pa dang / chos ma yin pas mthun par byed pa dang /chos kyis mi mthun par byed pa dang / chos kyis mthun par byed pa'o/ /de la gso sbyong gi las chos dang ldan pa ni gcig ste/ 'di lta ste chos kyis 8mthun par byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ④'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon pa du mchis/ nye ba ⑫'khor lnga ste/ gsol tshub byas te gleng gzhi rngubaton nas lhag ma thos pas sgrogs par byed na dge 'dun gyis so sor thar pa bton 8cing gso sbyong byas pa yin no//1—345

gsol ba byas te gleng gzhi yang bton①/ pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi yang bton nas lhag ma thos pas sgrogs par byed na dge 'dun gyis so sor thar pa bton cing gso sbyong byas pa yin no/ /gsol ba byas te gleng gzhi ②yang bton/pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi ③yang bton④/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum yang bton nas lhag ma thos pas sgrogs par byed na dge 'dun gyis so sor thar pa bton ⑤cing gso sbyong byas pa yin no/ /gsol ba byas te gleng gzhi ༅yang bton/ pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi yang bton/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum yang bton⑦/ ma nges pa'i chos gnyis kyang bton nas lhag ma thos pas sgrogs par byed na dge 'dun gyis so sor thar pa ④bton cing gso sbyong byas pa yin no/ /so sor thar pa'i 'don ⑨pa rgyas par bton ⑩pa ni lnga pa yin no// //sdom la/ gnas dang dbyar snga phyi ma dang / /glo 7bur ba dang rgyu ba dang / /mtshan yol gso sbyong gyis shig dang / /sems bskyed pa yis gso sbyong bya/ /'di lta ste gnas shig na dge slong rab tu mang po dag 'khod pa de dag 'di ltar dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo / /dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang bongo / /snyam pa las de dag gi chagaso sbyong bcwa lnga pa de nyid la dge slong su la ciyang so sor thar pa mi snang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong de dag gis gnas bstabs ④pa dang /gnas mal bstabs 8pa dang / las bstabs ⑩pa dang / rnyed pa bstabs ⑫pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba bstabs pa yidang / dge slong gang la so sor 1—346

thar pa snang ba gnyer ①bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gang la so sor thar pa snang ba zhig rnyed ②na de lta na legs/ 'on te ma rnyed na dge slong de dag gis gnas de nyid du gso sbyong gzhan la bsdad par mi bya'o/ /sdod par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste gnas shig na dge slong rab tu mang po dag dbyar snga mar ②gnas par khas blang bar 'dod cing de dag 'di ltar dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo / /dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo snyam pa las/ de dag gis gso sbyong bcwa lnga pa de nyid la dge slong su la yang so sor thar pa mi snang nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / dge slong de dag gis gnas bstabs pa dang / gnas mal bstabs ④pa dang / las bstabs ⑤pa dang / rnyed pa bstabs yipa dang / bsnyen bkur ba ༅bstabs pas dge slong gang la so sor thar pa snang ②ba gnyer bar bya'o//gal te dge slong gang la so sor thar pa snang ⑨ba zhig rnyed na de lta ⑪ na legs/'on te ma rnyed na dge slong de dag gis gnas de nyid du dbyar snga mar gnas par khas blang bar ༅mi bya'o/ /khas len par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste gnas shig nas tsodage slong rab tu mang po dag dbyar snga mar gnas par khas blangs shing de dag 'di ltar dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo / /dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo snyam pa las / de dag gis tsogaso sbyong bcwa lnga pa de nyid la dge slong su la yang so sor ⑫thar pa mi snang ④nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong de dag gis gnas bstabs (9pa dang / gnas mal bstabs tsu)pa dang / las bstabs ④pa dang / rnyed pa bstabs yipa dang / bsnyen bkur ba bstabs 1—347

pas ①dge slong gang la so sor thar pa snang ba gnyer bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gang la so sor thar pa snang ba zhig rnyed ②na de lta na legs/ 'on te ma rnyed na dge slong de dag gis gnas de nyid du dbyar snga mar gnas par mi bya'o/ /gnas par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste gnas shig na dge slong rab tu mang po dag dbyar phyi mar gnas par khas blang ②bar 'dod ④cing de dag 'di ltar dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo / /dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo snyam pa las/ de dag gi ⑤gso sbyong bcwa lnga pa de nyid la dge slong su la yang so sor thar pa mi snang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong de dag gis gnas bstabs ⑥pa dang /gnas mal bstabs rtsopa dang / las bstabs du pa dang / rnyed pa bstabs pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba bstabs pas ⑨dge slong gang la so sor thar pa snang ba gnyer bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gang la so sor thar pa snang ba zhig rnyed na de lta na legs/ 'on te ma rnyed na dge slong de dag gis gnas de nyid du dbyar phyi mar gnas par khas blang bar rgyu )mi bya'o/ /khas len par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste gnas shig na dge slong rab tu mang po dag dbyar phyi mar gnas par khas blangs shing de dag 'di ltar dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo / /dge slong che ge mo zhig la so sor thar pa snang ngo snyam pa las de dag gis yigaso sbyong bcwa lnga pa de nyid la dge slong su la yang so sor thar pa mi snang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 4)bka' stsal pa/dge slong de dag gis gnas de nyid du zla ba gnyis so sor brtags 0te gnas par bya'o/ /zla ba gnyis 'das nas dge slong de dag gis gnas bstabs ④pa 1—348

dang / gnas mal bstabs ①pa dang / las bstabs ②pa dang / rnyed pa bstabs ②pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba bstabs pas khyodage slong gang la so ⑤sor thar pa snang ba gnyer bar bya'o/ /gal te dge slong gang la so ⑥sor thar pa snang ba zhig rnyed na de lta na legs/ 'on te ma rnyed ⑦na dge slong de dag gis niganas de nyid du gso sbyong gzhan la bsdad par mi bya'o/ /sdod ⑨par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba ci'akhor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa 'di lta ste dge slong gnyug mar gnas pa dag gis dge slong glo 7bur ba mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa dag mchi'o zhes thos nas 8de dag gis de dag la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ nye ba tso'akhor dge slong de dag gis dge slong glo 6bur ba mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa dag gi don du dpag tshad phyed dang gsum du gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa dag gis bsu 8bar bya'o/ /gal te 'grub na de lta na ⑩legs/'on te mi 'grub na rgyang grags lngar gdugs chadang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa dag gis bsu 8bar bya'o/ /gal te 'grub na de lta na legs/'on te mi 'grub na dpag tshad phyed dmayi/ rgyang grags gsum mam du tre/ rgyang grags sam/ rgyang grags phyed dam/ tha na khyams su yang gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa dag gis bsu 0bar bya'o/ /ngag gis bshes pa'i tshig gis bsus blanas lhung bzed dang chos/ gos dag blang bar bya'o/ /khrus bya zhing dge 'dun la yang snum bag gi rnyed pa dbul bar bya'o'u/ /de dag la gnas ( stebastabs ( )pa dang / gnas mal bstabs 0pa dang / las 1—349

bstabs pa dang / rnyed pa bstabs ①pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba bstabs ②pa dang / chos mnyan pa sbyin par bya'o/ /gal te la la zhig de na 'di skad ces/tshe dang ldan pa dag rab tu byung ba dag tu 'dra chan ci'i phyir dge slong de dag la ni mchod par 'os par byed la/ kho bo cag la ni 'os par mi byed ces zer na de la 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa ston pa 'das pa'i gsung rab la 'di ni ston pa'o/ /'di ni rten te/ 'di lta ste mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang /ma mo'o/ /de yang tshe dang ldan pa de dag gis rgya cher bklags ④shing thon pas de'i phyir 'di dag ni mchod par 'os pa yin gyi ⑤khyod ni ma yin no/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /'di lta ste gso sbyong bcwa lnga pa de nyid la dge slong lhan cig gnas pa dang / nye gnas dag ljongs rgyur 'dong bar 'dod na/ de dag la mkhan po dang slob dpon dag gis rnam pa ༅gang gis kyang gnang bar mi bya'o/ /gal te rkyen de lta bu zhig byung na tshe dang ldan pa dag gnas che rtson mo zhig na dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan dang bcas/ so sor thar pa dang bcas shing / dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa dang duyon tan dang ldan pa des pa dge ba'i chos can dag 'khod kyis/ de dag gis 'gyod pa ma skyes ⑨pa ni skyed par mi 'gyur la skyes ⑨ pa ni sel bar 'gyur gyis der deng ༅shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /gal te bstan pa de las gzhan du 'jug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gso sbyong bcwa lnga pa de nyid la dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mtshan mo yol gyis gso sbyong gyis shig /de nas dge slong zhig stan las langs te bla 1—350

gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ①te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de ②logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa gnas shig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs zhuche ba zhig mchis na de la bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgrub ④par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i yongs su dag pa blang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i yongs su dag pa blang bar bya'o zhes bka' stsal nas⑤/ dge slong dag gis ji ltar blang bar bya ba mi shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gcig gis gcig gi dang /gcig gis gnyis kyi dang / rab tu mang po rnams kyi ⑥yang rung ste/ dge 'dun gyi nang du ji snyed kyi ming dag brjod par nus pa'i bar du'o/ /dge slong dag ngas ⑦dge slong yongs su dag pa 'bul bar byed pa'i kun du spyad dupa'i chos rnams bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong yongs su dag pa 'bul bar byed pas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ mchil lham gnyis 2phud nas rgan rims rkyebazhin du phyag 'tshal te/ tsog tsog por 'dug nas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcwa lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong bro 'tshal skyob sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gso sbyong yang bcwa lnga pa lags te/bdag dge slong bro 'tshal chab sdug bsngal ba bro tshabs che ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ⑫bar chad kyi chos rnams yongs su dag go zhes bdag ④mchi'o/ /bdag gi gso sbyong yang yongs su dag ste/ yongs su dag pa yang brjod do/ /brjod pa yang rig ④par bgyid do/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ dge 1—351

slong yongs su dag pa 'bul bas gal te lus kyi ①rnam par rig byed kyis yongs su dag pa 'bul bar byed na yongs su dag pa phul bar brjod par bya'o/ /ngag gi rnam par rig byed kyis 'bul bar byed na yongs su dag pa phul bar brjod par bya'o/ /lus kyi 0rnam par rig byed dang / ngag gi rnam par rig byed kyis 'bul bar ②byed na yongs su dag pa phul bar brjod par bya'o/ /lus kyi rnam par rig byed kyis 'bul bar mi byed④/ ngag gi rnam par rig byed kyis kyang 'bul bar mi byed na dge 'dun thams cad der dong bar bya'o/ /yang na dge slong de dge 'dun gyi nang du blang bar bya'o/ /dge 'dun thams cad der dong ⑤bar mi byed dam༅/ dge slong de dge 'dun gyi nang du len par mi byed par mi mthun par byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong yongs su dag pa 'bul bar byed pas kun du spyad pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa rnams yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag ngas dge slong yongs su dag pa len pa'i kun du spyad pa'i ༅chos rnams bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong yongs su dag pa len pas yongs su dag pa blangs nas brgyug ༅par mi bya'o/ /mgyogs ⑨par mi bya'o/ /mchong tshubar mi bya'o/ /phyi rol la mchong bar mi bya'o/ /'obs la mchong bar mi bya'o/ /bang rim la ⑪mchong bar mi bya'o/ /steng gi nam mkha' la 'dug par mi bya'o/ /mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /gom pa gcig gis skas kyi ④rim pa gnyis la thod rgal du gzeg 8par mi bya'o/ /gom pa gcig gis them skas kyi them pa ⑫gnyis la thod rgal du gzeg 8par mi bya'o/ /chu lkog ma tshunub tsam la 'bog par mi bya'o/ /gnyid log par mi bya'o/ /snyoms par 'jug par mi bya'o/ /1—352
