bya'o / /gang gi ①tshe gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa rab tu byung ba de'i tshe de'i rkang mthil ②la gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba'i spu sor bzhi tsam yod pa de drug sde dag gis mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag gis smras pa/ dga' bo nye dga' re zhig mar sar gyi gong bu 'dra ba 'di gcig tu brtson pas ②bstan pa la rab tu byung nas ci zhig byed ces smras pa des thos so/ /des thos nas nga rgyal skyes te tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i drung du song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la dris pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyis gcig tu brtson pas ④bstan pa la ting nge 'dzin yun ring ༅du gnas par gsungs pa gang lags / tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes 'chag zhupas thob pa yin no/ /de bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du song nas 'chag zhus bcas so/ /de 'chag ⑤pa na spu gser gyi kha dog 'dra ba sor bzhi tsam po dag kyang zad do/ /de'i 'og tu pags ⑨pa rdol/ de'i 'og tu khrag byung ste/ de ji srid 'chag nyu) sa'i mgo gcig nas ༅cig nyunyeshos su song gi bar du de'i 'chag sa'i mgo gcig na yang khu dag khrag 'thung la gnyis pa na yang 'thung ngo / /chos nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho la gzhes 8pa ni dus dus su chu bor rgyu ba spyod do/ /zhes bya ba'i bar du rgyas par bya ste/ skabs 'dir ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang du rgyu zhing gshegs pa yin pas tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa'i gtsug lag khang gang na ba der gshegs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa'i 'chag sa gzigs sol/ /gzigs nas kyang thonyesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du 8med pa yin pas mkhyen bzhin du rmed de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 1—634

'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rmas ①pa/ kun dga' bo gcig tu brtson pa'i 'chag las 'di dge slong gang gi yin/ gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa'i lags so/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pas rim pa chagacig pa'i mchil lham bcang bar bya'o/ /rim gnyis pa ma yin/ rim gsum pa ma yin no/ /gal te rdol bar gyur na lhan pas btab ste bcang bar bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa gang na ba der so/nga ste son nas/ tshe dang ldan pa gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi shu pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shes par gyis shig ston pas khyod la mchil lham rim gcig pa rjes su gnang ste/rim gnyis pa ma yin/ rim gsum pa ma yin no zhes bya ba rgyas par sbyar ro/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo ci byadage 'dun thams cad la'am/ 'on te bdag 'ba' zhig la/ khyod 'ba' zhig la'o/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo ston pa'i bka' ni dumi gcog na/ gal te bdag gis bcangs na gzhi ༅des bdag la tshangs pa mtshungs ༅par spyod pa dag e ma'o gro bzhin skyes bye dub nyi shu pa rab tu byung nas ltog po zhig rnyed ⑩do/ /gang yang yul tsam pa thun mong tsom yin pa dang glang po che bdun gyi tshogs spangs te rab tu byung la/ deng mchil lham the ༅gi ⑫ba tsam la chags pa lta zhes gleng bar 'gyur 8te/ de lta mod kyi gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la bltos cite dge 'dun thams cad la rjes su gnang na ⑫bdag gis de bzhin du bcang bar bya'o cizhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos ⑩rgyas par gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ gro bzhin skyes bye ba nyi 1—635

shu pa la bltos ①nas dge 'dun thams cad kyis rim gcig pa'i mchil lham bcang bar bya ste/ rim gnyis pa ma yin zhes rgyas par sbyar ro / /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga na rgan zhugs mchil lham can gzhan zhig 'chag par byed pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong phar song nga'i spyan snga na ma 'dug cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams ②la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag re zhig 'jig rten thams cad kyi ②zang zing dang 'dres pa'i ston pa gang yin pa/ston pa de'i nyan thos rnams kyang 'di ltar myur ba myur bar ltung bar 'gyur ba'i brtul zhugs mi spyod na/ nga ci'ajig rten thams cad kyi zang zing dang bral bar gnas pa'i ④lta smos kyang ci dgos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa nyes dmigs gang ci byung ba de ni dge slong dag mchil lham 'chang ba yin te/de lta bas na dge slong gis mchil lham bcang bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis mchil tholham bcang bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang /gar mkhan zhugazhan zhig rab tu byung ba de'i chu zhusnod chag spunas de rkang pa bkru ba'i gnas su rkang pa bkrus nas kha'i nang 6chus bkang ste/ rma bya'i 'gros su song ba de drug sde rnams kyis mthong nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag rol mo'i sgra med par dge slong gar byed kyis tho)rol mo'i sgra bya'o zhes de rnams kyis khas rol mo'i sgra bya bar brtsams so/ /de rnams la dge slong dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ci ma grangs pa byed dam/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di la ma grangs su ci zhig yod khyed kyis rol mo'i sgra med par dge slong gar byed pa mthong ngam zhes bya ba'i 8skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge 1—636

slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / ①bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed pa yin pas mkhyen bzhin du khrurmed de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong de la rmas ①pa/ dge slong khyod kyis bsam pa ci zhig gis ④de lta bu byas/btsun pa gnas mal bsrung ⑤ba'i ⑥slad du'o/ /dge slong 'di gnas mal bsrung ⑦ba'i phyir de lta bu ⑤byed pa la ltung ba med de0/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ gnas mal bsrung ⑩ba'i phyir rim gcig pa'i mchil lham bcang bar bya'o/ /rim gnyis pa ma yin/ rim gsum pa ma yin/ gal te rdol bar gyur na lhan pas btab ste bcang bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rim gcig pa'i tsomachil lham bcang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / bsod snyoms pa gzhan zhig la khyim bdag cig dad par gyur to/ /de nang par sngar langs te mchil lham med par mnyan yod du bsod tsosnyoms la zhugs so/ /de mchil lham med pa khyim bdag des mthong ngo / /mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa la mchil lham ma mchis sam/ tshur spyon lham mkhan gyi drung du bzhud/ mchil lham cig tsunye'abul du stsal to/ /de lham mkhan gyi drung du song nas des lham mkhan la smras pa/ kye nang rje 'phags pa 'di la mchil lham cig phul cig ces bsgo cinas song ngo / /de'i tshe dge slong rnams dang / shi ba rnams dang gnyis kyi phyir mchil lham rim byagacig pa dag byas so/ /dge slong de yang ⑩yang du lham mkhan gyi drung du song yang ma byin no/ /dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag des yang dge slong mchil lham med pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ⑩smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod la lham mkhan gyis tsomachil lham ma phul lam/ khyim bdag ༅lham mkhan la bden par 0 smra ba dkon par kūkhyod kyis ma thos sam/ yang dang yang dusong 1—637

yang ma byin no/ /des smras pa/ 'phags pa tshur spyon khyim du bzhud/ des ①khyim du khrid nas kha zas bsod pas tshim par byas te rim pa mang po can gyi mchil lham zhig byin no/ /dge slong gis smras pa/ khyim bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang ngo / /des 'phags pa snoms ②te bzhud la rim gcig pa'i mchil lham mdzod la gsol cig /des de khyer te gnas khang du son dunas des de dang gri blangs te shing drung du 'dug nas dral ④bar brtsams so//bcom ldan 'das kyang phyogs der byon nas dge slong ci byed/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rim pa mang po can gyi mchil lham bkag na bdag la rim pa mang po can 'di lta bu grub ste/ rim pa dugacig par bgyis la bcang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du e ma'o nga'i nyan thos rnams la bram ze dang /khyim bdag dad pa can dag gis rim pa mang po'i mchil lham ster ba lta ༅snyam rkyedu dgongs nas/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ mchil lham rim pa mang po can khyim pa'i dman num yin phan chad bcang bar bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa nye ba lku'akhor gyis zhus te zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis mchil lham rim pa mang po can khyim pa'i dman co ma yin phan chad bcang bar bya'o zhes gsungs na/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis na khyim pa'i dman byam lags par brjod par bgyi/ nye ba 6'khor tha na gom pa bdun nam brgyad bgos par gyur na yang yin no// gleng gzhi cini yangs pa can na'o④/ /de'i tshe yangs pa can na 'di lta bu'i mchil lham dag byed de/ 'di lta ste/ thig thig /tshig tshig blachem chem zhes zer ba lug ru'am/ byang chub kyi shing gi lo ma lta bu khra bo kār ṣā pa ṇa 1—638

lnga ri ba dag byed do/ /drug sde dag gis mchil lham gon ①pa zhig mthong nas de dag gi ②ting pa rkang pa'i mthe bos ②mnan nas ltag pa ④nas phul te khyod kyis sbyin pa 'di phul bas sems kyi rgyan dang / sems kyi yo byad ⑤dang /rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / don gyi mchog sangs rgyas nyid thob par gyur cig ces byas nas blangs pa dang / phyogs kun du 'phags pa dag ni lham de lta bu 'phrog go༅/ /zhes sgra grags so༅/ /rgan mo zhig gi mag dupa zhig 'ongs pa dang / de la des mchil lham zhig byin nas 'phags pa dag mchil lham 'phrog gis kluji nas kyang 'phrog ⑩par mi 'gyur bar bag yod par gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /phyis skyobasod snyoms pa zhig bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs pa des mthong nas de khyim zhig tu zhugs so/ /de yang de nyid du zhugs pa dang / 8khyim de nas 8byung nas khyim gzhan zhig tu zhugs so/ /bsod snyoms pas kyang de nyid du zhugs pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod don ci'i phyir kho bo'i borjes bzhin 8du 'brang ba ④ci mchil lham 'di dbrog ⑩par bzhed mod/ bzhin bzangs khyod kyi mchil lham kho bo mi 'phrog ste/ 'on kyang kho bo bsod snyoms kyi phyir zhugs so//des smras pa/ 'phags pa 'phrog kyang rung mi 'phrog kyang rung ste/ 'on kyang phyogs kun tu 'phags pa khyed cag mchil lham 'phrog go zhes sgra grags 8pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/ nyes dmigs gang ci byung ba de ni dge slong dag mchil lham thig thig yices bya ba nas de lta bas na dge slong gis mchil lham thig thig sgro zer ba bcang bar mi bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar rgyas par sbyar rol/ /de lta bu bcang bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis de lta bu'i mchil lham 1—639

bcangs ①na 'gal 0tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi zhuni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong rnams mchil lham gyis rkang pa'i bol ④mi byung ba bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas/khyed cag gi 0zhabs kyi bol ji zhuzhig gis rma byung bar gyur/ mchil lham gyis so/ /ci khyed cag gis bsogs su bcings nas ma bcangs ⑦sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang ngo zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dubaka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ bsegs su bcings nas bcang bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams bya rgod kyi kluphung po'i ri la 'dzeg byapa na rkang pa'i mthe bor rma byung ngo //de dag bram ze dang khyim bdag dag myagis mthong nas smras pa/ khyed cag gi zhabs mthe bo la nyunyeci zhig gis rma byung / bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la 'dzeg skupa na'o / /ci khyed cag gis mchil lham gyi rtse mo sbu bu thoXcan ma bcangs sam/bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang mngo zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na thoXrjes su gnang ste/ dge slong gis mchil lham nyu)rtse mo sbu bu (smebacang bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams bya rgod kyi 2phung po'i ri las babs pa na rkang pa'i rting pa rma byung ba bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/'phags pa khyed cag rnams kyi zhabs kyi rting pa ci zhig gis rma byung / bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri las babs pa na'o/ /ci khyed cag gis mchil lham gyi rting pa spu bu pya can ma bcangs sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang ngo zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang /1wa 640

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ dge slong gis mchil lham gyi rting pa sbu bu ①can bcang bar bya'o// //sdom la/ mgul chad dang ni yu'u ②thung lham/ /kha dukhrod dag tu sgro ༅gu can / /dom gyi pags ⑤pa gnang ba dang / /smyung bu 'breng bu chu gri'o/ /gleng gzhi 'uni mnyan thoyod na'o/ /dge slong rnams rtswa'i dustsa gus rkang pa rma byung ba dag bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa dag khyed cag gi zhabs ci zhig gis rma byung / rtswa'i myu gus so/ /ci khyed cag gis lham mgul chad ma bcangs sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang rtsango zhes bya ba'i co skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/lham mgul chad bcang bar bya'o/ /gang gi tshe rtswa'i nyunyemyu gu dag mcher skyes pa de'i tshe dge slong rnams kyi rkang pa de bas kyang rma cher byung ba bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyis mthong nas smras pa/ khyed cag gi nyunyezhabs ci zhig gis rma byung /de rnams kyis smras pa/ rtswa'i comyu gu dag cher skyes pas bdag cag gi 6rkang pa de bas kyang rma cher byung ngo / /'phags pa rnams ci khyed cag gis lham yu'u skyethung ma bcangs sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang ngo zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ lham yu'u ⑩thung bcang bar bya'o/ /gang gi tshe skyes bu gti mug 'phags skyes pos ser skya na gnas pa'i shākya rnams kha btag 8pa na/ de dag las kha cig nub phyogs su 1—641

dong ba nas/ kha cig bal yul gyi bar du dong ngo / /mnyan yod pa'i don mthun dag zong thogs te bal yul du lhags pa dang / de dag gis de rnams mthong nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag gang nas da 'dir lhags/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ mnyan yod nas so/ /bdag cag gi gnyen 'phags pa kun dga' bo ༅yod na lan 'ga' yang 'phags pa kun dga' bo 'dir 'ongs te snubadag cag la gtam ma dris so/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ bdag cag gi ②'phags pa kun dga' bo'i byadrung du song la sbran par bgyi'o/ /de rnams kyis zong rnams bsgyur ba'i zong dag khyer te mnyan yod du lhags nas de rnams kyis 'phags pa kun dga' bo dul smras pa/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo khyod kyi gnyen bal yul na mchis te de dag khyod zhumathong bar 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ni gnyen la gdung ba yin pas de gnyen dag la blta ba'i ④phyir bal yul du song ba las/ de lhags pas lag pa dang rkang pa ser ga byung ba dang / de la dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo pad ma'i 'dab dum ral pa bzhin du khyod kyi lag pa dang rkang pa ci ༅zhig rtsagis ⑪ser ga byung bar gyur/ des 7smras pa/ lhags pas so/ /khyod kyi gnyen dag ni lham sgro gu can ci ste 'chang / khyod ni 6ci'i phyir mi 'chang bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang ngo zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ yul kha ba can rnams su lham sgro cig can bcang bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa nye ba 8'khor gyis zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis yul kha ba can rnams su ⑩lham sgro ⑩1—642

gu can bcang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa gang lags pa/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis yul kha ba can du brjod par bgyi/ /nye ba ①'khor gang na snod du chu 'khyag pa yin no/ /dge slong gzhan ②zhig la rngon pa zhig dad par gyur dunas/ rngon pa des dom lpags shig rnyed pa dge slong de la phul ba dang des ma blangs so/ chi/des dge slong de'i phyi bzhin 'brang zhing smras pa/ 'phags pa bdag gis dom lpags rnyed pa khyod la 'bul gyis bubazhes shig /dge slong des ma blangs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang phyogs der gshegs te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed pa yin pas mkhyen bzhin du rmed de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das phyokyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rmas ༅pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong 'o ni'i ④phyi bzhin du rngon pa pha bi ci ste 'brang / btsun pa rngon pa des dom lpags shig rnyed nas/ des dge slong 'o ni la stsal pa las/dge slong gis de ma blangs pa dang rngon pa de dge slong 'o ni'i duphyi bzhin 'brang zhing ⑨mchi'o⑩/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rngon pa dad pa can ni dkon te/ gal te brgya'am stong zhig dang phrad skyon thams cad gsod pa yin pasasku/ de bas na gal te rngon pas dom lpags byin na blang bar bya'o/ /blangs 8nas dri gtsang khang gi sgo'am/ rkang pa'i 'og tu gding 5bar bya ste/ dom lpags thams cad ni mig la phan no/ /dge slong gzhan zhig blamachil lham ral nas spre'ude lham mkhan gyi drung du song ste son nas smras pa/bzhin bzangs bdag gi mchil lham ral ba rgyus ༅te bdag la byin cig /lham mkhan gyis bsams 8pa/ shākya'i sras kyi yidage sbyong zhu rnams ni rngan 0pa med par 'tshol gyis duyun ring du bsgyangs 0pa dang / rang gi blo slar ldog ④1wa 643

par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ 'phags pa bdag brel gyis ①sang spyon cig /dge slong de yang dang yang du lham mkhan de'i drung du song yang des bsgyangs ②pa dang /de mdza' bshes dge slong rnams kyis mthong nas de la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa ci de na khyed kyi ②zas sbyor ba'i khyim yod dam/ 'on te gnyen gyi 'khyim yod/des smras pa/ de na bdag gi zas sbyor ba'i khyim yang med/ gnyen gyi khyim yang med mod kyi bdag gi mchil lham ral nas bdag gis de la rgyus te byin ⑤cig ces smras na thodes bsgyangs so/ /des smras pa/ ⑦lham mkhan la bden par smra ba dkon par khyod kyis ma thos sam/ 'on kyang bdag shes dukyis ⑨gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang na bdag gis ⑨ brgyus te khyod la sbyin no zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gang zhig shes pa yod na des gang du gzhan tsunyegyis mthong na mi dad par mi 'gyur ba dben pa'i phyogs su 'dug ste brgyu bar bya'o/ /de de'i drung du song ste smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su gnang gis rgyus the1shig /des smras pa/ ci 'di de bzhin du brgyur rung snyam mamanyu5/ de la re zhig smyung bu dang / dra gri dang / 'breng bu yang dgos so zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gang zhig shes pa yod na des smyung bu dang / 'breng cibu ni bcang bar bya'o/ /dra ④gri ni bcang bar mi bya'o/ /ko lpags kyi gzhi rdzogs stos// //sman gyi gzhi'i ⑩bsdus pa'i sdom la/ sman dag dang ni bde chen tsodang / /1—644

rgyal po'i ①khab dang 'od ma'i tshal②/ /shing mkhan yid ⑤tsa nang ga la/ /kum bi la dang sngon rgyal po'o④/ /gzhon nu 'phel dang nad pa dang / /gtam du gyur dang sder bsdus sos/ /sdom la/ sman ni rjes su gnang ba dang / /tshil dang g.yan pa mig sman dang / /smyon pa dang ni pi lin da⑥/ /nam gru ⑦dang ni skyur khu'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe dge slong rnams ston ma'i nad kyis thebs te/ de rnams ston ku'i nad kyis btab pas skya bo bseng bseng dupor gyur cing rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang /na bas nyam spudams par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rtsarmed pa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rmas hupa/ kun dga' bo ci'i phyir da 6ltar dge slong 'di rnams skya bo bseng bseng thosapor gyur cing rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang /na bas nyam rtso )dmas par gyur tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/btsun 6pa dge slong 'di rnams ston ku'i bro nad kyis btab ste/ 'di rnams ston ku'i bro nad kyis btab pas skya bo bseng bseng skyepor gyur cing rid pa dang /nyam chung ba dang / bro 'tshal bas nyam skyedams par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/dge slong gis sman so sor bsten par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis sman so sor bsten 8par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de rnams dus su za ba yin pas dus su sten 7par byed kyisadu / dus las yol bar sten par mi byed pas de rnams skya bo bseng bseng 0por gyur cing rid pa dang / nyam 1—645

chung ba dang / na bas nyam ①dmas par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhuni mkhyen bzhin du med pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rmas ②pa/ kun dga' bo ngas dge slong gis sman so sor bsten par bya'o zhes bka' stsal na/ 'on kyang da ④ltar dge slong 'di rnams skya bo bseng bseng zhupor gyur cing rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang / na bas nyam dmas ⑥par gyur tam/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/ ༅bcom ldan 'das kyis dudage slong gis sman so sor bsten par bya'o zhes gsungs pa 'di dag dus su 'tshal ba lags pas ④dus su byasten ⑩par bgyid kyi dus las yol bar mi sten tho)te/ de'i slad du skya bo bseng bseng ⑫por gyur cing rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang / bro 'tshal bas nyam cadams par gyur lags so/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ dge slong rnams kyis sman rnam 8pa bzhi po dus su rung ba dang / thun tshod du rung ba dang / zhag bdun pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba so sor bsten par bya'o/ /de la dus su rung ba ni 'de the'ugu dang / 'bras chan tho)dang /zan dron dang / sha dang / snum khur ro/ /thun tshod du rung ba ni btung ba rnam 8pa brgyad po shing thog tso tsa'i nyu)btung ba dang / chu shing gi 'bras bu'i btung ba dang / rgya shug gi btung ba dang / a shwat+tha'i zhu btung ba dang / u dum bā ra'i btung byab dang / pa ru sha ma'i btung ba dang / rgyan 'bru'i byabatung ba dang / 'bra go'i btung ba'o3 // //bar sdom la/ tso tsa chu shing rgya shug dang / /a shad u dum bā du ra dang //1wa 646

ba ru sha ka rgyan 'bru ①dang / /brgyad pa yang ni 'bra go yin/ /zhag bdun pa ni mar dkar dang / /til mar dang / bu ram gyi dbu ba dang / sbrang ②rtsi dang / sha kha ra'o/ / 'tsho ba'i ③bar du bcang ba ni rtsa ba'i ⑤sman dang /sdong bu'i sman dang / lo ma'i sman dang / me tog gi sman dang / 'bras bu'i sman dang / trang chu lnga dang / thal ba lnga dang / lan tshwa lnga dang /bska ba lnga'o/ /de la rtsa ba'i sman ni gla sgang ⑤dang / shu dag dang / yung ⑥dang / sge'u gsher dang / bong zhung dkar po dang / gzhan yang rtsa ba'i sman gyi nang du gtogs pa zas kyi don du mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa'o/ /sdong bu'i sman ni tsan dan dang / dbyi mo dang / shug pa dang / thang shing dang /sle tres dang / skyer dupa dang / gzhan yang sdong bu'i klusman gyi nang du gtogs pa zas kyi mdon du mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa'o/ /lo ma'i sman ni pa to la'i lo ma dang / ba sha ga'i lo ma dang / nim pa'i lo ma dang / ko sha ta ga'i skyelo ma dang / sap+ta par+ṇa'i nyu)lo ma dang / gzhan yang lo ma'i sman gyi nang du gtogs pa'i nyunyezas kyi don du mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa'o/ /me tog gi sman ni me tog lnga po ba sha ku'i me tog dang / nim pa'i me tog dang / dha 6ka'i me tog dang / sha ta'i me tog dang / pad ma ke sa ra'i me tog dang / gzhan yang me tog gi sman gyi nang du gtogs pa zas kyi don du mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa'o / /'bras bu'i sman ni a ru ra dang / skyu ru ra dang / ba ru ra dang /na le sham dang / pi pi ling dang / gzhan yang 'bras bu'i sman gyi nang du gtogs pa zas kyi don du mi 'gyur ba gang yin pa'o/ /trang chu lnga ni shing kun dang / sra rtsi dang / rgya skegs dang / spra tshil dang / drod sman 8no/ /1—647

de la shing kun ni shing kun gyi ①sdong chu'o/ /sra rtsi ni shing sa ②la'i trang chu'o/ /rgya skegs ni rgya skegs so/ /spra tshil ni spra tshil lo/ /drod sman ni de dag las gzhan ②pa'i shing rnams kyi trang chu'o/ /thal ba lnga gang zhe na/ nas kyi thal ba dang / nas kyi phub ma'i thal ba dang / shing sardzi ④ka'i thal ba dang / til gyi thal ba dang / shing 'ba' shig ⑤ka'i thal ba'o/ /lan tshwa lnga gang zhe na/rgyam tshwa dang / ⑥lan tshwa smug po dang / kha ru tshwa dang / lan tshwa dang / rgya mcho1) lan na'iro/ /bska ba lnga gang zhe na/ a mra'i bska ba dang / nim pa'i bska ba dang / 'dzam bu'i bska ba dang / sha ri sha'i ④bska ba dang / ko sham pa'i bska ba'o/ /de la dus su rung ba gang yin pa dang / thun tshod du rung ba gang yin pa dang / zhag bdun pa gang yin pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba gang yin pa dude dus su rung ba dang 'dres par gyur na dus su spyad par bya'i mdus ma yin par longs spyad cepar mi bya'o/ /dus su rung ba gang yin pa dang / thun tshod du rung ba gang yin pa dang / zhag bdun pa gang yin pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba gang yin pa de gal te thun tshod du rung ba dang 'dres par gyur na thun tshod la yongs su spyad par bya'i thun tshod las 'das par spyad par mi bya'o/ /zhag bdun pa gang yin pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba gang yin pa de zhag hubadun pa dang 'dres par gyur na zhag bdun /3spyad par bya'i zhag bdun las 'das par spyad par mi bya'o/ /'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba ni 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang bar byin gyis brlabs nas yongs su spyad par bya'o/ /byin gyis brlab pa ni 'di ltar bya ste/ zan ma zos nga/'i mdun du lag pa gnyis bkrus nas byin len byas te/ dge slong 1—648

zhig gi mdun ①du 'dug nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag ②ming 'di zhes bgyi ⑤ ba'i sman ni ④bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi don du 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang bar byin gyis brlab bo/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod ⑤do/ /'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba ༅byin gyis brlab pa ji lta ba de bzhin du thun ༅tshod du rung ba dang / zhag bdun pa yang byin gyis brlab par bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan ④yod na'o/ /de spunas ⑩dge slong gzhan zhig rlung nad kyis thebs nas des ༅sman pa'i drung du song ste/ bzhin bzangs kho bo 'di 'dra ba'i nad kyis btab 8na sman ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa tshil sten cig dang khyod sos par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong gis smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ci kho bo kye'adre yin nam/ sman pas smras pa/ dge slong khyod kyi sman 'di yin te gzhan gyis ni sos par mi nus so zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te sman pa na re dge slong khyod 6kyi coman 'di yin te gzhan gyis ⑪ni sos par mi nus so zhes smra man tshil bsten par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis ma shes nas sman pa la dris pa dang / des smras pa/ 'phags pa khyed cag gi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa yin gyis 8/ de kho na'i drung du bzhud la zhus shig /skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcorme ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshil lnga so sor bsten ༅par bya ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ nya tshil dang / sbal pa dkar ⑥ po'i tshil dang / chu srin byis pa gsod 0kyi tshil dang / dom tshil dang / phag gi tshil lo/ /tshil 'di lnga dus ma yin 1wa 649

par btsos pa dang / dus ma yin par btsags pa dang / dus ma yin par byin len byas pa ①dang / dus ma yin par byin gyis brlabs na longs spyad par mi bya'o/ /dus su btsos la dus ma yin par btsags/ dus ma yin par byin dulen byas/ dus ma yin par byin gyis brlabs na longs spyad par mi bya'o//dus su btsos dus su btsags ②dus ma yin par byin ④len byas/ dus ma yin par byin gyis brlabs na spyad par mi bya'o/ /dus su btsos/ dus su btsags / dus su byin ④len byas la dus ma yin par byin gyis brlabs na ⑥spyad par mi bya'o/ /dus su btsos ④dus su btsags/ dus su byin len byas/②dus su byin gyis brlabs na til mar la spyod pa bzhin du zhag bdun du spyad par bya'o / /de nas dge slong des tshil longs spyad nas sos par gyur to/ /de sos par gyur pa dang / des tshil gyi ༅lhag ma dag bor ro/ /ji tsam na dge slong gzhan zhig de 'dra ba'i nad kyis thebs nas de yang sman pa'i drung du song nas smras pa/ bzhin sku bzangs kho bo la 'di 'dra ba'i nad kyis btab kyis ⑪sman ston cig /des de la yang tshil bstan 8pa dang / de dge slong de'i drung du song nas smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis tshil spyad pa kho bo la yang sman pas bstan na tshil lhag pa lta cung 8zad ciyod dam/ des smras pa/ bdog bdog pa las bdag gis de bor ro/ /ma legs pa zhig byas so/ /zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis 8gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis tshil longs spyad pa'i lhag ma bor bar mi bya ste/ 'on kyang bcang bar bya'o/ /ngas tho9dge slong tshil 'chang ba'i kun du spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ tshil 'chang ba'i dge slong 1—650

gis tshil spyad pa'i lhag ma dge slong gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /gal te ma byin na sman khang du gzhag par bya ste/ su 'dod pa des blang bar ①bya'o/ /tshil 'chang ba'i dge slong gis kun du spyod pa'i chos ji ②ltar bcas par ③yang dag par blangs nas 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe dge slong gzhan zhig g.yan pa'i nad kyis thebs nas/ des ④min pa'i drung du ⑤song ste/bzhin bzangs kho bo g.yan pa'i nad kyis btab kyis ༅sman ston cig des smras pa/'phags pa bska ba sten cig dang khyod sos par 'gyur ro/ /bzhin bzangs ci kho bo 'dod pa la spyod pa yin nam/ des smras pa/ dge slong khyod kyi sman 'di yin te gzhan gyis ni sos par mi nus so zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang zhes bya ba'i bar rtsogong ma bzhin du ste / khyod kyi ston pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa yin pas/ de kho nas mkhyen par 'gyur duzhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bska ba ni lnga ste a mra'i bska ba zhes bya ba nas gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong des bska ba dag 'de ⑨gur byas te lus la byugs pa las rma mched nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ phye ma bya'o dge slong dag gis 0rlon pa la btags 7pas ri lur gyur pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bskam par bya'o/ /de dag gis nyi ma la bskams pa dang / mthu nyams par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nyi ma la bskam 8par mi bya'o/ /de dag gis grib ma la bskams 8pa dang 'on kyang rul bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 1—651

stsal pa/ nyi ma'i grib mas bskam ①par bya'o/ /dge slong gis bska bas lus byugs nas bkrus te ②bska ba'i bya ba mi byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag pas ji tsam chog gi bar du dril nas khrus bya'o/ /bkrus nas slar yang bska bas bskus nas bkrus na ①bska ba'i bya ba byed par 'gyur ro//dge slong des bsku bas bskus pa dang nad zhi bar gyur to des bska ba'i lhag ma bor ro/ /ji tsam na dge slong gzhan ④zhig de 'dra ba'i nad kyis thebs nas de yang sman pa'i drung du song ste zhes bya ba nas gong ma bzhin du ste/ kho bos de ni bor ro/ /ma legs pa zhig byas so zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ngas bska ba 'chang ba'i dge slong gi kun du spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/bska ba 'chang ba'i dge slong gis bska ba spyad pa'i lhag ma dge slong su slong ba de la sbyin par bya'o/ /gal te ma byin na sman khang du gzhag ⑤par bya'o/ /bska ba bcang rjoba'i dge slong gis kun du spyod pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa yang dag par blangs te ⑦'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ⑤ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe dge slong gzhan zhig mig nad kyis phebs nas de sman pa'i drung du song ste bzhin bzangs kho bo mig nad kyis thebs par gyur na kho bo la sman ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa mig sman so sor sten cig dang khyed 0sos par 'gyur ro/ /bzhin bzangs ci kho bo 'dod pa la rmyaspyod dam 'phags pa khyod kyi sman 'di yin te gzhan gyis ni sos par mi nus so zhes bya ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te sman pa na re 1—652

sman 'di yin te gzhan gyis ni sos par mi nus so zhes zer na mig sman bsten par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis mig sman gang bsten par bya ba ①ma shes nas de dag gis sman pa la dris pa dang des smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod nyid ②kyi ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa yin gyis ③zhes bya ba'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mig sman ni lnga ste/ me tog gi ④mig sman dang / khu ba'i mig sman dang /phye ma'i mig sman dang / ri lu'i mig sman dang / btsag yug snam gyi ⑤mig sman no/ /de nas dge slong des mig sman de bsten nas sos par gyur to/ /des mig sman gyi lhag ma gar bab bab tu bzhag pa las de chud zos par gyur to/ /ji tsam na dge slong gzhan zhig mig nad kyis thebs nas des kyang sman pa la dris pa dang / des de la yang mig ༅sman de nyid bstan to/ /de dge slong de'i drung du song nas tshe dang ldan pa kho bo yang mig nad kyis btab par gyur na khyod la mig sman gyi lhag ma cung zad yod dam/ des btsal ༅bar brtsams pa las ma rnyed nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mig sman de bdog bdog ste bzhag ⑧pa las der ⑨stor to zhes pa'i ⑩ skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong gis mig sman gar bab bab tu gzhag ༅par mi bya'o/ /ngas mig sman 'chang ba'i dge slong gi 8kun du spyad 8pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ mig sman 'chang ba'i dge slong gis mig sman rnams so sor phye la gzhag par bya ste/ me tog gi mig sman ni snod kyi nang du'o/ /khu ba'i mig sman ni gab tse'i byanang du'o/ /phye ma'i mig sman ni dong bu'i nang du'o/ /ri lu'i mig sman dang btsag yug snam 1—653

gyi ①mig sman ni sgye'u ②'am/ thum ①por skud pas bcings ④la zung nga la ⑤gdags par bya'o/ /mig sman 'chang ba'i dge slong gis kun du spyad ⑥pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs nas 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi ⑦ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa bye ma skyes sems 'khrugs te smyos par gyur nas de de dang de dag tu 'phyan pa/ ji tsam na bram ze dang khyim bdag dag dugis mthong ste de dag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'di su'i bu zhig yin/ gzhan dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag che ge mo zhig gi'o / /de dag gis smras pa shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong mgon rtsamed pa rtsarnams kyi nang du rab tu ma byung na 'di gnyen rnams kyis gsos par 'gyur ba 4zhig ces pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong bye ma skyes kyi dpyad sman pa la dris la byos shig /sman pa'i drung du dong nas bzhin bzangs dge slong zhig 'di 'dra ba'i nad kyis thebs kyis skyede'i sman ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa skyedag sha rjen 'tshal du stsol cig dang cosos par 'gyur ro//bzhin bzangs de ci 'dre yin nam/ 'phags pa de'i sman 'di lags te gzhan gyis ni sos par mi nus so zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te sman pa na blare 8de'i sman 'di yin te gzhan gyis ni sos par mi nus so zhes zer na sha rjen pa sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis de bzhin du byin pa dang /de zar ma btub bo bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mig ras kyis 1—654

bkab la sbyin par bya'o/ /de dag gis byin te byin ma thag tu ras phye ba dang des lag pa la reg pa mthong nas ①zhe ba ②log pas skyugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod la ras dbye bar mi bya ste de lta mod kyi bca' ba dang bza' ①ba gtsang zhing bsod pa dag mdun du bzhag nas gang gi tshe de'i ④lag pa bkrus pa de'i tshe de dbye bar bya'o/ /de sos par gyur pa dang de de nyid la srid ⑤par gyur pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/tshi gang gi tshe sos par gyur pa ④de'i tshe bslab pa ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs te 'jug par bya'o/ /longs spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi rgyani rgyal po'i khab na'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu gang gi tshe rab tu byung ba de tshun chad rtag tu na ba dang zug gzer rtsamang por gyur pa dang / de la dge slong dag gis smras pa/ gnas brtan khyod kyi 6snyan gyi zo ji lta des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag rgyun du na ba dang zug gzer skyemang bas the ge ba'i 6skabs med do/ /gnas brtan khyod sngon ci zhig 'chang bar byed / des smras pa/ sman gyi mchan khug go/ /de ci'i phyir mi bcang thormibacom ldan 'das kyis rjes su ma gnang ngo zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste dge slong gis sman gyi ④mchan khug bcang bar bya'o/ /dge slong dag gis rtsa 8ba dang / me tog dang sdong bu dang /'bras bu'i sman rags pa dag de'i nang du bcug ⑩pa dang de dag rul nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de dag sbam pa'am bam por byas te 1—655

zung nga la gdags ①par bya'o/ /de dag rul nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dus dus su dubaskam par bya'o/ /de dag gis nyi ma la bskams pa dang de dag mthu chung bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ nyi ma la bskam par mi bya'o/ /de dag gis grib ma la bskams pa dang 'on kyang rul bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 0bka' stsal pa/ grib ma la bskam par mi bya'o/ /de dag gis bting byanas dong ba dang / char pa dang rlung byung ste ma bsdus dunas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bsdu ⑥bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bsdu ༅bar bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang de dag gis sus ⑧bsdu ba ma shes nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/khyim pas so/ /khyim pa med na dge sbyong gis so/ /dge sbyong med na dge slong nyid kyis bsdu bar bya'o/ /dge slong gis bsdus 2pa dang 'dres par gyur nas 'dres so zhes ma zos pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ so sor phye nas longs spyad par bya ste/ de la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /ngas rtson ba dag la rjes su gnang ba gang yin pa de tha mal skyepa'i gnas skabs na spyad 8par mi bya'o/ /spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro//gleng gzhi lku ni mnyan yod na'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru gar yang som nyi za bas de'i ming nam gru som nyi can nam gru som nyi can zhes bya bar grags so/ /de snga dro sham thabs bgos chos gos dang lhung bzed thogs nas mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs te de rim gyis bu ram byed pa'i grong du phyin pa dang /ji tsam na 'bras phye dang bu ram sbru byabar byed pa mthong nas des smras pa/ shes ldan dag bu ram 'bras phye dang ma sbru 8shig /'phags pa spyi bar bgyid pa 1—656

gzhan 'ga' mkhyen nam/ kho bos spyi ba gzhan yang mi shes mod kyi bdag cag dus ma yin par longs spyod dgos ①so/ /'phags pa dus su'am dus ma yin par gsol ba ②yang rung ste/ de'i spyi ba ni 'di lags te gzhan gyis ni mi 'brus so ②ji tsam dus ④gzhan zhig na dge 'dun gyis thubaca' ba bu ram dag rnyed zhun des ma zos so/ /de'i lhan cig gnas pa dang nye gnas dag gis smras pa slob ⑦dpon dge 'dun gyi bca' ba bu ram zhig brnyes kyis longs spyad ⑤du gsol / des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs ⑨zas dang 'dres so de byadag gis kyang longs ma spyad pa dang de rnams la dge slong gzhan dag gis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dge 'dun gyi bca' ba bu ram zhig brnyes yin ci ste longs mi spyad de dag gis smras pa mkhan po'i zhal nas 'di zas dang 'dres so zhes gsungs so nyunyede rnams kyis kyang longs ma spyad nyu5do 'khor pal po che de byadang dge 'dun ril las kyang phal mcher longs mi 4spyad pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams nyu)kyis gsol pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / zas kyis nyunyezas kyi bya ba mi byed pa ni mi rnyed pas 'byung khung nyu)yongs su dag pas longs du spyad par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod byapar mi bya'o//gleng gzhi zhuni mnyan yod na'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa nam gru snga dro sham thabs bgos chos gos dang lhung bzed thogs nas mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs so'u/ /rim gyis srang zhig tu phyin pa dang des spos 'tshong 3zhig phye la reg nas bu ram la reg par byed pa mthong nas des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs phye la reg nas bu ram la reg par ma byed/ dus ma yin par yang bdag cag gis longs spyad dgos so des smras pa/ 'phags pa dag chal yang dang yang du sug 1—657

chab gtong ba su zhig mchis/ dus gzhan zhig na dge 'dun gyi bca' ba bu ram zhig rnyed pa dang des longs ma spyad ༅do/ /lhan cig gnas pa dang nye gnas dag gis smras pa slob dpon dge 'dun gyi bca' ba bu ram dag brnyes ②na ci ste mi gsol des smras pa/ bzhin bzangs 'di zas dang 'dres so/ /de rnams kyis kyang longs ma spyad ②pa dang de rnams la dge slong dag gis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa dag dge 'dun gyi bca' ba bu ram zhig brnyes ④na ci ste mi za de rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan po'i zhal nas 'di zas dang 'dres so zhes gsung ngo / /de dag gis kyang longs ma spyad do/ /'khor phal po che de dang dge 'dun ril las kyang phal ches longs ma spyad pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/zas kyis zas kyi bya ba mi byed pas 3mi rnyed kyis thokhyim pas yongs su dag pas longs spyad par bya ste/ de la 'gyod 3par mi bya'o//gleng gzhi ni mnyan 3yod na'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rlung nad kyis thebs nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi 6bu chen pos bsams 6pa tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bdag rang gi blos rim gro ni lan mang du byas mod kyi lan 'ga' yang sman pa la ma dris kyisaskye/ ma la da ni sman pa la dri'o snyam nas de sman pa'i drung du song ste/ bzhin bzangs tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di 'dra ba'i nad kyis thebs par gyur na de'i sman ston cig des smras pa/ 'phags 8pa skyur khu'i nang du lan tshwa stsol la gsol cig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /des skyur khu ni rnyed na lan tshwa med nas de lan tshwa btsal bar brtsams ④pa dang tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu kho bo 8la lan tshwa ⑩1—658

rwa gang 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang bar byin gyis brlabs pa zhig yod kyis①/gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na sbyin no zhes smras pa tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus thos nas des smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ②gyi bu chen po kho bo 'di snyam du sems te/ 'tsho ba'i bar du bcangs pa ①dus su rung ba dang 'dres pa chelongs spyad par mi dbang ngo 6snyam mo zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ⑥gyi bu chen pos gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mod gal ⑦gyi bu mi dbang ste/ dus su rung ba gang yin pa dang / thun tshod du rung ba gang yin pa dang / zhag bdun pa gang yin pa dang 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba gang ⑧yin pa de gal te dus su rung ba dang 'dres par gyur la/ gal te byin gyis kyang rtsam brlabs na dus su rung ba dang 'dres pas dus su spyad par bya'i dus las 'das par spyad par rtsomi bya'o//thun tshod du rung ba gang yin pa dang / zhag bdun pa gang yin pa dang /'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba gang yin pa de gal te ljonyethun tshod du rung ba dang 'dres par gyur la/ gal te nyu)byin gyis ma brlabs na thun tshod du rung ba dang 'dres pas thun tshod du spyad par 6bya'i thun tshod las 'das par spyad par mi bya'o//zhag bdun pa gang yin pa dang / 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba 6gang yin pa de zhag bdun pa dang 'dres par gyur na zhag bdun pa dang 'dres pas 8zhag bdun du spyad par bya'i 8zhag bdun las 'das par spyad par mi bya'o/ /'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba gang yin pa de ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du spyad par bya ste gzhan du spyod na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //1—659

sdom la/ sde chen sha dang gzhang 'brum dang / /rlung nad can dang gang po dang / /mes byin dang ni be'i ra to/ /sprin can ①bya rog rnams yin no/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul ka shi nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na bā rā ṇa sīr byon nas/ bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags ②na bzhugs sol/ /bā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag sde chen zhes bya ba phyug ducing nor mang la ④longs spyod che ba zhig gnas so/ /de'i chung ma ni sde chen ma zhes bya'o/ /de chung ma dang bcas te dad pa bzang ba dge ba'i bsam pa can yin te/ des bcom ldan 'das yul ka shi zhes bya ba nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na bā rā ṇa sīr byon nas/ bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags ⑤na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos skyonas kyang ༅'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi dukhyim du lan mang du spyan drangs te zhal zas ni gsol na ⑨yo byad thams cad kyis ma bstabs kyis༅/ ma la bdag gis da bcom ldan 'das la zla ba gsum du yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs skyopar bya'o snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos 8phyag byas 8te phyogs gcig tu 'dug gobla/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag sde chen la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad8/ yang dag par 'dzin tsodu 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod ⑩par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug(sme /yang dag par gzengs ⑩bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung du 1—660

ngo / /de nas khyim bdag sde chen bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par bstod de ②rjes su yi rangs nas stan ②las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar blunas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ④la dgung ⑤zla gsum du na bza' ༅chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad ༅kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams 'bul na bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag sde chen la cang mi gsung bas sheganang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag sde chen bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod de rjes su yi rangs spunas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 6zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas stan las langs te song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ༅tu khyim bdag sde chen gyis zla ba gsum du na bza' 8chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad 8kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis ④bsnyen bkur kho na byas 8so/ /khyim bdag sde chen gyi 8kun du spyod pa ni nang par sngar langs te bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑩zhabs la mgo tsobos phyag 'tshal te dge slong rnams la lta bar byed pa las dge slong na ba nad tshabs che ba sdug bsnga la ba'i nad pa gzhan zhig yod pa de la sman pas sha khu 'thung yishig ces bstan to/ /de nas khyim bdag sde chen dge slong de gang na ba der song ste phyin du nas rkang pa gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te dris pa/'phags pa sman pas ci bstan 0/ des smras pa/ sha khu 'thung dushig lo/ /de nas khyim bdag sde chen rang gi khyim du song ste chung ma la smras pa/ slob 1—661

dpon che ge mo zhes bya ba la sman pas sha khu 'thung ①shig ces bstan gyis ②sbyor ②la skur cig /des bu mo zhig la rin bskur nas tshong dus su btang ④ba las/de'i nyin mo rgyal po'i sras bltam ②nas/ des dril sgrogs su bcug pa⑥/sus kyang srog gcad ༅par mi bya'o/ /gang zhig srog bcad lan chad pas chod par bcad 0do zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas rin gyis kyang tshong dus byas sha ma rnyed nas / de nas bu mo des de ltar gyur pa dag khyim bdag sde chen yil rgyas par brjod pa dang / khyim bdag sde chen gyi chung mas bsams 8pa/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bdag cag gi 8yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs na/ gal te dge slong zhig sman med pas shi bar gyur na ma legs so zhes de snyam du dpyad nasartso/ gri rnon po blangs te khyim du zhugs nas brla'i sha las bcad de bu mo la byin nas bu sha sku'adi khu bar byos la 'phags pa che 8ge mo zhes bya ba'i drung du khyer cig /des de khyer nas dge slong gi skyelongs spyad pa ⑫las sos par gyur to// // 'dul ba gzhi/ bam po nyi shu tsegasum pa/ dge slong des 'di ltar bdag la khyim bdag gi chung ma 'dis rang gi du shas bsnyen bkur byas par rig nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag dad pas byin pa longs spyad zhunas glos phab ste 'dug pa ni rigs pa ma yin gyi 3/ ma la bdag gis ma thob pa thob par bya ba dang / ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba dang / mngon sum tsodu ma byas pa mngon sum tsu )du bya ba'i phyir brtson par bya'o snyam nas/ de brtson 'grus brtsam 6)par brtsams te/ des ( 9brtson pa dang / 'bad pa dang /brtsal 0ba byas pas tso'akhor ba'i 'khor lo 0cha lnga po 0 g.yo ba dang / mi g.yo 1—662

ba 'di nyid rig ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad nyams pa dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos nyid du zil gyis mnan nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas nas dgra bcom par gyur te/ khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba/bong ba dang gser du mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mnyam pa'i sems ste'u dang tsan dan du mnyam pa/ rig pas ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs dral cing rig pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / so so ①yang dag par ②rig pa ⑧thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed ④pa dang chags pa dang / bkur sti shel rgyab kyis phyogs pa ⑥/ dbang po dang nye dbang po rtsodang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjed nipar bya ba dang / mngon du smra bar bya bar gyur tortsa/ /skabs de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi mkhyen pa'am / mi gzigs pa'am/ thugs su mi lku chud pa'am/ rnam par mi ⑩mkhyen pa cung zad kyang mi mnga'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das snga dro sham thabs mnabs nyunyelhung bzed dang / chos gos bsnams nas dge slong gi tshogs nyunyekyis yongs su bskor cing rū/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun gyis bltas 8te khyim bdag sde chen gyi khyim gang na ba der gshegs te byon nas dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag 9sde chen la bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag khyim bdag gi chung ma sde chen ma mi snang na ga re/ bcom ldan 'das spyod lam rngo mi thog ⑩pas phugs na mchis so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi che ba'i bdag nyid ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pas tsobacom ldan 'das kyis gang gis 1—663

na rma de mdog 'dra ba dang / pags ①pa 'dra ba dang / ba 0spu 'dra bar gyur pa ②de ltar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas khyim bdag sde ༅chen gyi ⑤chung ma dad pa skyes te sgor byung nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtugs so//⑥bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ci khyim bdag gi 0chung ma 'di byang chub sems dpa'i sbungs nyams su myong bar byed dam/ des tshigs su bcad ⑤de gsol pa/ bsgrim khyami dgos par 'khor ba na/ /lus ni shin tu rnyed par sla'i0 —/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams su/ /sbyin gnas shin tu rnyed par dka'ayi//de nas khyim bdag sde 4)chen gyis sangs rgyas la sogs pa tho)dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs n+tu par rig nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba byarnams rang gi lag gis stobs shing tsotshem par byed do༅/ /rnam grangs du mar gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag rang gi lag gis bstabs shing tshim par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsol zin nas phyag bcabs te/ lhung bzed gyu 8bar rig nas stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te / bcom ldan 'das kyi gyaspyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag sde chen la chos dang ldan du pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug ri nyepar mdzad/yang dag par gzengs stod cipar mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/ rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par bstan 3—/ yang dag par 'dzin ④du bcug /yang dag par gzengs byabastod/yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas gdan 0las bzhengs te gshegs so//de nas bcom ldan 'das gtsug lag khang 0du gshegs nas dge slong gi dge 1—664

'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sha rnams kyi nang nas ①ni 'di lta ste/ mi'i sha tha chad yin no/ /de lta bas na dge slong gis mi'i ②sha bza' bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong gis mi ②sha zos na ltung ba sbom por 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ngas dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi ④dge slong gi kun tu spyod pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi ⑤dge slong gis sha 'drim ⑥par byed na 'di ci'i sha zhes dri bar bya'o/ /gal te dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis ma spobs na gnas brtan gnyis pas dri bar bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi ༅gnas brtan gyis kun du spyad ②pa'i chos ji ltar bcas pa bzhin yang dag par blangs te 'jug par mi byed na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong thams cad the tshom ②skyes nas the tshom ༅thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa khyim bdag sde chen gyi mchis 'brang ⑩gis rang gi shas dge slong 'di la bsnyen bkur bgyis la/ dge slong 'dis kyang sde chen ma la brten nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du bgyis pa nyunyel gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag da ltar 'ba' zhig ma yin gyi/ ji ltar 'dis 'das pa'i dus na yang dge slong 'di la rang gi shas 8bsnyen bkur byas ⑩ te 'dis kyang de la brten nas mngon par shes pa lnga mngon sum du byas pa de shin tu legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 8shig dang bshad do/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī'i grong na khyim bdag sde chen zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de'i chung ma sde chen ma zhes bya'o/ /ji tsam na bram ze tshogs 'don du 'jug 8pa gzhan zhig bram 1wa 665

ze'i bu lnga ①brgya tsam la bram ze'i gsang tshig 'don du 'jug go②/ /de la khyim bdag sde chen dad pa skyes te/ des de 'khor dang bcas pa la yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs te/ khyim bdag sde chen gyis ①bram ze de 'khor dang bcas pa la bkur sti ༅kho na byas so/ /khyim bdag de'i kun tu spyod pa ni nang par sngar langs te nad pa rnams la lta bar byed pas ⑤ji tsam na bram ze'i khye'u ⑥gzhan zhig na ba sdug bsngal ba nad tshabs che bar gyur nas de la sman pas sha khu 'thung ༅shig ces bstan to/ /de nas khyim bdag sde chen bram ze'i khye'u dugang na ba der song ste son nas phyag byas te dris pa⑨/ bram ze'i khye'u ⑩khyod la sman pas ci bstan/ des smras pa/ sha khu 'thung 0shig lo/ de nas khyim bdag sde chen khyim dag 8tu song nas chung ma la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u 8che ge mo zhes bya ba la sha khu 'thung byashig ces sman pas bstan gyis 8de sbyor byal skur ༅cig /des bu mo zhig la rin bskur te tshong dus 8su btang ngo / /de nyid kyi lonyin mo rgyal po'i bu btsas nas des dril sgrogs su du bcug ste/ sus kyang srog gcad ⑥par mi bya'o/ /gang gis srog bcad snyepar gyur na de chad pas chod par bcad 3do zhes bsgo'o/ /de nas tshong dus du su rin gyis kyang sha ma rnyed do/ /de nas bu mo des de ltar gyur pa dag khyim bdag sde chen gyi chung ma la rgyas par smras pa dang / khyim bdag sde chen gyi chung mas bsams 3pa/ bram ze 'khor dang bcas pa 'di dag bdag cag bugis yo byad thams cad bstabs na/ gal te bram ze'i khye'u du zhig sman med pas dus byas par gyur na ma legs so zhes de snyam du dpyad na 3/ gri rnon po blangs te khyim gyi nang du zhugs nas brla'i sha las bcad de bu mo la byin nas/ bu ⑥sha 'di khu bar byos la bram ze'i khye'u du che ge 1wa 666

mo zhes bya ba'i drung du khyer cig /des khyer nas bram ze'i khye'u ①des longs spyad nas sos par gyur to/ /bram ze'i khye'u ②des 'di ltar bdag la khyim bdag gi chung ma des rang gi shas bsnyen bkur byas par rig nas de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag dad pas byin pa yongs su longs ②spyad nas bdag glos phab ④ste 'dug pa ni ⑤rigs pa ma yin gyis༅/ ma la bdag gis ma thob pa thob par bya ba dang / ma rtogs pa rtogs ⑦par bya ba dang / mngon sum du ma byas pa mngon sum du bya ba'i phyir bdag gis 'bad par bya'o snyam nas/ de nas de zhi ba'i phyogs su song ste mngon par shes pa lnga mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi 'khyim bdag sde chen bozhes bya ba'i chung ma gang yin pa de ni khyim bdag sde chen gyi chung ma 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi ⑨ bram ze'i khye'u yigang yin pa de ni dge slong 'di nyid yin te de'i tshe yang 'dis dge slong de la rang gi shas bsnyen bkur byas te/ 'dis kyang de la brten nas mngon par shes pa lnga mngon sum du byas so/ /da ltar yang 'dis dge slong 'di la blarang gi shas bsnyen bkur byas so/ /dge slong 'dis kyang 'di la brten nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te dgra bcom pa mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi ⑫rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin/ las gcig 8tu dkar ba rnams kyi 8ni gcig tu dkar ⑩ba yin/ 'dren ༅ma rnams kyi ni 'dren tsom yin no/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na yid bu phyin chad las gcig tu gnag pa rnams dang 'dren ⑥ma ni spangs la/ las gcig tu dkar ba la brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o//1—667

gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na'o/ /de'i tshe yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi glang po che tsho dgu kha dag ①go/ /mu ge'i dus byung bas bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyis glang po che'i sha bza' ②bar brtsams so/ /drug sde'i dge slong dag snga dro sham thabs bgos ②lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas mnyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs ④so/ /ji tsam na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis glang po che'i sha phru ⑤bar bcug ste 'tshed cing 'dug ⑥pa'i khyim der de dag zhugs pa dang / /khyim bdag gi 0chung mas smras pa/ 'phags pa dbul du cung zad kyang ma mchis kyis ⑧bzhud cig /de dag gis smras pa/ phru ba 'di'i nang na 'tshed 0cing 'dug na/ 'phags pa 'di ni glang po che'i sha lags na ci khyed cag kyang glang po che'i ⑩sha gsol lam/ kho bo cag ni 'tsho ba khyed cag la rag las pa yin pas gal te khyed za na kho bo cag la yang byin cig /de dag la skyephul nas de dag gis lhung bzed kyi snod bkang ste phyir byung ba dge slong rtsogazhan dag cig bsod snyoms la rgyus pa 6de dag gis mthong ngo / /mthong nas dris pa/ e ma'o drug sde tho )lhung bzed kyi snod khengs na ci yin/de dag gis smras pa/ glang po che'i sha cung zhig 6rnyed do/ /ci khyed cag glang po che'i sha yang za'am/ tshe dang ldan pa dag mu ge'i dus byung ba la cigal te gzhan ma rnyed na ci kho bo cag ltogs te 'chi'am zhes pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rgyal po'i glang po che tsho dgu kha dag laci/ gal te khyed kyis glang po che'i 8sha zos pa rgyal pos thos na/ khyed la mngon par dad pa'i lha dang / klu dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa gzhan dag kyang yod pas 1—668

'phags pa dag glang po che'i sha za ste/ des na ①bdag gi glang po che tsho dgu kha dag ②go zhes sems par ②mi 'gyur ram/ ④dge slong dag gis glang po che'i sha longs ༅spyad par mi bya'o/ /longs spyad na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /glang po che'i sha ji lta ba bzhin du rta'i ⑥sha yang de dang 'dra'o// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul tsam pa na drang srong gar ⑦ga'i rdzing 'gram na bzhugs so/ /yul tsam pa'i klu dad pa bzang ba dge ba'i bsam pa can de tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi la gnas nas byung ste yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas blangs nas gnas snang bar lus chen por byas te lus btang nas 'dug cing ④/ 'jig rten na sems can ⑨gnas pa dag la cung zad kyang gnod pa'am skrag par mi byed do/ /mu ge'i dus byung bas las la mi lta ba'i mi phyugs tho) rdzi rnams dang / lug rdzi rnams dang / rtswa thomathun rnams dang /shing thun rnams dang / lam gyis 'tsho ba rnams dang / lam gol bas 'tsho ba'i mi rnams kyis klu'i 8sha la dum bu dum bur bcad nas longs spyad 8par brtsams so/ /drug sde'i dge slong dag snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos 8thogs nas bsod snyoms la zhugs pa las/ ji tsam na khyim bdag gzhan zhig gis klu'i sha phru 8bar bcug ste 'tshed ⑩cing 'dug pa'i khyim der de dag zhugs so/ /khyim bdag gi chung mas smras pa/ 'phags pa dbul du cung zad kyang ma mchis kyis ⑩bzhud cig /de dag gis smras patso/ phru ba 'di'i nang na 'tshed ⑩cing 'dug na/ 'phags pa 'di ni klu'i sha lags na ci khyed cag kyang klu'i sha gsol lam/ kho bo cag ni 'tsho ba khyed zhu la rag las pa yin pas gal te khyed cag za na kho bo cag la yang byin cig /de dag la phul nas 1—669

'phags pa rnams kyang longs spyod ①do zhes phal mo ches spyad ②par brtsams so/ /de nas tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma 'di snyam du sems te/ 'phags pa 'di dag kyang klu'i sha la longs spyod ②pas skye bo'i tshogs phal mo ches longs spyad na bdag gi khyim thab kyis ༅yun ji srid cig sdug bsngal mnags phyedagos/ bdag gis 'di'i phyir 'di kho na bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma de'i ༅mtshan mo 'das nas kha dog 'phags pas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de'i tshe ④tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma'i kha dog gi mthus drang srong gar ga'i rdzing gi nyen kor thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par byas so/ /tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma duphyogs gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gi 0sdum thab dad pa bzang ba dge ba'i bsam pa can des 6tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi la gnas nas byung ste yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas blangs nas lus btang ste mchis la 'jig rten na sems can dag gnas pa gnod pa dang skrag pa cung zad kyang mi bgyid pa mu ge'i dus byung bas las la mi lta ba'i mi phyugs ༅rdzi rnams dang / lug rdzi rnams dang / rtswa thun 8rnams dang / shing thun rnams dang / lam gyis 'tsho 8ba rnams dang / lam gol bas 'tsho ba'i mi rnams kyis klu'i sha dum bu dum bur bkum nas 'tshal ba 'phags pa dag gis gzigs nas 'phags pa rnams kyis cigasol bar brtsams so/ /'phags pa rnams kyis gsol la 8de dag gis kyang tsocher bkum zhing 'tshal bar brtsams nas ⑩bdag gi bsdum thab kyis yun ji srid cig sdug bsngal mnags 7'tshal/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das 1—670

thugs brtse ba nye bar bzung ste/ gang gi phyir 'phags pa dag klu'i sha mi gsol bar dgongs pa'i rgyu chung ①zhig bca' bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /②de nas tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma ༅bcom ldan 'das kyis cang ④mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi ༅zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te de nyid du thomi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas dge slong gi cudage 'dun gyi nigung la gdan bshams ⑨pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' 455 pa/ dge slong dag mdang sum lku nga'i spyan sngar tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma mtshan mo 'das nas kha dog 'phags pas skyigang na ba der 'ongs te phyin nas nga'i zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /6de'i tshe tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma'i kha dog gi mthus rtso drang srong gar ga'i skye rdzing gi nyen kor thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par byas so/ /tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma saphyogs gcig tu 'dug nas nga la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag gi skyesdum thab dad pa bzang ba nyu snadage ba'i bsam pa can de nyunyetshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi la rang gi thorteganas nas byung ste yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas blangs nas lus btang ste mchis lakyi / 'jig rten na sems can dag gnas pa la gnod pa dang skrag pa cung zad kyang mi bgyid pa mu ge'i dus byung bas las la mi lta tuba'i mi phyugs rdzi rnams dang / lug rdzi rnams dang / rtswa tsu)thun rnams dang /shing thun rnams dang / lam gyis 'tsho ba rnams dang / lam gol bas 'tsho ba'i mi rnams kyis klu'i sha dum bu dum bur bkum nas 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis 1—671

'tshal ba dang / 'phags pa dag gis kyang gsol bar brtsams so /'phags pa rnams kyang ①gsol to zhes de dag gis cher bkum zhing 'tshal bar brtsams na②/ bdag gi sdum thab kyis ②yun ji srid cig sdug bsngal mnags ④'tshal / kye ⑤bcom ldan 'das thugs brtse ༅ba nye bar bzung ste gang gi phyir 'phags pa dag klu'i sha mi gsol bar dgongs pa'i rgyu cung zhig bca' bar gsol zhes zer nas ngas ༅tsam pa'i klu'i chung ma la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo //de nas tsam pa'i klu'i chung mas nga cang ⑧mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas nga'i zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /gang la da ltar 0lha dag kyang shākya'i sras kyi dge slong ⑨ rnams ni dge ba'i chos rnams las nyams so zhes smod par byed/ phyar ka ⑩gtong bar byed/ kha zer bar byed pa 'di ni bzang po ma yin 8/ rigs pa ma yin te/ dge slong dag de lta bas na dge slong dag gis klu'i sha bza' bar mi bya'o/ /za na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// // bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga ṅgā'i 3ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas/ rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /ma ga d+ma'i ④rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga ṅgā'i 6ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ ⑩rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang yang ⑩'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis lan mang du spyan drangs te zhal zas gsol nas 8lan 'ga' yang zla ba gsum du yo byad thams cad kyis ma bstabs kyis(rkye/ ma la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la zla ba 1—672

gsum du yo byad thams cad kyis bstabs shing sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho ①byed kyang dbul lo snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po'i 'byor pa dang / rgyal po'i mthu ②chen pos bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ④ma ga ṅgā'i ༅rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam ⑥gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad / yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod ༅par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do༅/ /rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis ⑨yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ⑩bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo / /de nas ma ga d+ma'i ༅rgyal po bzo cisbyangs gzugs can snying po stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la ⑫dgung zla gsum du bsod snyoms dang / na bza' chos gos dang / gzims cha dang / snyun dpyad ④kyi rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams dang / sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed dbul ④na bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma ga ṅgā'i ⑩rgyal po bzo 7sbyangs gzugs can snying po la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas ma ga ṅgā'i 8rgyal po bzo sbyanges gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung yibs gnang bar rig nas/ stan las 1—673

langs te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ①ma ga ṅgā'i ②rgyal po bzo sbyangs cigazugs can snying pos zla ba gsum du na bza' chos gos dang /bsod snyoms dang / gzims byacha dang / snyun ⑤gyi rkyen sman gyi ༅yo byad thams cad dang / sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis rim gro kho na byas so/ /yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu ma ga ṅgā'i ④rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos yo byad thams cad dang / sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed bstabs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyarngo 'di snyam du sems te/ de yang rgyal po rgyal rigs duspyi bo nas dbang bskur ba yin/ bdag kyang rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ⑨ba yin la/ de'i sman pa'i rgyal po ni 'tsho byed yin la/ bdag gi sman pa'i rgyal po ni rgyun shes kyi bu yin gyis 6gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod du skyebyon pa de'i tshe bdag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi skyedage 'dun dang thabs cig la yo byad thams cad dang / sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi bu bstab skupar bya'o snyam mo/ /ji tsam na bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu dbyar bzhugs hūṃ ༷nas dbyar gyi zla ba gsum 'das nas chos gos byas pa dang ldan/chos gos zin pa dang ldan nas lhung bzed dang chos gos bsnams te/ dge slong gi skyotshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing / dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi mdun ⑩gyis bltas nas tsomanyan yod gang na ba der rgyu zhing gshegs te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa na8/ mnyan yod du byon nas mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /ko sa la'i 1—674

rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das yul ko sa la'i ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na mnyan ①yod du byon nas mnyan yod na ②rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang mnyan yod nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la zhuchos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/④ yang dag par gzengs stod ②par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i gtam thogyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod / yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung dungo / /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar rtsonas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 6te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig la dgung zla gsum du na bza' chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun sman gyi rkyen byasman gyi yo byad rnams dang / sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi 8bu dbul na bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la cang mi tsogasung bas gnang ngo / /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig 1—675

nas stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas song ngo / /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis zla ba gsum du yo byad thams cad dang /sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi bus rim gro kho na byas so/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi kun du spyod pa ni nang ①par sngar langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag byas nas dge slong nad pa la lta ②ba yin no/ /ji tsam na dge slong gzhan zhig gzhang 'brum gyis thebs chanas de skya bo bseng bseng ④por gyur cing rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang / na bas nyam ⑤dmas par gyur pa ⑥de ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis mthong nas smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod ci'i phyir skya bo bseng bseng ༅por gyur cing rid pa dang / nyam chung ba dang /na bas nyam dudams par gyur/ lha bdag gzhang 'brum gyis thebs so/ /de nas rgyal pos sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi bu la bsgo ba/ dge slong 'di'i dpyad ⑨byos shig /lha ⑩bka' bzhin 'tshal7/ de ma dad pas des tsom byas so/ /ji tsam na rgyal pos yang dge slong de mthong nas smras 8pa/ 'phags pa khyod rgyun shes kyi bus dpyad ma bgyis sam lha ma bgyis so/ /de nas rgyal po khros te rgyun shes kyi bu pho nyas bkug nas bsgo ba/ gal te khyod kyis dge slong 'di'i dpyad byas na bode lta na legs/ gal te ma byas na khyod kyi dbang thang gcad 'do/ /de rang bzhin gyis ma dad pa zhig pas cher ⑩'khrugs nas/ dge sbyong mgo reg 'di'i phyir lhas bdag gi dbang thang gcod par 'gyur ro zhes des dge slong de rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi 7sgor bzo bcos byas nas de dang de nas mtshon gyi las bya tu)bar brtsams so/ /de nas dge slong de nyam nga ba dang /1—676

dog pa dang / gnod pa thob cing sdug bsngal rtsub ①pa ②mi bzad pa yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba nyams su myong chanas bsams pa/ bdag ⑤nyam nga ba dog pa gnod pa thob pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis ma dgongs pa lta zhig /skabs de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/thugs su mi chud pa'am/ rnam par mi mkhyen ⑤pa cung zad kyang mi mnga'o/ /dre nas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen pos bskul nas phyogs der gshegs pa dang / sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi bus bcom ldan 'das phyogs der gshegs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang kun nas dkris pa drag pos bcom ldan 'das la smras pa/ dge sbyong bran mo'i bu tshur shog /nyan thos kyi ༅rkub ⑦phye ba la ltos/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid nas duslar log ste gtsug lag khang du gshegs nas gdan bshams 0pa nyid la bzhugs so/ /bzhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe zhal nas 'od zer sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dag 'byung zhing kha cig ni 'og tu 'gro'o/ /kha cig ni steng ⑩du 'gro'o/ /gang dag 'og tu song ba de yidag ni yang sos dang / thig tshunag dang / bsdus gzhom dang / ngu 'bod dang /tho) ngu 'bod chen po dang / tsha ba dang /rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang / chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol pa cidang / so thams thams 8dang / kyi hud zer ba dang / a chu zer ba dang / ut+pal ⑩ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa dang / pad ma ltar gas pa chen po rnams su yang 0song ste/ tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba gang dag 1—677

yin pa de dag la ni bsil bar 'bab bo/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba ①gang dag yin pa de dag la ni dro bar 'bab bo/ /des sems can de rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi khyad par dag so sor zhi bar byas so/ /de rnams 'di snyam ②du sems te/ shes ldan dag ci bdag cag 'di nas shi 'phos par gyur tam/'on te gzhan du skyes par gyur snyam pa la/ de rnams dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis sprul pa zhig btang ngo / /de rnams kyis sprul pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ shes ldan dag bdag cag ni 'di nas shi 'phos ghupa med la/ gzhan du skyes pa med kyis kyang sngon ma mthong ba'i sems can 'di'i mthus bdag cag gi sdug bsngal gyi khyad par rnams so sor zhi bar byas so zhes de rnams sprul pa la sems mngon par dad par gyur pas dmyal ba myong bar ④ gyur pa'i salas de zad par byas shinas gang du bden pa rnams mthong ba'i snod du 'gyur 7ba lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyor ba sabazung ngo / /gang dag steng du song ba de dag ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / sum bcu rtsa gsum rkyodang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa'i mdun men 'don (1dang / tshangs pa chen po dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang / dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang / sprin med dang / bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che dang /mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / gya rnam 3)snang ba ྅nyedang / shin du mthong ba nyu )dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyi nang du song nas mi rtag pa dang /sdug bsngal ba chedang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa'i dbyangs sgrog cing 1—678

tshigs su bcad pa 'di ①gnyis kyang bsgrags so/ /brtsam par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin / /'chi rgyabadag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod pas/ /chos 'dul 'di la brtson gyur du tshon/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par gyurabya/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po phye'ajig rten gyi rgyakhams rnams byul rtsonas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rjes bzhin 3rjes bzhin du ⑨'gro'o/ /de la gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i las rnams lung ston par bzhed na ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snam rngulogs su nub par 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa lung ston par bzhed na ni mdun logs su nub par 'gyur ro/ /dmyal bar skye bar lung ston par bzhed na byani zhabs kyi mthil du nub par 'gyur ro/ /dud zhu 'gror skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi rting par nub par 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas su skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi mthe bor nub par 'gyur ro/ /mir skye bar lung ston par bzhed na ni zhabs kyi pus mor nub par 'gyur ro/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur tsu ba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed nyu na ni phyag g.yon pa'i mthil sadu nub par 'gyur rotshi/ /'khor los sgyur tsoba'i rgyal por lung ston par bzhed na ni phyag g.yas pa'i mthil du nub par 'gyur ro/ /lha rnams su lung ston par bzhed na ni sku'i lte bar nub par 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni zhal gyi nang du nub par 'gyur ro/ /rang byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni mdzod spur nub par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par bzhed na ni dbu'i gtsug tu nub 1—679

par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'od zer de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi ①mthil du nub bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos thal mo sbyar nas zhus pa/kha dog sna tshogs stong gis bkra ba yi/ /tshogs rnams zhal gyi nang nas byung gyur pa②ske/ /ji ltar ②gdugs ni shar bar gyur pa bzhin/ /de yis phyogs rnams kun du snang bar bgyis/ /yang tshigs su bcad pa dag gsol pa/ rgod bral zhum dang rgyags pa spangs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro nang mchog gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dgra thul byed rgyu ma mchis par/ /rtsa lag dung ltar dkar 'dzum ston mi mdzad / /de slad brtan pa nyid blos ④dus mkhyen nas/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po thub pa skyes kyi mchog /nyan par 'tshal ba'i nyan pa po rnams kyi/ /the tshom skyes pa gsung tshig brtan pa dang / /dam pa bzang po dag gis bsal 'du gsol / / tshwa chu'i ⑥ri bo lta bur brtan ⑦pa'i mgon/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams blo gebur 'dzum mi ston/ /brtan ⑨pa ci slad 'dzum pa ston mdzad ⑩pa//skye bo phal che skye'adi dag de nyan 'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo de de bzhin te/ de de bzhin no/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med rkyen med par 'dzum pa mi ston te/ kun dga' bo sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi bu nyams shing chud zos par gyur te/ des de bzhin gshegs pa mang pos bkur tsoba'i gdung rgyud tsonas bzung ste spyod pa skyon mi mnga' ba la bran ④mo'i bu zhes byasmras so/ /de deng tsonas zhag bdun nas ⑩khyag dron du skyugs te dus byed par 'gyur te/ lus zhig nas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro//1—680

dge slong dag de lta ①bas na rgyun shes kyi bu'am/ rgyun shes kyi bu 'dra ba la bsnyen bkur byed du ma gzhug ②cig /gzhang 'brum yang gcad ②par mi bya'o/ /'on kyang gzhang 'brum gyi dpyad ni ④rnam pa gnyis kyis ⑤bya ste/ gsang sngags dang / sman gyis so/ /dge slong gis gzhang 'brum gcod dam/ rgyun shes kyi bu'am/༅ rgyun shes kyi bu 'dra ba la bsnyen bkur byed du 'jug na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro/ /dge slong de rgyun shes kyi bus ji ltar gnod pa de nyid kyis dus las 'das pa de lta de ltar byas so/ /de nas blon po dag gis rgyal po gsal rgyal la smras pa/ lha rgyun shes kyi ⑦bus ⑤ni bcom ldan 'das la yang bran mo'i bu zhes 'tshig tu smras la0/ dge slong de yang ji ⑩ltar gnod pa de nyid kyis dus las 'das pa de lta 8de ltar bgyis so/ /de nas rgyal po che thang du khros nas blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag ngas sman pa'i rgyal po rgyun shes kyi bu yongs su btang zin gyis deng 8shig /blon po rnams kyis smras pal/ lha gum lags pa de dgum ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rtsozhag bdun na khrag dron du skyugs chenas dus byed par 'gyur te lus zhig nas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan lags so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te de ltar gyur na nga'i yul nas spyugs shig /de dag gis de spyugs nas yul gnas bcas zhes bya bar phyin no/ /yul gna~X bcas na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis ⑩skyes bu gti mug gang gi phyir khyod khams gsum gyi mgon po la bran mo'i bu'o ⑩zhes tshig tu smras pa/ khyod 'dir gnas su ga la rung zhes mang du spyos nas bskrad do/ /de nas bā rā ṇa sīr song ngo / /de nas kyang bskrad nas yangs pa can du song ngo / /de nas kyang bskrad nas yul 1—681

tsam par song ngo / /de nas kyang bskrad nas rgyal po'i khab tu song ngo de nas kyang bskrad nas shing ①drung zhig na gnas so/ /de nas kyang shing la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis bskrad nas/ 'bab chu dang / mtsho dang / mtshe'u ②dag gi ②'gram shig tu song ba dang der yang skabs ma rnyed nas des bsam ④pa/'dzam bu'i gling 'di na re zhig wa ⑤dag gis kyang skabs yirnyed na/ bdag gis ⑦skabs shing drung dang / mtsho dang / mtshe'u dudag na yang med do snyam pa dang /de la gang gis na khrag dron po skyugs nas dus las 'das pa de lta bu'i kun nas dkris pa skyes so/ /dus las 'das ma thag tu mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byung ba de la tshigs su bcad pa dag gsungs pa/ mi zhig skyes par gyur pa yi/ /kha nas sta re'i tshig 'byung ⑨ste/ /nyes par smra ba smra tshig des/ /bdag nyid la ni gcod par byed / /gang zhig smad 'os skye bo bsngags byed cing / /bsngags 'os skye bo tsernam par smod byed pa/ /de ni kha yi nyes pas skyogang gis na/ /bde ba thob kyemi 'gyur ba'i nyes pa sogasanyu)/ /'dir ni brgyan pos rang gi nor yal ba/ /'di ni phung ba nyu )cung zad tsam yin te/ /bde gshegs rnams la yid kyis gdug bsam 8pa/ /gang yin de ni phung ba tsochen po yin/ /'phags la gnod 7byed lus dang ngag gis skyelas/ /sdig to byas nas chu bur rdol byarnams su / /lo 'bum dag dang chu bur can du lo'u / /bzhi khri chig stong gang yin dmyal der 'gro// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul ka shi nas ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa na grong rdal mtshams ma bcad pa gzhan zhig tu dgongs btab nas bzhugs so/ /1—682

de na ①bcom ldan 'das rlung nad kyi snyun gyis thebs par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das la bdag gis rang gi blos ni rim gro lan mang du byas na sman pa la lan 'ga' yang ma dris kyis / ma la ②bdag gis da ②ni sman pa la dri'o snyam ste ④/ de sman pa'i ②drung du song nas bzhin bzangs bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i ༅snyun gyis thebs kyis ⑦sman ston cig /des smras pa/ 'phags pa gru sum chab mar dumang po spustsal pa sgrol la gsol cig dang byasnyan gdangs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo rang nyid kyis byas te btsos nas bcom ldan 'das la 'bul skyelo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du med pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la mas 8pa/ kun dga' bo 'di ci yin/ des gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag gis lku glo ba la bsams tsan/ bcom ldan 'das la bdag gis rang gi blos ni rim gro lan mang du bgyis na sman pa la tunyelan 'ga' yang ma dris kyisanyu9/ma la bdag gis da ni sman pa la 7dri'o snyam bgyis skyonas bdag gis sman pa la smras na skyede'i mchid du nas/ gru sum bya chab mar mang pos stsal pa sgrol la gsol byacig dang snyun gdangs zhu)par 'gyur ro zhes mchi du nas/ de nas bdag gis bgyis te bsgral ba lags so/ /kun dga' bo gang du btsos/ mtshams kyi nang du'o/ /gang du gzhag( sme /mtshams kyi nang du'o/ /sus btsos(nye/bdag gis mtshams kyi nang du'o/ /kun dga' bo mtshams kyi nang du btsos la mtshams ⑦kyi nang du zhag kyang tsolon pa longs spyad ⑥par mi bya'o/ /mtshams kyi nang du btsos la mtshams kyi phyi rol du zhag lon pa yang longs spyad zhu par mi bya'o//1—683
