mtshams kyi phyi rol du btsos la mtshams kyi nang du zhag lon pa yang longs spyad par mi bya'o/ /mtshams kyi phyi rol du btsos la mtshams kyi phyi rol du zhag lon na 7longs spyad par ②bya'o/ /kun dga' bo mtshams kyi nang yang rung mtshams kyi phyi rol ⑧yang rung ste dge slong gis btsos pa ni thams cad kyi thams cad du longs spyad par mi bya'o/ / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis btsos pa ④thams cad kyi ⑤thams cad du longs spyad par mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang /mnyan ༅yod na khyim bdag gzhan zhig yod pa de bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag de la chos dang ldan pa'i gtan gyis yang dag par ston par mdzad / yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod ⑦par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad de/rnam dgrangs du mar zhes bya ba nas/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung yingo zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de nas khyim bdag de stan las langs te bla ⑩ gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de ⑪logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig sang 8bdag gi sdum par gdugs tsotshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba nas rgyas par sbyar te(ste/ ji tsam na spyan 'dren gyis dus tshod gsol pa/btsun pa gdugs tshod lags na/ bcom ldan 'das da de'i dus la bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas dge slong gi dge tso'adun snga dro sham tsothabs bgos 1—684

lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas khyim bdag de'i khyim ①ga la ba der dong ngo //bcom ldan 'das ni bsod snyoms bzhes nas rdzas kyis bsgrubs pa'i khyim na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsod snyoms bzhes nas rgyu lngas rdzas kyis bsgrubs pa'i khyim na bzhugs sol/ /lnga gang zhe chan/ nad pa la gzigs par bzhed pa dang / gnas mal la gzigs par bzhed pa dang /nang du yang dag 'jog la bzhugs par bzhed pa dang / lha rnams la chos ston par bzhed pa dang / nyan thos rnams 'dul ba la bslab ④pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das nyan thos rnams 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pas bsod snyoms bzhes ⑤nas rdzas kyis bsgrubs pa'i khyim na bzhugs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bsod snyoms nod pa yin te/ ji tsam na ⑥der 'bras chan ma tshos pa zhig phog pa dang / de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'di snyam du ⑦sems te/ bcom ldan 'das snyun gdangs nas ring po ma lon la 'bras chan 'di yang ma tshos pa zhig pas 'di gal te longs spyad na snyun slar ⑧ldang bar 'gyur srid kyis0/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang yang 'di nyid kyis rkyen byas nas gnang bar 'gyur ba'i gnas de yod do snyam nas/ des chu snod blangs te chus btab nas ji srid tshos pa de srid du btsos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du rmed pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la rmas ⑩pa/ kun dga' bo ci dge 'dun thams cad kyi 'bras chan ⑩yang 'di 'dra'am/ btsun pa ma lags te/ 'on kyang ma dral tsob 1—685

lags so/ /'o na 'di ga las kyi'ongs/ des skabs de bcom ldan 'das la rgyas par gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo legs so legs so/ /ngas rjes su ma ②gnang ba gang yin pa ④yang khyod kyis shes so/ /de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/ dge slong gis ma tshos pa byin len byos la btsos te ༅longs spyad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong gis ma tshos pa byin len byos la btsos te longs spyad par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang / drug sde rnams kyis 'bras skam byin len byas te btsos nas longs spyad par brtsams 3pa'i skabs de bcom ldan 'das la dge slong rnams kyis gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ 'bras chan sum cha tshos pa byin len byos la btsos te longs spyad ༅par bya'o/ /tshod ma dang /me tog dang / 'bras thobu dang / nya dang / sha dag ni kha dog gyur nas 5byin len byas te longs spyad par bya'o/ /'o ma la sogs pa'i rdzas kyi 〈khu ba rnams gang gi nyurtatshe lan gnyis lan gsum du bskol bar gyur pa de'i tshe byin len byas te bskol nas spyad par bya ste/ 'di la 'gyod par mi bya'o/ /'di las gzhan du longs spyad na 'gal tshabs can du 'gyur ro// //sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe grong khyer slo ma lta bu skyezhes bya ba na khyim bdag 'byor pa zhes bya ba phyug pa nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/yongs su bzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyis 'gran byapa zhig gnas so/ /des rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas0/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/1—686

dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na chung ma la sems can zhugs par gyur to/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nas khye'u gzugs bzang ba / mdzes pa/ blta lhan sdug pa zhig btsas nas/ de nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu 3gcig tu grubatsas ston rgya cher byas nas ming 'dogs par byed de/ khye'u 'di'i ming cir gdags/ nye du rnams kyis smras pa/ khye'u 'di khyim bdag 'byor pa'i bu yin pas/ de lta bas na khye'u'i coming 'byor len zhes dugadags so zhes khye'u de'i khuming 'byor len zhes bya bar btags so/ /yang rtse bar byed/dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u zhig tsubatsas te /de'i ming ni 'byor skyob sheces bya bar btags so/ /yang de'i khye'u zhig btsas te / de'i ming ni 'byor dga' zhes bya bar zhu btags so/ /ji tsam na nyu1dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag 'byor pa nad kyis btab par gyur nas de shin tu tshig rtsub mor sasmra ste/ des na nyu chung ma dang bus kyang yal bar bor miro/ /de'i mngag gzhug sabyed pa'i bu mo zhig yod pa des bsams slopa/ bdag gi jo zhu bos thabs brgya stong du mas longs spyod 18rnams bsags na/ de da 9nad kyis thebs par gyur pa dang chung ma dang bus kyang yal bar bor na bdag gi ri rje bo yal bar dor nuḥb ni bdag la rigs pa ma yin no snyam 35nas des sman pa'i drung du song ste/ jo bo khyod kyis khyim bdag 'byor pa mkhyen tam/ shes so/ /de ci bya/ de 'di 'dra ba'i bro nad cig gis thebs te/ de chung ma dang bus kyang yal bar bor na de'i sman ston cig /des smras pa/ chung ma dang bu dag gis kyang yal bar bor ro zhes khyod nyid zer nanunye/ 'o na de la su zhig rim gro 1—687

byed / de'i rim gro bdag gis bgyi mod kyi khyod kyis ci nas ②sman rin chung ba zhig ston cig /des de'i sman ni 'di yin no zhes bstan to/ /de nas des bdag rang gi ②rgyags las kyang cung zad sbyar/ khyim de nyid nas kyang cung zad brkus nas rim gro byas te de sos par ④gyur to/ /des bsams ④pa bdag ni thuchung ma dang bus kyang yal bar bor te 'di ltar bdag skyogason por gyur pa ni bu mo 'di'i mthu yin gyisam/ 'di la phan gdags dupar bya'o snyam nas des de la ⑨smras pa/ bu mo kho bo ni chung ma dang bus kyang yal bar bor ba las / kho bo cung zad cig gson cipa de thams cad ni khyod kyi du drin yin na/khyod mchog ci 'dod pa sbyin gyis masmros shig /gal te jo bo bdag sku khyod kyi thugs su 'thad par gyur na bdag khyod dang lhan cig 'grogs par 'tshal lo/ /des smras pa/ nga dang khyod lhan cig 'grogs pas ci byas tshekār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin la bran las dbyung bar bya'o/ /des smras pa/ jo bo bdag rgyangs bkum par mchis kyang bran mo kho na lags par bas kyisam/ gal te rje'i sras khyod dang lhan cig 'grogs na de lta na bran mor mi 'gyur lags so/ /des gal gyis 'chu skyabar shes nas smras pa/ bu mo gang gi tshe rung zhing zla mtshan dang ldan par gyur pa de'i tshe hūṃ mkho bo la spron cig /des dus gzhan zhig skun rung zhing zla mtshan dang ldan par gyur nas des de la sbran to/ /de nas khyim bdag 'byor pa dang de gnyis lhan cig skyodaga' mgur du spyad pas de sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ /gang gi byanyi ma la sems can zhugs par gyur pa'i nyi ma 3de kho na nas bzung dunas khyim bdag 'byor pa'i nor thams cad dang / las kyi mtha' thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nas 1—688

khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ blta ①na sdug pa/ mdog zhugaser 'dra bske/ mgo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ lag ②pa ring ba/ 'phral ④ba'i dbyes che ba/ smin ma 'jar ⑤ba/ sna'i gzangs ⑥mtho ba/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas ⑦so/ /de btsas nas lhag par khyim bdag 'byor pa'i dgos pa thams cad dang / las kyi mtha' thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /de nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu dugacig tu btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas ming 'dogs par byed de zhes bya ba nas/ gang po zhes bya bar gdags so zhes de'i ming gang po zhes btags so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin no/ /khye'u gang po ma ma brgyad la rjes su gtad nyude/ dri ma phyi ④ba'i ma ma gnyis dang zhes bya ba nas tshergyas par sbyar te/ rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin 6du myur du skyed par byed do zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de chen por gyur pa de'i tshe yi ge dang / rtsis dang / grangs dang / lag rtsis dang /dbyung ba dang / gzhug 8pa dang / gzhag pa la nye bar zhugs shing brtag hu pa brgyad po gzhi brtag pa dang / ras brtag pa medang / rin po che brtag pa dang / shing brtag pa dang / glang po che brtag pa dang / rta brtag pa dang /gzhon nyuston brtag pa dang / gzhon nu ma brtag pa la shin tu byang zhing /brtag pa gzhan yang byed pa dang / klog ༅pa la 8mkhas pa dang / spyod pa gsal bar gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag 'byor pas 'byor len la sogs pa bu rnams rim yibazhin du khyim phub pa dang / de dag chung ma la lhag par chags pas 'tsho nam yal bar bor te 'jo sgeg lhur len cing 'khod do/ /de nas khyim bdag 'byor pa lag 0pa la 'gram pa gtad nas sems khong du 0chud cing 'dug 1—689

pa de bu rnams kyis mthong nas dris ①pa/ yab khyod ci'i slad du phyag la zhal gtad nas sems khong du ②chud cing bzhugs/ des smras pa/ bu dag nga ni ji srid gser 'bum ma rnyed pa de srid du khyim ma phub bo/ / khyed cag 'tsho nam ②yal bar bor nas byachung ma la lhag par chags ⑤pas 'jo sgeg lhur len cing 'khod de/ nga shi nas khyim mya ngan gyis gang bar 'gyur na ji ltar sems khong du ⑥chud par mi 'gyur/ 'byor len gyis rin po che'i rna rgyan zhuthogs pa bkrol ②nas shing gi rna rgyan gcig btags khyate bdag byagis ji srid gser 'bum ma grub pa de srid du rin po che'i rna rgyan tshegadags par mi bya'o zhes dam bcas so /gcig gis ni rgya skegs kyi rna rgyan nonyunye/ /gcig gis ni zha nye'i rna rgyan 8no/ /de dag byaming 'byor len dang / 'byor skyob skyedang / 'byor dga' zhes bya ba rtsogang yin pa de dag nub par gyur nas shing gi rna rgyan can33/ rgya skegs kyi rna rgyan nyu5can/ zha nye'i rna rgyan nyunyecan zhes bya bar ming grags so/ /de rnams zong thogs te rgya mtsho chen por dong ba dang / gang pos smras pa/ yab bdag kyang rgya mtsho chen por mchi'o/ /des smras pa/ bu khyod bus pa yin gyis tri )'di nyid du 'dug la tshong khang gi cho nyabya ba dag byos 5shig ces phyo de nyid du 'dug go/ /de rnams kyis kyang gru bo che grub nas lhags te lam gyis dub zhupa dag snyengal bso tsonas smras pa/ yab bdag cag gi zong 'di brtsir 3gsol/ brtsis nas re res kyang gser 'bum 'bum rnyed par gyur to/ /gang pos kyang de nyid du chos dang mthun pas bsgyur bas zhugaser 'bum lhag cig rnyed nas gang pos kyang pha'i rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas smras pa/ yab bdag gi tshong khang nas bsgyur ba'i rdzas byukyang brtsir du gsol/ des smras pa/ bu khyod 'di nyid na 'dug 1—690

'dug na khyod la ci zhig brtsir ①yod/ des smras pa/ yab 'on kyang brtsir ②gsol / mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /brtsis na gang khuyang rigs pas byabasgrubs pa gser ⑤bzhi po nyid ma gtogs pa gser 'bum lhag cig byung ngo / /khyim bdag 'byor pa dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes te bsams 6pa sems can 'di ni bsod nams kyi rtsomathu chen po dang ldan pa zhig lta duste/ 'dis 'di nyid na 'dug bzhin nyugaser 'bum rnyed byacig grub bo snyam mo/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na khyim bdag 'byor pa nad kyis btab par gyur nas des bsams skyepa bdag shi ba dang 'di dag 'bye bar 'gyur gyis nyusnye tshothabs shig bsham par bya'o snyam nas des de dag la smras pa/ bu dag shing skam po dag sta skyo gon gyis shig /de rnams kyis shing dag sta tshigon gebyas pa dang / des smras pa/ me bus shig/de rnams kyis skyeme bus pa dang / des smras pa/ mgal pa re re nas phyung shig/de rnams kyis mgal pa re re nas phyung ba dang / me nyu de shi bar gyur nyu to/ /des smras pa/ bu dag khyed nyu9kyis mthong ngam/ yab mthong lags so/ /des tshigs su bcad rdu pa dag smras pa/ mgal pa tshogs pas me rdu1'bar byu ltar/ /spun tshogs pa yang de bzhin no/ /mgal pa phral na shi gyur pa / /mi rnams kyang ni de dang 'dra/ /bu dag nga byu )shi nas khyed cag gis bud med kyi tshig mnyan par mi bya'o/ /bud med kyis ni bza' ri dag 'byed/ /snar ma rnams ni ngag gis 'byed/ /ngan la smras pas gsang tshig 'phel/ /'dod pa yis gyeni mdza' bshes bya'abyed/ /de dag gzhan ni dong ngo / /'byor len de nyid na 'dug pa dang des de la du )smras pacho rte/ bu khyod kyis ji ltar gyur kyang gang po gtang du bar mi bya ste/ sems can 'di ni bsod nams kyi 2 mthu chen po dang 1—691

ldan pa yin no zhes bsgo ①ste/ bsags pa kun gyi ②mtha' zad cing / /mthon po rnams kyi chamatha' ltung gyur④/ /phrad pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/ /gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ⑤ba yin/ /zhes smras nas dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur to/ /de rnams kyis de ras sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po rnams kyis khyogs brgyan te bkur sti 'ucher byas nas dur khrod du khyer te bsregs so/ /de nas mya ngan bsang ba thobyas nas smras pa/ gang gi 2tshe bdag cag gi pha gson pa de'i tshe ni srog de la rag las na da de dus las 'das na / gal te de rtsa'atsho nam yal bar bor te 'dug na khyim zhig par 'gyur zhing nye mdu rnams kyis kyang skyedapyas par 'gyur gyis8/ ma la bdag cag zong thogs te yul gzhan du 'dong ngo / /gang pos smras pa/ gal te de ltar can cobadag kyang mchi'o/ /de rnams gekyis smras pa/ khyod 'di nyid du 'dug la tshong khang gi sabya ba dag byos shig /kho bo cag kho na 'dong ngo zhes de rnams kyis zong khyer te yul gzhan du tshadong ngo // //'dul ba gzhi/ bam po nyi shu bzhi pa/ gang po la ni dgos pa thams cad gtad nas de nyid na gnas so/ /chos nyid kyis phyug po'i khyim dag na nyin re zhing 'god pa 'bog pa yin pas/ de dag gi nyunyechung mas bran mo de skyi dag mngags te 'god pa nod du btang ba las gang po tshong pa dang / tshong dpon dang / ded dpon dang / gzhan yang rjes su 'tsho ba dag gis yongs su bskor cing 'dug ste de dag gis skabs ma rnyed do/ /ji tsam na de dag langs te dong bar gyur pa de'i tshe de dag la nyin par gyi 'god 0pa phog go/ /bu mo de dag ring zhig lon te 'ongs pa byadang / kye ma bu mo khyed 3cag ring 1—692

zhig ci thogs zhes spyos pas ①de dag gis smras pa/ gang po tshong pa dang /tshong dpon dang / ded dpon dang / gzhan yang rjes su 'tsho ba dag gis yongs su bskor nas ②nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bur gzi brjid 'bar zhing bzhugs te/gang gi 0tshe de dag langs te mchis pa de'i tshe phog go/ /de dag gis smras pa④/gang dag gis ༅khyim na bran mo'i bu dag dbang phyug la dbang byed pa de dag la yong yang de ltar 'gyur ro/ /'byor len gyi ༅chung mas bran mo la smras pa/ring mo zhig tu ci'i phyir thogs/ des skabs de rgyas par smras pa dang / des smras pa/ khyod 'or che'o/ /khyod kyis dus shes par byos la song shig /des dus shes par byas nas song ba dang myur du thob bo/ /gzhan dag ni ring du thogs par gyur nas de dag gis de la dris pa/ khyod ni ci ste myur bar 'khor/des thams cad smras nas de dag kyang de dang lhan cig 'dong bar brtsams so/ /gang po yang tshong pa dang / tshong dpon dang / ded rtsodapon dang / gzhan yang rjes su 'tsho ba rnams kyis yongs su bskor cing 'dug pa las de dag kyang dong nas/ des de la nyin par gyi du'agod pa phog go/ /de dag gis kyang myur du thob bo/ /de dag gi jo mo dag gis smras pa/ da 1myur du 'khor ba 'di la rgyu ci yod/ de dag gis smras pa/ jo mo thu mo snyun mi mnga' bar gyur cig / de'i tshe gang gi rtsabran mo mchis pa de'i tshe phog lags kyis hubadag cag de dag ⑫dang 'grogs te mchi'o/ /de dag mi bzod pa skyes nas smras pa/ gang dag gi ⑫khyim na bran mo'i bu dag dbang phyug la dbang byed pa de dag la yong yang de ltar 'gyur ro/ / ji tsam 0dus gzhan zhig na 'byor len dang / 'byor skyob ⑫dang / 'byor dga' rnams lhan cig tu dga' zhing mthun pas ⑩rgya mtsho chen 1—693

po nas gru bo che ༅grub ste 'ongs so/ /'byor len gyis khuchung ma la dris pa/bzang mo gang pos khyod zhulegs par bskyangs sam/ des smras pa/ ji ltar ming po'am/ bus bgyi ba bzhin du legs par bgyis so/ /gzhan dag la khyim thab dag cudag gis smras pa dang de dag gis smras pa/ gang dag gis ⑤khyim na bran mo'i bu dbang phyug la dbang bgyid zhupa de dag la yong ༅yang de ltar 'gyur lags so/ /de dag gis bsams ⑧pa/ bud med dag ni mdza' bshes kyi rkyodabyen du 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na ka shi ku'i ras kyi tsu 4tshong khang gi sgo phye ma thag tu 'byor len gyi bu 'ongs nas gang pos de la ka shi ma'i ras yug gcig bskon no/ /mna' ma dag gis mthong nas smras pa/bu 'di sus byin/ des smras pa/ khu gus byin no/ /gzhan dag gis mthong nas kyang rang rang gi nyunyebu btang ba dang / ka shi ku'i ras kyi skyotshong khang gi sgo ni bcad/ ras sbom po dag yod pa'i tshong khang gi sgo phye ba la de dag kyang ma skye stes 0te/ phyin nas de dag la gang pos ras sbom po dag bskon no/ /de dag gis mthong nas khyim thab nyu)dag la smras pa/ khyed nyu9cag gis gzigs sam/kha cig la ni ka shi ku'i ras mayug stsal la/ kha cig la ni ras sbom po dag go/ /de dag gis lan btab pa/ cig nyunyegadon mi za bar 'di ltar ka shi ma'i tshong khang gi ras kyi nyuskyesgo ni bcad la/ ras sbom po'i sgo bye rngu ba la bab pa zhig ma yin grang / de dag gis smras pa/ da dung yang brtag 3par bgyi'o/ /ji ⑫tsam dus gzhan zhig na sha kha ra'i 'utshong khang gi sgo phye ba na 'byor len gyi bu 'ongs gyo nas des sha kha ra 2)phor bu gang thob ste/ des de khyer nas khyim du song ba dang mna' ma dag gis mthong nas smras pa/ bu 'di sus byin/ des smras 1wa 694

pa① / khu gus byin no/ /de dag gis kyang rang rang gi zhubu btang ba dang /sha kha ②ra'i tshong khang gi sgo ni bcad/ bu ram gyi tshong khang ④gi sgo phye ba dang /de dag kyang ma stes ④te/ bu ram gyi tshong khang ༅gi sgo bye rnguba'i khar 'ongs nas de dag gis bu ram zhig thob bo/ /de dag gis smras pa/ khyed dukyis gzigs sam / gcig la ni sha kha ra stsal la/ gzhan la ni spugu ram 475 lo/ /de dag gis de mthong ste/ ji ltar khyim bgo tshub byed par stsol pa de lta 2de ltar khyim thab dag bye nas de dag phan tshun gros byas pa/ bdag cag rtso)gi khyim gtan zhig gis bgo skubar bya'o/ /gcig gis smras pa/ phu bo chen po sbran 6pa snyam/ gcig gis smras pa/ re zhig ji ltar bgo bar dpyad 6do/ /de skyeganyis kyis kyi rang gi blos dpyad pa/ gcig gis ni khyim na yod pa dang zhing na yod pa'o/ /gcig gis ni tshong khang na yod pa dang yul gzhan na yod pa'o/ /gcig gis ni gang po'o/ /gal te phu bo chen pos tsunakhyim na yod pa dang zhing na yod pa blangs nanyu9/ bdag cag gis tshong khang na yod pa dang / yul gzhan na ciX yod pas rang 'tsho bar nus so/ /'on te tshong khang na yod pa dang / snyo yul gzhane na yod pa blangs na/ 'on kyang bdag cag gis khyim na yod pa dang /zhing na yod pa dang thu/ 'tsho bar bya zhing gang po yang mnar bar nus so snyam nas / de gnyis kyis de ltar gros byas te 5'byor len gyi 'udrung du song nas spun zhig par 'gyur gyis thubadag cag khyim bgo'ori 'u/ /des smras pa/ khyim 'jigs 0par byed pa ni bud med dag yin pas legs par brtags te bya ba snyam/de gnyis kyis byasmras pa/ bdag cag gis brtags zin gyis du )bgo'o/ /des smras pa/ gal te de ltar na gzu du bo mi lnga zhig bos shig /de gnyis kyis ༅1—695

smras pa/ bdag cag gis snga mo zhig tu bgos zin na gzu ①bo mi lnga ci dgos kyis dugacig gis ni khyim na yod pa dang zhing na yod pa dag go/ /gcig gis ni zhutshong khang na yod pa dang yul gyi ④mtha' na yod pa'o/ /gcig gis ni gang ⑤po'o༅la/ /des smras pa/ ci gang po'i skal rtsib mi sbyin nam/ de gnyis kyis ⑤smras pa/ bran mo'i bu de la bgo skal sus sbyin/ der ma bas kyis de nyid ⑨bdag cag gis bgo'o/ /gal te khyod bzhed na khyod nyid 0snoms shig /des bsams ༅pa/ pha na re bdag la 'khyod kyis bdog pa thams cad yongs su btang yang gang po gtang thabar mi bya'o zhes bsgo bas gang po blang cibar bya'o snyam du bsams skyenas smras pa/ gal te de lta na gang po ni kho bos bkur ro/ /khyim na yod pa dang / zhing na yod pa dbang ba gang yin pa de ni rings par khyim du song nas smras pa/ mna' ma thu mo phyung shig /de tsophyir byung rngub dang slar yang ma 'jug shig /ci'i phyir/ bdag cag gis khyim du gtogs pa bgos zin to/ /tshong khang na yod pa dang / yul gzhan na yod pa dbang ba gang yin pa 8de yang de ma thag tu tshong khang du song nas smras pa/ gang po mar bobs shig /des babs 2pa dang / da phan chad ma 'dzeg zhu shig /ci'i phyir / bdag cag gis khyim bgos te/ yul gzhan na yod pa dang tshong khang na yod pa ni bdag gi byuyin no/ /des smras pa/ bdag gi bgo zhuskal byin cig /des smras pa/ khyod bran mo'i bu yin na khyod la ci'i phyir bgo skal byinas/der ma zad khyod nyid kho bo cag phyogis bgos te phu bo chen pos thob bo/ /'byor len gyi chung ma gang po dang lhan cig 'grogs te gnyen zhig gi khyim du dong ba na bus pa bkres bunas ngu bar brtsams so/ /des smras pa/ gang po bus pa 1—696

dag la g.yar snas ①stsol cig /des smras pa/ kār ṣā pa ṇa 0phog shig /des smras pa/ khyod kyis ②gser 'bum snyed kyi 0spogs byas na 0bus pa dag gi g.yar snas ⑥ma mchis pa lta ci kho bos khyed cag gi ༅khyim 'di 'dra ba mkhos nisu 'bebs par 'gyur bar shes sam/ gal te kho bos shes par gyur na gser 'bum phrag du ma spags pa zhig /bud med kyi tsogos kyi mthar ma sha ka sgyu ma can dag thum po byed pa de ni chos nyid yin te/ des ma sha ka 0sgyu ma can zhig phog ste g.yar snas snoms te byon ༅cig /des de khyer te tshong dus ④su song ba las mi zhig gis rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis thabadas pa'i shing las khur cig khyer te grang bas sbrebs nas 'dar zhing 'ong ba de des mthong nas dris pa/ kye nang rje ci'i phyir de ltar 'dar/ des smras 8pa/ bdag gis kyang ma 'tshal ⑫te / cung zad du na shing khur 'di thogs nas bdag 'di 'dra bar grang bar gyur to/ /de shing brtags rtsapa la mkhas pas des shing de brtag ⑩par brtsams pa dang / de na tsan dan sa mchog yod par mthong nas des de la smras pa/kye nang rje rin ji tsam du btsong / / kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgyar 8ro/ /des skyeshing khur de blangs nas tsan dan sa mchog de du phyung ste/ tshong dus zhusu song nas sog les dum bu bzhir gshegs cite/ bu ram de rnams kār ṣā pa ṇa stong du btsongs tsonas de nas de la kār ṣā pa ṇa 3lnga brgya byin te 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim ga ge mo zhes bya ba na 'byor len gyi chung ma 'dug gisabya/ der shing khur 'di khyer la gang pos bskur ba yin no zhes byos shig /des de khyer nas ji a+yoltar gyur pa dag smras pa dang / des brang brdungs nas smras pa/ 'di ltar de nor 'khyams na shes rab kyang 'khyams sam/ ci btso ba tshol 0du btang na 1—697

btso rgyu gang yin pa de nyid med par bud ①pa bskur to/ /ci ⑤tsam dus ③gzhan zhig na grong khyer slo ma lta bu'i rgyal po tsha ba'i rims chen pos thebs nas myog myog por gyur pa de la sman pas tsan dan sa mchog bstan to/ /de nas blon po rnams kyis tsan dan sa mchog btsal ④bar brtsams pa dang / de rnams kyis tshong dus ⑤su brgyud pa las thos nas de rnams gang po'i drung du song ste ⑥/tsan dan sa mchog yod dam/ yod do/ /rin ji tsam du btsong / kār ṣā pa ṇa ⑦stong ngo / /de rnams kār ṣā pa ṇa dustong gis nyos nas rgyal po la byugs pa dang sos par gyur to/ /rgyal pos bsams pa/ gang gi lakhyim na tsan dan sa mchog yod pa'i khyim 6de ci 'dra ba zhig yin snyam 7nas/ rgyal pos blon po rnams la smras 8pa/ 'di ga las 'ongs/ blon po rnams kyis tsoms pa/ lha gang po las so/ /gang po 'dir khug shig /der pho nya song nas smras pa/gang po lhas bka' stsal to/ /des dpyad ④par brtsams pa/ rgyal po bdag la ci'i phyir bka' stsol/ des yang bsams pa/ des 8tsan dan sa mchog gis snyun gdangs par gyur pas de'i phyir bdag la bka' stsal gyis byatsan dan sa mchog thams cad khyer te 'gro'o snyam tsonas/ des tsan dan sa mchog gi 8dum bu gsum ras kyis khud tsodu dkris te/ gcig lag tu thogs nas rgyal po'i drung du song ba dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ gang po tsan dan sa zhu mchog cung zad yod dam/ des smras pa/ lha 'dir mchis so/ /'di la rin ji tsam/gser 'bum mo/ /gzhan yang 2yod dam/ lha mchis so zhes des dum bu sum car byabastan pa dang rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ gang po la gser bzhi 'bum byin cig /gang pos smras pa/ lha gsum gyis 3ni stsol cig /1—698

gcig ①ni lha la skyes su 'bul lo/ /gsum gyis ②byin nas rgyal pos smras pa/gang po khyod nga'i ②thugs su 'thad kyis ④mchog ci 'dod pa gsol cig dang sbyin no / /lha gal te thugs dang 'thad par gyur na lha'i yul du sus kyang mi gtse ⑤bar mchis par gsol/ rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba shes ldan dag deng phyin chad ⑥khyed kyis gzhon nu rnams la bsgo bar bya'itso/ gang po la ni ma yin no / /ji tsam na du tshong pa lnga brgya tsam pa 0rgya mtsho chen po'i gru bo che byagrub nas grong khyer slo ma lta bur lhags so/ /tshong pa'i tshogs kyis nang khrims su yibacas pas / bdag cag sus kyang gcig pu tsotshogs las gar te tshong pa'i drung du 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /gal te song na de la kār ṣā pa ṇa drug bcu cadabab bo/ /brungs 8kyang tshogs 8te blang bar tho)bya'o zhes bcas so/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ gang po yang sbran 8pa snyam/ kha cig gis smras pa/ bkren pa de la sbran yin ci yod/ de'i tshe gang po phyir byung ba na/ des tshong pa lnga brgya tsam rgya mtsho chen po nas gru bo che 4grub nas grong 0khyer slo ma lta bur phyin no zhes thos nas/de grong khyer du ma zhugs pa nyid du de dag gi cudrung du song ste dris pa/ shes ldan dag rdzas 'di dag ci yin/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di dang 'di dag yin no/ /rin ji tsam/ ded dpon gar phyin yang khyod dukho na dri bar bas so//des smras pa/ gal te de lta zhu yin yang 'on kyang rin thang smos dushig /de dag gis gser sa ya dang brgyad 'bum du rin btab bo/ /des smras pa/ shes ldan dag thag bcad phyapa'i gser sum ci'abum khyer cig phyo /zong 'di dag ni kho bo'i yin no/ /lhag ma ni nang du phyin nas sbyin no/ /de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes pa dang / des gser sum 'bum yang blangs nas thag gcad pa'i phyir ⑦1—699

byin / rang gis ①rgyas kyang btab ste song ngo / /de ②nas tshong pa'i tshogs kyis zhutshong pa'i g.yog gis ④mi dag rdzas ci yod ⑤stos shig ces mngags nas de dag zhusong ste dris pa/ rdzas 'di dag ci yin/ 'di dang 'di dag yin no/ /bdag cag la 'di 'dra bas ni mdzod dang bang ba gang bar 'dug go/ /de rnams kyis ⑦smras pa/ gang yang rung ⑧ma gang yang rung ste/ 'on 0kyang 'di btsongs cizin to/ /su zhig la/ gang po la'o/ /gang po la btsongs spun chen mo zhig khugs mod/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ des thag bcad 8par byin pa gang yin pa de khyod 8kyis rin du yang mi byin cino/ /des thag bcad 8par ci byin gser sum 'bum mo/ /des phu bo de dag las brkus tsoyang dag go/ /de rnams slar log ste tshong pa'i tshogs la smras pa/ rdzas de dag ni btsongs ⑩zin to/ /su zhig la/ gang po la'o/ /gang po la tshongs 'un chen mo zhig khugs mod/ des thag bcad 8par byin pa gang yin pa de khyod du kyis rin du yang mi byin kye no/ /des thag bcad 3 par ci byin/ srang sum 'bum mo/ /des spun de dag las brkus ri )yang dag go/ /de rnams kyis de bos nas smras pa/gang po tshong pa'i tshogs kyis ri )khrims su bcas pa/ sus kyang gcig pus zong mi blang gis 2kyitshong pa'i tshogs kho nas blang bar 2bya'o zhes bcas na 3khyod kyis ci'i phyir blang / des smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang gi 9tshe khyod 'ukyis khrims su bca' ba byas pa de'i tshe ci kho bo'am/ kho bo'i phu du )nu bo dag la bsgo'am/ khyod kho bo phyanas khrims su bca' ba byas/ khyed cag nyid srungs 3shig /de nas tshong pa'i tshogs khros nas kār ṣā pa ṇa 3drug bcu'i phyir bzung ste nyi ma la bzhag pa rgyal du po'i mi gang gis mthong ba de dag gis rgyal po la smras pa dang ④/1—700

rgyal pos bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag de rnams khug shig /de dag gis de rnams bkug pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed cag gis ci'i phyir gang po bzung ste nyi ma la bzhag /lha tshong pa rnams kyis khrims su bcas pa/sus kyang gcig pus zong 'jal ①tshong mi bgyi'o zhes bcas pa las/ 'di gcig pus 'jal rmitshong bgyis pas so/ /des smras pa/ lha gang gi zhutshe 'di dag gis khrims su bca' ba bgyis pa de'i tshe 'di dag gis ci bdag gam bdag gi kluphu nu bo dag la bsgo'am zhes rmar phyogasol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ shes ldan dag gang po'i skyoshags bzang ngo / /de rnams skyengs nas de btang ngo / /ji tsam thodus gzhan zhig na rgyal po la rdzas shig gi dudagos pa byung nas des tshong pa'i tshogs bkug ste bsgo spub/ shes ldan dag nga la rdzas che ge mo zhes bya ba zhig dgos kyis lku de nga la phul cig /de rnams kyis smras hupa/ lha gang po la mchis sosku/ /des smras pa/ nga skye de la bka' mi stsol gyis6/ khyed 6nyid kyis glude las panyos la nga la phul cig /de dag gis gang po la pho nya btang ste tshong pa'i tshogs 'bod do 8zhes byas so/ /des smras pa/ kho bo mi 'ong skyengo /de nas tshong pa'i tshogs thams cad 'dus te de'i khyim du song nas sgor bsdad de de la phrin rngu btang nas gang po tshong pa'i tshogs sgo na sdod kyis byung byazhig ces spring ngo / /de nga rgyal dang nyam du byashed dang bcas pa'i dregs pas byung ba dang / tshong pa'i tshogs kyis smras pa/ ded dpon ji ltar nyos pa bzhin du zong byin cig /des smras pa/ gal te ji ltar nyos pa bzhin zong byin na kho bo tshong pa 3chen po yin mod/ de dag gis smras pa/ rin nyis 'gyur ④gyis byin cig dang tshong pa'i tshogs mchod par 'gyur ro/ /des bsams du )pa/1—701

tshong pa'i tshogs ni ①mchod par bya ba yin no snyam nas/ des sa ya dang lnga 'bum 2nyis 'gyur zhudu byin no/ /lhag ma ni khyim du sbas nas des bsams ④pa/ji ga zil pa'i thigs pas bum pa dgang bar nus sam/ rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par bya'o snyam nas/ rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par bya ba'i phyir des grong khyer slo tsam lta bur dril sgrogs su thobacug pa/ shes ldan grong khyer slo ma lta bu na gnas pa'i tshong pa dag nyon cig /ded rtsodapon gang po rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par 'gyur gyisam/ khyed cag las gang yoded dpon gang po dang lhan cig sho gam med pa dang / la gcan 6pa'i gla med pa dang / gru btsas med par rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par spro ba de dag gis rgya mtsho chen por 'dong ba'i zang sta gon byos shig /tshong pa lnga brgya tsam gyis rgya mtsho chen por 'dong ba'i zong sta gon byas so/ /de nas ded dpon gang po dge mtshan dang / bkra shis dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dag byas te nyunye'akhor tshong pa lnga brgya dang rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa las 3/ gru bo che nyu tshegrub nas/ grong khyer slo ma lta bur 'khor to/ /de lta bur lan drug gi bar du rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa las gru bo che grub nas slar 'khor to/ /phyogs kun du gang pos lan drug gi 6bar du rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa las gru bo che thosagrub nas slar 'khor skyato zhes sgra grags pa dang / mnyan yod pa'i tshong pa dag zong thogs te grong khyer slo ma lta bur dor rkyinas / de dag lam gyis dub pa skungal sos nas/ ded dpon gang po phyagang na ba der dong ste lhags nas smras pa/ ded dpon rgya mtsho chen por bzhud dog ༷ //des smras pa/ shes ldan dag lan drug gi bar 'udu rgya mtsho chen po nas gru bo che 3grub ste/ slar 'khor ba las bdun par 'jug pa khyed cag 3gis mthong ba'am 1—702

thos pa 'ga' yod dam/ de dag gis smras pa/ gang po bdag cag shul ①ring po nas khyod ②kyi ched du lhags te gal te mi 'jug na khyod nyid tshad ma yin no/ /des bsams zhupa/ bdag la ni nor gyis cung zad kyang mi chog ④pa med na 'di dag gis zhudon du 'gro bar bya'o snyam nas/ de de rnams dang lhan cig tu rgya mtsho chen por chas so/ /de dag gis nam tho rangs kyi ༅dus su ched du brjod pa dang / pha rol 'gro byed dang / bden pa mthong ba dang / gnas brtan pa'i phyetshigs su bcad pa dang / gnas brtan ma'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / ri druganas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / thub pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / don gyi tshoms skyikyi mdo dag gsang bstod de bton pa dang / des de dag thos nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag glu bzang po zhig 6long 4shig /de rnams kyis smras pa/ ded dpon dzo de dag ni glu ma lags so/ /'o na ci/de ni sangs rgyas kyis bka'o/ / /des sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra sngon ma thos pa thos nas ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas spu zing zhes byed nas gus pa dang bcas pas dris pa/ shes ldan dag sangs rgyas zhes bya ba de su zhig yin/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ shākya'i sras dge slong gau cita ma shākya'i rigs las skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig skyebagos te yang tshadag pa kho nar 3— dad pas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub skyomangon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhig yod de/ ded /skyedapon de ni sangs rgyas ri sduzhes bgyi'odu nye/ /shes ldan dag bcom ldan 'das de da ltar gang na bzhugs/ded dpon mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi phyokun dga' ra ba 3 na bzhugs so/ /des de snying la bzung du nas de rnams dang lhan 1—703

cig rgya mtsho chen por zhugs te gru bo che ༅grub nas slar lhags so/ /de'i phu bo 'byor len gyis bsams ②pa 'di rgya mtsho chen por 'gro 'gro ②bas dub par gyur gyis 'di cokhyim dbub par ⑤bya'o snyam nas des de la smras pa/ khyod kyi don du tshong pa dang / tshong dpon dang / ded ༅dpon gang gis ༅bu mo bslang ba duphu bo la smros rtsashig /des smras pa/ bdag 'dod pa ni ma 'tshal gyis chagal te gnang na rab tu 'byung ngo / /des smras pa/ gang gi tsotshe bdag cag 6khyim gyi nyu)'tsho nam la ma zhugs pa de'i tshe rab tu mi 'byung bar da sh+yi ci'i phyir skyerab tu 'byung / des smras pa/ de'i tshe ni mi rigs lags so/ / da ni rigs pa lags so/ /chudes de gdon mi za bar gal gyis skye'achu bar shes nas gnang ngo / /des smras pa/ phu bo rgya mtsho chen po na nyes dmigs ni mang la mnog ni chung ngo / /der 'jug pa ni mang skul slar 'khor ba byunyung bas khyod kyis rnam pa thams cad du rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par mi bya'o/ /khyod la rigs pas bsgrub rdu pa'i nor phal po ci che yod la khyod tri kyi nu bo dag la nunyerigs pa ma yin pas bsgrubs pa yin pas gal te de dag na re lhan cig 'khod par bya'o zhes zer na 'dug par mi bya'o zhes smras nas rim gro pa gcig khrid de mnyan yod du song ste/ mnyan yod kyi skyed zhukyimos tshal sroXdu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la phrin pa btang ste 3/ khyim bdag ded dpon gang po khyim bdag blta rdunyebar 'dod nas skyed tshemos tshal na sdod do zhes spring ba dang /mgon med zas sbyin gyis bsams du pa/ gdon mi za bar chu'i 3bzhon pas dub nas 3/ da ni thang gi bzhon 3pas 'ongs so snyam mo/ /de du nas dris pa/kye nang rje zong ji snyed cig khyer te 'ongs bu/ de la zong ga la yod/ rim gro 1—704

pa dang gnyis pu nyuste de dang bdag tu bas so/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyis bsams ②pa/ gang bdag gis skyes bu dam pa de la bkur stir zhum byas par khyim du bod ④pa ni bdag rigs pa dang ldan pa ma yin no 8snyam nas/ des de bkur snyi 'uchen pos khyim du bos nas sku mnye 3byas te khrus byas nas ⑧zan byin te dga' ba'i spugatam byas te 'dug nas/ mgon med zas sbyin gyis dris pa/ded dpon dgos pa ci zhig la 'ongs/ khyim bdag bdag ni legs par gsungs nyuX pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi kye dngos po 'tshal lo/ /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ro stod bstod sanas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste ched du brjod pas ched du skyabarjod pa/kye ma'o sangs rgyas/ kye ma'o chos/ kye ma'o dge 'dun/ kye ma'o chos legs par gsungs pa nyid/ de la ni da skyes bu gtso bo 'di lta bu yang rang gi skye bo ci dang gnyen bshes kyi tshogs rgya chen po dang / mdzod dang bang nyunyemadzod rgyas pa rnams kyang spangs nas legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba las rab tu byung nyu5zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po 'dod par gyur to / /de nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ded dpon gang po khrid de bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la bzhugs nas chos 'chad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin skyes dang chas te 'ong ba 5gzigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang dge slong rnams la bka' 455 pa/ dge slong dag khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin skyes dang chas tsete da ltar 'ong ngo /de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes ni 'di lta bu med de/ 'di lta ste gdul zhu ba'i skyes 1—705

bu'o / /de nas zhukhyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ②zhabs gnyis la ②phyag byas te/ ded dpon gang po dang lhan cig phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa ded dpon gang po 'di legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa ④dge slong gi rgyadangos po 'tshal na/ de bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu dbyung 'ub dang bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la cang mi gsung bas 3gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ded dpon gang po la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong tshur shog tshangs par spyad 3pa spyod cig ces bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa'i mod kho nar de skra 9byi ba dang / snam sbyar gon tshupar gyur te/ skra dang kha spu zhag bdun skyes pa tsam dang / lag na lhung bzed nyu dang bya ma bum thogs pa dang / dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i spyod lam lta bur gnas par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pas tshur shog gsungs pas deshe/ /skra byi snam sbyar gon nyu pa'i lus ldan zhing / /mod la dbang po rab zhir gnas 6gyur te/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pas lus gzugs bkab par gyur/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na tshe dang ldan pa gang po bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nasaskye/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gezhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa gang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol tonyurte/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das las 8bdag gis mdor bsdus pa'i chos thos pa ji lta bus gcig pus skye1—706

dben pa bag yod pa dang rtun ①pa dang ldan la bdag nyid la rjubadag nyid gtod cing gnas par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos mdor bsdus pa legs par bshad du gsol/ gcig pu dben pa bag yod pa dang rtun pa dang ldan la rjubadag nyid cigatod cing gnas na/ rigs kyi bu dag gang gi skyephyir skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smrig bgos te yang dag pa'i dad pas skyokhyim nas khyim ma mchis par rab tu byung bar bgyid skyipa tshangs par spyod pa'i mtha' bla na ma mchis pa de mthong ba'i chos de nyid la rang gi thumangon par shes pas mngon sum du bgyis nyu)te bsgrubs nas bdag gi skye ba ni zad do/ /tshangs par spyod pa ni spyad 0do/ /bya ba ni byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes go bar bgyi'o/ / /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa gang po la 'di skad ces bka' 47pa to/ /gang po legs so/ /legs tsunyeso/ /gang po gang khyod tsunye'adi skad du srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so zhes bya ba nas de lta bu'i chos mdor bsdus pa legs par bshad du gsol zhes bya ba'i bar mismra ba ni yang legs so zhes bya ba snga ma bzhin te/ de'i phyir rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang bshad mudo/ /gang po mig gis rnam par shes par bya ba'i gzugs sdug pa dang tshe/ chags pa dang / dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong ba tshe dang / 'dod pa dang ldan pa dang / kun du chags par 'gyur ba yod la/de dag gal te dge slong gis mthong nas mngon par dga' ba dang / mngon par bstod pa dang / lhag par chags pa dang / lhag par zhen cing gnas nas (3de dag la mngon par dga' ba dang / mngon par bstod pa dang /lhag par chags pa dang / lhag par zhen cing gnas pa de la kun du dga' ba 1—707

'byung ngo / /kun du dga' ba yod na dga' ba dang / yid bde bar 'gyur ro / /dga' ba dang yid bde ba yod na kun du chags par 'gyur ro/ /kun du chags pa yod na kun du sbyor bar 'gyur te/ dga' ba dang / kun du chags pa dang / kun du sbyor ba dang ldan par gyur pa'i dge slong ni gang po mya ngan las 'das pa las ring du gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /gang po rna bas rnam par shes par bya ba'i sgra dang / snas rnam par shes par bya ba'i dri dang / lces rnam par shes 1par bya ba'i ro dang / lus kyis rnam par shes par bya ba'i reg bya dang / yid kyis rgyarnam par shes par bya ba'i chos sdug pa dang / chags pa dang / dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / 'dod pa dang / ldan pa dang kun du chags par 'gyur ba rnams yod la/ de dag gal te dge slong gis shes ri cinas zhes bya ba nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa las ring du gyur pa zhes bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar snga ma bzhin no/ /gang po mig gis rnam par shes pa gebya ba'i gzugs sdug pa dang / chags pa dang / dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / 'dod pa dang ldan pa dang / kun du chags par 'gyur ba yod las /de dag gal te dge slong gis mthong nas mngon par mi dga' ba dang / mngon par mi stod 9pa dang / lhag par ma chags pa dang / lhag par mi 3zhen cing gnas na du tshode dag la mngon par mi dga' ba dang / mngon par mi stod spupa dang / lhag par ma chags pa dang / lhag par ma zhen par gnas pa de la kun du dga' ba mi 'byung ngo / /kun du dga' ba med na dga' ba byayid bde ba med par 'gyur ro/ /dga' ba dang yid hubade ba med skyon kun du ma chags par 'gyur ro/ /kun du chags pa med na kun du sbyor ba med par 'gyur ro/ /1—708

kun du sbyor ba med na dga' ba dang / kun du chags pa dang / kun du sbyor ba dang mi ldan pa'i dge slong ni gang po mya ngan las ①'das pa la nye bar gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /gang po rna bas rnam par shes par bya ba'i sgra dang / snas rnam par shes par bya ba'i dri dang / lces du rnam par shes par bya ba'i ro dang /lus kyis du rnam par shes par bya ba'i reg bya dang / yid kyis byarnam par shes par bya rgyaba'i 'uchos sdug pa dang / chags pa dang / dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang / 'dod pa dang ldan pa dang / kun du chags par 'gyur ba yod la/ de dag gal te dge slong gis shes rgyanas zhes bya ba shenas/ de ni mya ngan las 'das pa la nye bar gyur pa zhes bya'o zhu zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gang po ngas mdor bsdus pa'i gdams tsu ngag 'dis khyod la gtams ri — na gang du gnas par 'dod/ gang du gnos bca' bar 'dod/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis mdor bsdus pa'i gdams ri ngag 'dis bdag la tso gtams tso lags pas gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i yu/la gyi glumathar mchis par 'tshal ri lags so/ /gang po gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i yul gyi mtha'i mi rnams ni gtum pa/ gzu lums can/ rtsub pa/ gshe ba/ spro thung ba/ 'phya ba yin te/ gang po gal te khyod la gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams mngon sum du/ sdig pa tshogs par mi dbyung nyu8ba'i tshig rtsub pos gshe bar byed/zher 'debs par byed/ 'phya bar byed na/ de la khyod ji snyam byed/btsun tshipa gal te gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams bdag la mngon sum du sdig pa tshogs par mi dbyung du ba'i tshig duXrtsub pos gshe bar bgyid/ zher 'debs par bgyid/ 'phya bar bgyid na de la bdag gis 'di snyam du sems te/1—709

e ma'o gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams ni rung ba dag yin no/ /e ma'o gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams ni blo dang ldan pa yin te/ de dag bdag la sdig pa tshogs par mi dbyung ①ba'i tshig rtsub pos gshe bar byed/zher 'debs par byed/ 'phya bar byed kyang lag pa'am bong bas ma brgyab snyam mo / /gang po gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rna mas ni gtum pa zhes bya ba nas 'phya bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin tes/ gang po gal te gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams kyis dbyug pa'am mtshon gyis brgyab na de la khyod ji snyam byed/ btsun du pa gal te bdag la gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i sami rnams kyis dbyug pa'am mtshon gyis brgyab par gyur na/de la bdag gis 'di snyam 5sems te/ kye ma'o nigro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams ni rung ba dag yin no/ /kye ma'o gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams ni blo dang ldan pa yin te/ de dag bdag la dbyug pa'am mtshon gyis brgyab kyang thams cad kyis 7thams cad du srog dang bral sabar mi byed do 9snyam mo/ /gang po gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams ni gtum pa zhes bya ba nas 'phya bar byed pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ gal te gang po gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i 1 mi rnams kyis khyod thams cad kyis nyu1thams cad du srog dang 'bral mebar byed na de la khyod ji snyam byed/ btsun nyu tshopa gal te bdag la gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams kyis/ sna thams cad kyis nyunyethams cad du srog dang 'bral chubar bgyid na/ de la bdag nyid 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mnyan thos lus rnag can 'dis/ skye ba 8dang / ngo tsha ba skyedang / rnam par smod pa gang dag mtshon gyis kyang 'debs 1—710

par byed/ dug kyang za bar byed/ thag pas kyang 'gegs te 'chi bar byed/g.yang sa nas kyang mchongs te 'chi ba ①yod na/ kye ma'o gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i mi rnams ni rung ba dag yin no/ /kye ma'o gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha'i tsami rnams ni blo dang ldan pa yin te/ de dag bdag gi du lus rnag can 'di las tshegs chung dus grol bar byed do snyam bsam par bgyi'o/ /gang po legs so legs so/ /gang po khyod bzod pa dang nges pa ④'di dang ldan par gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i yul gyi mtha' 3gnas par nus pa ni khyod yang rtsolegs so//gang po song la ma bsgral ba rnams ni sgrol 3cig /ma grol ba rnams ni khrol 5cig /dbugs ma phyin pa rnams ni dbugs phyung shig /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa tsurnams ni yongs su mya ngan las zlos shigs /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang pos nyu1bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod cing rjes su yi rangs tsu nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ri zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang po de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos te lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs nas tshimanyan yod du bsod snyoms la zhugs te/ mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi ri 5zas kyi bya ba byas nas zas phyi ma'i bsod snyoms las slar nyunelog ste/ gnas mal ji ltar longs spyad pa mkhos nyu ༷su phab nas/ lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i yul gyi nyusnyematha' gang na ba der chas te/ rim gyis rgyu zhing song ba na gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i yul gyi mthar phyin to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang po snga tsuṣ+ṭhadro sham thabs du bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te/ gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mthar bsod 1—711

snyoms la zhugs pa rngon pa zhig mda' gzhu lag na ①thogs te ri dgas gshor 0du 'gro ba ②des mthong nas des bsams ④pa/ dge sbyong mgo reg 'di mthong ba ni kha rje ⑤ma rung bar byas so snyam du bsams yinas gzhu rna drung du ⑦bkang ste/tshe dang ldan pa gang po gang na ba duder brgyugs pa dang / de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang pos de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bla gos bsnyil te smras pa/bzhin bzangs dgang dka' ba 'di'i don du zhugs pas 'di la snun cig /tshigs su bcad de ⑨smras pa/ gang gi don du mkha' la bya rgyu ri dgas rnyis ⑩ zin gyur/ /g.yul ngor mda' mdung mda' bo che thogs mi rnams 'chi 'gyur la//bkren pa nyon mongs yul ngan rgyu zhing mchil kyepas nya zin pa/ /sdig pa rab mang lto 'dir khyod kyis 'tsham rims phyamada' 'phongs shig / des bsams skyepa / rab tu byung ba 'di ni 'di lta bu'i bzod pa dang nges pa dang ldan pa yin na/ ci'i phyir 'di la mda' 'phang snyam du bsams nyu) nas de sems mngon par dad par gyur to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang pos de la chos bshad debe/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi sarnams la bzhag tshepa dang / des ri khrod pa gzhan nyu5lnga brgya ni dge bsnyen tsu9byas/ lnga brgya ni dge bsnyen rngu mar byas nas gtsug stsolag 5lnga brgya rtsig tu bcug ste/ khri dang /khri'u dang / stan nang tshangs can dang / sngas nang tshangs can dang / gor thabs brgya phrag du ma 'bul du bcug go/ /zla ba gsum po de 'das pa dang des rig 3pa gsum lus kyis mngon sum du byas nas dgra bcom par gyur te/khams gsum gyi kwa 'dod chags dang bral ba zhes bya ba dunas/ dbang po dang nye dbang po'i lha dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod par bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba 1—712

dang / mngon sum du smra bar bya bar gyur ①rto zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na shing gi rna cha can gyi nu bo gnyis longs spyod srabs ②shing yongs su zad pas ②gtugs par gyur nas de gnyis kyis smras pa/ byur lta bu de bdag cag gi dukhyim nas song gis ༅tshur shog lhan cig gnas par bya'o/ /des smras pa/ byur lta bu de gang zhig yin/ gang po yin mod/ de ni kho ⑥bo'i khyim nas dpal byung ba yin gyi 'gyur lta bu duni ma yin no/ /de gnyis kyis smras pa / dpal yang rung byur yang rung tshur shog lhan cig tu gnas par bya'o ⑨/ /des nyu) smras pa/ khyed cag gi nor ni tsu)rigs par tsu)bsgrubs pa ma 3)yin la/kho bo'i 6 ni rigs par 19bsgrubs pa yin pas khyed 4cag dang kho bor 8lhan cig gnas par mi bya'o/ /de gnyis kyis smras pa/ bran mo'i bu des rgya mtsho chen por yang song meyang song nas khyod kyi skyelongs spyod dag bsgrubs pas ṭu khyod de la duḥspyod ri — pas rgyags su zad/ khyod kyis ni rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par ga la nusari dī /de de gnyis las nga rgyal bzung nas des bsams duX pa/ bdag kyang rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par bya'o snyam nas zhes bya ba nas rgya mtsho chen por zhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ji tsam na gru bo che de rjes su mthun pa'i rlung gis tsan dan sa mchog gi ri nyetshal du bdas du 9so/ /sa mkhan du)gyis smras pa/shes ldan dag tsan cadan sa mchog gi 3tshal zhes grags 'u pa gang yin pa de ni 'di yin gyis hu'adi las 'doms la long du )shig /de'i tshe na 3tsan dan sa mchog gi tshal gyi du dbang po gnod sbyin dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba yin te/ de yang gnod sbyin rnams kyi ciganod sbyin gyi bumadun sar song ngo / /de nas tsan 3dan sa mchog gi tshal 3sta re lnga brgya tsam gyis bcad par brtsams ༅so/ /gnod 1—713

sbyin mi dga' ba zhes bya bas tsan ①dan sa mchog gi tshal sta re lnga brgya tsam gyis gcod par ②mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang gnod sbyin dbang phyug chen po gang na ba der song ste phyin nas ciganod sbyin dbang phyug chen po la 'di skad ces smras sol/ /dpon po mkhyen par mdzod cig /tsan dan sa mchog gi tshal sta re lnga brgya tsam gyis 'gums na khyod kyi phrin ④las sa/ma bgyi ba gang lags pa de mdzod cig /de nas gnod sbyin dbang phyug chen po gnod sbyin rnams kyi ⑤gnod sbyin gyi 'dun thom byas nas mi bzod pa skyes te/ rlung nag po chen po 'jigs su rung ba bslangs rgyanas tsan dan sa mchog gi tshal gang na ba der chas so/ /sa mkhan gyis smras pa/ shes ldan 'dzam bu'i gling gi ④tshong pa dag nyon cig /rlung nag po chen po'i sh+yi'ajigs pa skyo zhig yod do zhes grag skyepa gang yin pa de ni 'di yin gyis ngo lon som tsu shig /de nas tshong pa'i tshogs de rnams 'jigs skrag phongs te ba spu'i (sna khung bu thams cad nas spu zing 6zhes byed nas/ lha rnams la gsol ba sabyed par rtsom skyeste/ zhi ba dang ni chu lha lus ngan nor lha sogasam / /lha mi lto 'phye gnod sbyin lha mi skyedabang po rnams/ /bdag cag shin tu nyam tho'uthag 'jigs par gyur lags kyis —/ /bsnyengs du dī bral de ring bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig /mi rnams nunyekha cig bde sogs khyod la 'dud / /gzhan dag tshangs dang khyab 'jug lha chen cadang / / sar rten ṭu shing dang tshal la brten snyepa la/ /sha za'i rlung gis zin pas skyabs tshol ca'adud/ /shing gi rna cha can sems las chung ngur ༅'dug pa dang / tshong pa rnams kyis smras pa/ ded dpon bdag cag ni sdug bsngal mi bzad 3pa nyam nga bar gyur na / khyod ci'i phyir sems las chung ngur 'dug /des smras pa/ shes ldan 1wa 714

dag kho bo la nu bos bsgo ba/ phu bo rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa ni mnog ②chung la nyes dmigs ②mang ②ste/ sred pas ldongs pa phal cher 'jug kyang byaslar 'khor ba nyung bas khyod kyis rnam pa gang gis kyang rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par mi bya'o zhes bsgo ba las/ kho bos de'i phyetshig ma mnyan te rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pas da ci 'ubyar yang med do/ /khyod kyi 2nu bo gang yin/ gang po yin no/ /3tshong pa'i tshogs rnams kyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'phags pa gang po de ni bsod nams kyi mthu chen po dang ldan pa yin gyisanyusna/ de nyid la bdag cag skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o zhes de thams cad kyis spe snatshig skyemathun par 'di skad ces 'phags pa gang po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa gang po de la phyag 'tshal lo//phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang po la mngon par dga' ba'i lha gang yin pa de dag tshe dang ldan pa gang po gang na ba der song ste phyin nas tshe dang ldan pa gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa khyod kyis gcan tsu ni sdug bsngal mi bzad nyu pa nyam nga bar gyur gyis dgongs su gsol / des bsams tes/ tsu5de nas sems ji ltar mnyam par bzhag na 7 gro bzhin skyes gnas pa'i mtha' nas mi snang bar gyur tezhu / rgya mtsho chen po nyunyegru'i dngor skyil mo krung chi bcas nas 'dug pa de lta bu'i ting nge rdunye'adzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas rlung nag po de ri rab la rdzog ste rdugs 3pa bzhin du slar log par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin dbang phyug chen pos bsams 3pa/sngon chad ni rlung nag pos gru gang la reg pa de shing bal gyi 'da' du bu bzhin 'phangs pa dang 'jig par 'gyur cizhin da snyeXrlung nag po de ri rab la phog ste/jugs pa bzhin du slar log par gyur pa'i rgyu gang yin snyam nas/ phan tshun du 1—715

brtag par brtsams pa las/ ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa gang po gru'i dngor skyil mo krung ①bcas nas 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang des smras pa/'phags pa gang po tho btsams te ②ci bgyi/ gang pos smras pa/ rga ba'i chos can khyod zhunyid kyis nga la byatho 'u'atsham mam/ gal te ngas 'di lta bu'i yon tan gyi tshogs ma thob par gyur na/ khyod kyis nga'i 'uphu bo ming lus par byas par 3'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug chen pos smras pa/ 'phags pa tsan dan sa mchog 'di ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i 5rgyal po'i don du srung lags so/ /gang pos smras pa / dpon po ji snyam du sems/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shedang / 'khor los sgyur chuba'i rgyal po gang che/'phags pa ci bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten tsu du byung ngam/ byung ngo / /gal te de lta na da gang ma gang ba de khong skyeshig /de nas tshong pa'i tshogs de rnams ci srog byin te/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po la sems mngon par dad nas gru de tsan dan sa mchog gis bkang ste chas pa dang rim gyis grong khyer slo ma lta bur phyin to/ /de nas gang pos phu bo la smras pa/ gang gi ming gis gru bo che sagrub ste 'ongs pa de ni de dbang bas khyod kyis rin po che ni tshong pa ba'adi rnams la gos sashig /bdag gis ni tsan dan sa mchog 'di rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi tephyir tsan dan gyi phreng ba'i khang bzangs brtsig go snye/ /des tshong pa de rnams la rin po che skyernams bgos so/ /de nas gang pos tsan dan sa mchog gi khang bzangs zhig brtsig 0par brtsams te/ des bzo bo dag bkug nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag ci nyi ma re re zhing kār ṣā pa ṇa yolnga brgya len nam 'on te tsan dan sa mchog gi phye ma pho sum gang len/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'phags pa tsan dan 1—716

sa mchog gi phye ma pho sum gang 'tshal lo/ /ji tsam na tshiring po ma methogs par tsan dan gyi phreng ba'i khang bzangs ②brtsigs te byi ④dor thams cad zin par gyur to/ /de na zhogs ma dang phye ma'i lhag ma gang yin pa de dag kyang btags nas de nyid rgyal zhal zhal du byugs so/ /des spun de rnams phan tshun du ⑥thams cad bzod pa gsol du bcug nas smras pa/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams spyan drangs rtsol zhal zas gsol cig /'phags pa gang po bcom ldan 'das gang na bzhugs/ mnyan yod na'o/ /lam ji srid mchis/ mnyan yod na skyidapag tshad brgya lhag tsam mo/ /re zhig rgyal po la brtag spupar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du gyis shig /de dag rgyal po'i drung du dong nas lha bdag cag ni sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drangs te zhal zas gsol bar 'tshal na/ lhas bdag cag la bstad skyedu gsol/rung gis ri —de bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa gang po khang steng du 'dzegs nas rgyal byed kyi tshal logs su kha bltas te/ pus mo ri lha nga gnyis sa la btsugs zhu te 'dug nas me tog gis gtor / bdug pas bdugs 6nas khyim pa zhig gser gyi mebya ma bum 'dzin du bcug ste tsu gsol ba 'debs pa la zhugs pa/ tshul khrims rnam dag shin tu rnam dag blo/ /zhal zas dus su rtag tu don gzigs pa/ /mgon med gyur pa rab tu gzigs nas ni/ /shin tu thugs brtser (snyemadzad de gshegs par (1gsol/ /de nas me tog de rnams sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhu sangs rgyas 6kyi mthu dang lha rnams kyi lha'i mthus me tog gi khang bzangs su 3byas te/ rgyal bu rgyal 6byed kyi zhutshal du rgan rims bzhin cuganas par gyur to/ /bdug bupa ni sprin ltar rgya spungs so/ /chu ni be+e ḍūr+ya'i 31—717

phur ma lta bur ①gyur to/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo mtshan ma la mkhas pa yin pas thal mo sbyar ba byas te bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa btsun pa spyan 'dren ldupa gang nas mchis/ kun dga' bo grong khyer slo ma lta bu nas so / /btsun pa grong khyer slo ma lta bur ji srid cig mchis/ kun dga' bo dpag tshad brgya lhag tsam yod kyis ④song la dge slong rnams la khyed cag las/ gang dang gang sang grong khyer slo ma lta bur song nas zas 5za bar spro bas 9tshul shing long shig ces bsgo skyishig /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal 3zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das las shemanyan nas tshul shing blangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams kyis tshul shing blangs so/ /de'i tshe yul chu mig can na gnas pa'i gnas brtan tshe dang ldan nga/ gang po shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus te 'dug par gyur pa des kyang tshul shing blang bar brtsams pa dang / de la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos slar tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ngatshe dang ldan pa zan 'di ni/ /ko sal 1 bdag po'i pho brang ngam/ /rab sbyin 1 khyim dang ri dgas kyi/ /khyim gyi zas kyang nyu ma lags so/ /grong khyer slo ma zhes bya ba/ /dpag tshad brgya lhag mchis pa der/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni bzhud 'tshal bas/ /gang po khyod ni ma gsung ngabazhugs/ /de shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba yin gyi gi/ des rdzu 'phrul ma bskyed tshapas de 'di snyam du sems te gang gi phyir bdag gis tsu mnyon mongs pa'i tshogs mtha' dag btsal skye cing bor la spangs shing so sor spangs naskye/ bdag mu stegs can dang thun mong ba'i rdzu 'phrul la sgyid lug gam snyam nas des brtson 'grus la gnas te rdzu 'phrul bskyed 1—718

pas ji srid tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gnas brtan gsum pa la tshul shing ma byin pa de'i bar du des lag pa glang po che'i ①sna lta bu brkyang spunas tshul shing blangs te/ de nas tshigs su bcad de dusmras pa/ gi 5ta ma 'di na rgyamangon shes drug po nyid/ /grags pa dang ni thos pas 'thob min la/ / tshan gyi ⑥yon tan rnams dang ngag dang ni/ /yid smon chen pos kyang ni ma yin gyitsu/ /bdag 'dra yongs su rtog 5par byed pa rnams/ /rga bas dar yal gyur kyang zhi ba dang / /tshul khrims lhag mthong stobs dang bsam gtan stobs/ /rnam pa sh+yidu mas mngon shes drug ldan 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag tsu ci'adi ni nga'i dge slong rnams kyi mchog yin te/ nga'i nyan thos mchod pa'i tshul shing blang ba la dang po ci dhe tshul shing len pa rnams kyi nang na 'di lta ste yul chu mig can na gnas pa'i gnas brtan gang po mchog yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo song la ci dge slong rnams la ngas dge slong dag khyed kyis dge ba mi spyoms 4pa dang / sdig pa mi bcab par gnas par bya'o zhes bshad mod kyi/ 'on kyang grong khyer de na mu stegs sapa rnams gnas pas khyed las gang ri gis rdzu 'phrul 1— gang thob pa de des grong khyer slo ma lta bur song la zan bza' bar bya'o zhes sgo shig /btsun zhu)pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das las mnyan spyo nas dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces ngas dge slong rnams kyis dge ba mi spyoms du pa dang / sdig pa mi bcab par gnas par phyebya'o/ /zhes bshad mod kyi du zhes bya ba nas song la 1—719

zan bza' bar bya'o zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal pos grong khyer slo ma lta bu rdo ba dang gseg ma dang gyo mo rnams sel du bcug nyuste/ tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab dri zhim po'i pog phor sna tshogs bshams/ dar gyi chun 'phyang du mang po dpyangasadu )/ me tog sna tshogs chal bar bkram ste dga' dga' ltar byas te ④grong khyer slo ma lta bu skyil sgo bcwa brgyad yod la rgyal po de la yang bu bcu bdun yod de/ 6grong khyer gyi sgo rer 3so sor rgyal po'i bu rnams 'byor pa mchog dang bkod dori / /sgo chen por ni slo ma lta bu'i shebadag po'i rgyal po rgyal po'i hūṃ tsho'abyor pa chen po dang tshe dang ldan pa gang po dang shing gi ri — rna cha can dang rgya skyegs zhu kyi rna cha can dang zha nye'i rna cha can 'dug go/ /byu ji tsam na lo ma 'drim pa dang / shang tse 'drim ci 5pa dang snod spyad 'drim ci pa dag rdzu 'phrul gyis lhags pa rgyal pos mthong nas smras sapa/ ci btsun zhu pa gang po bcom ldan 'das gshegs sam des smras pa/ 'di dag ni lo ma 'drim 9pa dang / shang tse 'drim ci pa dang / snod spyad 'drim pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das ma lags so/ /ji tsam na dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams bsam gtan la snyoms par zhugs pa rnam pa du mas lhags pa dang rgyal pos yang dris pa/ ci btsun pa gang po bcom ldan 'das gshegs ci sam/ des smras pa / ma lags te 'di gni dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan rnams bsam gtan la du snyoms par zhugs pa rnam riX pa du mas lhags pa lags so/ /de nas dge bsnyen du zhig gis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ kha cig seng ge stag tshe dang glang po che rta klu dang khyu mchog bzang po bcibs/ /kha cig rin chen gzhal du med khang dang ri dang shing mdzes shing rta 'bar la rten/ /gzhan hu dag nam 1—720

mkha'i ngos las chu 'dzin glog gi phreng bas brgyan ①pa lta bur ni/ /rab tu dgyes zhubazhin lha yi pho brang lta bur rdzu 'phrul dag gis gshegs par brtson/ /kha cig sa brtol gyen du 'byung / /kha cig nam mkha'i dkyil nas 'bab/ /kha cig stan las sprul par byed/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mthu la ltos/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gtsug lag khang gi phyi rol du zhabs gnyis bkrus te/gtsug lag khang du zhugs nas gad na bshams pa nyid la bzhugs te/ sku drang por bsrang nas dgongs pa mngon du phyogs par bzhag rdugo/ /ji tsam na bcom ldan 'das kyis mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas pa'i zhabs kyis dri gtsang khang du bzhag pa na sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur te/ sa chen po 'di g.yos/rab tu g.yos/ 5kun tu rab tu sregayos so/ /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/kun tu rab tu 4chem chem stege/ shar phyogs mtho na ri nub phyogs dma'atho/nub phyogs mtho na shar phyogs dma' / lho phyogs mtho na byang phyogs dma'/byang phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma'/ dbus mtho na mtha' dma'o / /rgyal pos tshe dang ldan pa gang po la dris pa/ 'phags pa gang po 'di ci skalags/ des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas pa'i zhabs kyis dri gtsang khang du bzhag pa des na nyunyes rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gser gyi 'od zer 6gyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od bkye ste/ des 'dzam bu'i gling gser zhun ma lta bur snang bar gyur to/ /yang rgyal po ngo mtshar du gyur pa'i 6mig phye nas dris pa/'phags pa gang po 'di ci lags/ des smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od zer bkye cib lags soskye// //⑫1—721
